import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/traffic/ego_approach_congestion/ego_approach_congestion_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/adas/ACC/scenarios/common/activate_acc/activate_acc_top.osc"

extend sut.acc_ego_approach_congestion:
    sce_func_kind: sce_func_kind with: keep(it == acc_ego_approach_congestion)
    cover(sce_func_kind, expression: sce_func_kind, event: start)
    
    overlap_fraction: overlap_fraction
    keep(overlap == overlap_fraction.overlap)
    overlap_dist: length with:
        keep(it==overlap_fraction.overlap_fraction())

    do acc_ego_approach_congestion:serial():

        initial_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
            sut.car.drive() with:
                speed([20..30]kph, at: start)
            ego_approach_congestion.vehicle_1.drive() with:
                speed([20..30]kph, at: start)
                position(time: [2..3]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)
                lane(same_as: sut.car)
            ego_approach_congestion.vehicle_2.drive() with:
                speed([20..30]kph, at: start)
                position(time: [2..3]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)
                lane(left_of:sut.car)
            ego_approach_congestion.vehicle_3.drive() with:
                speed([20..30]kph, at: start)
                position(time: [2..3]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)
                lane(right_of: sut.car)
        with: duration([2..3]s, tolerance: 1s)

        sut.car.activate_acc(requested_acc_cruise_speed:acc_cruise_speed)
        
        ego_approach_congestion:ego_approach_congestion(gen_traffic_speed:traffic_speed,
                                   ego_to_congestion_dist:ego_to_congestion_dist,
                                   gen_ego_speed_at_start:acc_cruise_speed)

    ego_overlap: in ego_approach_congestion.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lat_in1: lateral(distance:outer.overlap_dist, line:center, at: all)
        override(lat_in1, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_1_overlap: in ego_approach_congestion.drive_vehicle_1_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lat_in2: lateral(distance:0m, line:  center, at: all)
        override(lat_in2, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_2_overlap: in ego_approach_congestion.drive_vehicle_2_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lat_in3: lateral(distance:0m, line:  center, at: all)
        override(lat_in3, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_3_overlap: in ego_approach_congestion.drive_vehicle_3_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lat_in4: lateral(distance:0m, line:  center, at: all)
        override(lat_in4, run_mode: best_effort)
                    
    in ego_approach_congestion.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        speed_in: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at:end)
        override(speed_in, run_mode: best_effort)
    override(ego_approach_congestion.intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_post, 
        run_mode: disable)
    override(ego_approach_congestion.intent_assist_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_post, 
        run_mode: disable)
    override(ego_approach_congestion.intent_assist_vehicle_3_keep_speed_at_post, 
        run_mode: disable)

    car: vehicle with:
        keep(it.policy.may_exceed_legal_speed == true)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/lead_vehicle/lead_vehicle_and_stop/lead_vehicle_and_stop_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/adas/ACC/scenarios/common/activate_acc/activate_acc_top.osc"

extend sut.acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop:
    sce_func_kind: sce_func_kind with: keep(it == acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop)
    cover(sce_func_kind, expression: sce_func_kind, event: start)

    overlap_fraction: overlap_fraction
    keep(overlap == overlap_fraction.overlap)
    
    overlap_dist: length with:
        keep(it==overlap_fraction.overlap_fraction())

    do acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop: serial():
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
            intent_ego_activate_acc_at_phase_essence: sut.car.activate_acc(requested_acc_cruise_speed:acc_cruise_speed)
            drive_lead_vehicle_drive_at_pahse_essence: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_phase_essence: speed([1..5]kph, faster_than: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_position_at_phase_essence:position(time: acc_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle, ahead_of: sut.car, at:start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)

        lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence: lead_vehicle_and_stop(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle) with:
            keep(it.lead_vehicle_at_essence.gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start <= acc_cruise_speed)
    
    ego_overlap_1: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.lead_vehicle_at_essence.drive_ego_at_essence_approaching with:
        control_ego_lateral_at_essence_approaching: lateral(distance:outer.overlap_dist, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_ego_lateral_at_essence_approaching, run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approaching: keep_speed()
        override(intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approaching, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_overlap_1: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.lead_vehicle_at_essence.drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_approaching with:
        control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approaching: lateral(distance:0m, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approaching, run_mode: best_effort)
    ego_overlap_2: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.drive_ego_at_slow_to_stop with:
        control_ego_lateral_at_slow_to_stop: lateral(distance: outer.overlap_dist, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_ego_lateral_at_slow_to_stop, run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_slow_to_stop: keep_speed()
        override(intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_slow_to_stop,run_mode:best_effort)
    ego_overlap_3: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.drive_ego_at_still_stop with:
        control_ego_lateral_at_still_stop: lateral(distance:outer.overlap_dist, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_ego_lateral_at_still_stop, run_mode: best_effort)
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_still_stop: keep_speed()
        override(intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_still_stop, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_overlap_2: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.drive_lead_vehicle_at_slow_to_stop with:
        control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_slow_to_stop: lateral(distance:0m, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_slow_to_stop, run_mode: best_effort)
    lead_vehicle_overlap_3: in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.drive_lead_vehicle_at_still_stop with:
        control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_still_stop: lateral(distance:0m, line:center, at: all)
        override(control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_still_stop, run_mode: best_effort)
    in lead_vehicle_and_stop_at_essence.drive_ego_at_still_stop with:
        intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_still_stop: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

    car: vehicle with:
        keep(it.policy.may_exceed_legal_speed == true)

    # acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop_test scenario implementation
# scenario invokes serially ego warm up, acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop and then the post scenarios
extend sut.acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle_family_base_ego_warm_up(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop scenario
        phase_scenario: acc_lead_vehicle_and_stop(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_post: lead_vehicle_family_base_post(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        fraction: [80..90], force_on_road: true)

    ego_to_lead_vehicle_time_gap_tolerance:time

    diff_speed: speed
    keep(default diff_speed in [-10..10]kph)


    do acc_ego_drive_to_traffic_with_lead_vehicle:parallel(overlap:equal):

            activate_acc_phase: parallel(overlap:equal):
                ego_acc_activate: sut.car.activate_acc(requested_acc_cruise_speed: acc_cruise_speed)

                    lane(same_as: sut.car)

                    lead_vehicle_end_pos: position(time: ego_to_lead_vehicle_time_gap, ahead_of: sut.car, at: end,
                                                track: projected, run_mode: best_effort)
                                                #time_tolerance:ego_to_lead_vehicle_time_gap_tolerance)
            parallel(overlap: equal):
                ego_drive: sut.car.drive(duration: [4..8]s) with:
                    ego_lane: lane(leftmost: true)
                    override(ego_lane, run_mode: best_effort)
                    ego_cruise_speed: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    override(ego_cruise_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                    keep_lane()
                    lead_vehicle_change_speed: speed(speed: diff_speed, slower_than: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)

        keep(it.policy.may_exceed_legal_speed == true)

extend sut.iacc_ego_with_lead_vehicle_on_road_with_speed_sign:

    keep(road_with_higher_legal_speed_limit.speed_limit > road_with_lower_legal_speed_limit.speed_limit)
    keep(default driver_defined_speed == road_with_lower_legal_speed_limit.speed_limit)
    # driver should not take over and bypass in case lead vehicle slows
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.speed_adaptation_behavior.enable == false)
    do iacc_ego_with_lead_vehicle_on_road_with_speed_sign: serial():
        # Turn on ACC.
        sut.car.press_ACC_main_button()
    
        vehicles_drive_before_speed_sign: parallel(overlap:equal):
            ego_drive_at_start: sut.car.drive() with:
                along(road_with_higher_legal_speed_limit,at:start)
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
            lead_vehicle_drive_start: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                position(distance: distance_between_ego_and_lead_vehicle, ahead_of:sut.car, at:start)
                speed(lead_vehicle_speed, tolerance: 5kph, at:end)
        with: duration(10s)

        # Start ACC.
        slif_mode_on: sut.car.press_ACC_set_button(use_road_speed_limit: true)
        cruising: parallel(overlap:equal):
            ego_cruise: sut.car.drive() with:
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
            lead_vehicle_cruise: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                lane(same_as:sut.car,run_mode:best_effort)
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
        with: duration([5..10]s)

        vehicles_drive_after_speed_sign: parallel(overlap:equal):
            ego_drive_on_speed_sign_road: sut.car.drive() with: 
                along(road_with_lower_legal_speed_limit,at:start, run_mode:best_effort)
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
            lead_vehicle_drive_on_speed_sign_road: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                a1: along(road_with_lower_legal_speed_limit, at:start)
                lane(same_as:sut.car,run_mode:best_effort)
                keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                override(a1, run_mode: best_effort)
        with: duration(10s)

        keep(it == 2m)

        changing_multiple_lane_vehicle_lane == 3 and initial_lane_change == \
        left and final_lane_change == right)
    keep(turn_signal_state == left_on => ego_lane == 3 and \
        changing_multiple_lane_vehicle_lane == 1 and initial_lane_change == \
        right and final_lane_change == left)

extend sut.esa_ego_with_stationary_objects_on_path:

    turn_sign_value: int
    keep( ego_turning_side == left => turn_sign_value == 1)
    keep( ego_turning_side == right => turn_sign_value == -1)
    # for separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: esa_ego_with_stationary_objects_on_path_kind
    keep(default kind == esa_ego_with_stationary_objects_on_path)

    esa_turn_shape: esa_turn_shape with:
        keep(it.ego_speed_during_shape == ego_speed)
        keep(it.shape_psi == ego_turning_angle)
        keep(it.shape_radius==radius)
        keep(it.ego_shape_duration == time_offset_to_trigger_esa)
        keep(it.ego_turning_side == turn_sign_value)

    esa_off_road_coord: esa_off_road_coord with:
        keep(it.angle_between_ego_and_object == object_yaw)
        keep(it.object_width == stationed_objects.get_width())
        keep(it.object_length == stationed_objects.get_length())
        keep(it.relative_speed_between_ego_and_object == ego_speed)
        keep(default it.safe_acceleration == 3mpsps)

    keep(default overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object == 100)
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        ((sut.car.get_width())*overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object*0.01)-
        ((esa_off_road_coord.overlap_offset_coord() + sut.car.get_width())/2)))
   

    top.position_along_drive(object_position,
        ego_drive_at_start,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: (ego_time_gap_to_object_before_turn*ego_speed))

    do esa_ego_with_stationary_objects_on_path: parallel(overlap: equal):
        ego_drive: serial():
            esa_ego_on: sut.car.request_ESA_mode(state: active)
            ego_drive_at_start: sut.car.drive() with:
                avoid_collisions(false)
                speed(ego_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                along(ego_drive_path, run_mode: best_effort)
                along(road_curvature, run_mode: best_effort)
                lane(lane_num, from: curb)
            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

        stationary_object_position: stationed_objects.exists_at(object_position) with:
            rotation(roll: object_roll,
                    yaw: object_yaw,
                    pitch: object_pitch)
    with: duration([10..20]s, tolerance: 3s)

enum esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path_kind : [
    esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path, 
    esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path_and_neighbor_in_fda, 
    esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path_and_neighbor_in_sda, 
    esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path_and_neighbors] 

extend sut.esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path:

    turn_sign_value: int
    keep(ego_turning_side == left => turn_sign_value == 1)
    keep(ego_turning_side == right => turn_sign_value == -1)
    
    # for separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path_kind 
    keep(default kind == esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path)

    esa_off_road_coord: esa_off_road_coord with:
        keep(it.ego_to_object_distance == distance_for_object_to_travel_till_crossing_ego)
        keep(it.angle_between_ego_and_object == object_entering_angle)
        keep(it.object_width == stationed_objects.get_width())
        keep(it.object_length == stationed_objects.get_length())
        keep(it.relative_speed_between_ego_and_object == ego_speed)
        keep(default it.safe_acceleration == 3mpsps)

 
    keep(default overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object == 50)
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        ((sut.car.get_width())*overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object*0.01)-
        ((esa_off_road_coord.overlap_offset_coord() + sut.car.get_width())/2)))
    keep(object_lat_distance_from_ego == esa_off_road_coord.lat_offset_coord())
    keep(object_lon_distance_from_ego == esa_off_road_coord.lon_offset_coord())

    top.position_along_drive(object_position_start,
        ego_drive_at_start,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: -(object_lat_distance_from_ego),
        lon_offset: object_lon_distance_from_ego)

    top.position_along_drive(object_position_end,
        ego_drive_at_start,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: object_lon_distance_to_ego)

    esa_turn_shape: esa_turn_shape with:
        keep(it.ego_speed_during_shape == ego_speed)
        keep(it.shape_psi == ego_turning_angle)
        keep(it.shape_radius==radius)
        keep(it.ego_shape_duration == time_offset_to_trigger_esa)
        keep(it.ego_turning_side == turn_sign_value)


    do esa_ego_drive_with_plain_object_crossing_path: parallel(overlap: equal):
        ego_drive: serial():
            esa_ego_on: sut.car.request_ESA_mode(state: active)
            ego_initial_drive: sut.car.drive(duration:[1..3]s) with:
                avoid_collisions(false)
            ego_drive_at_start: sut.car.drive() with:
                avoid_collisions(false)
                speed(ego_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                along(ego_drive_path)
                along(road_curvature, run_mode: best_effort)
                lane(lane_num, from: curb)
            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

        plain_object_movement_path: serial():
            end_pos: stationed_objects.move(
                object_position_end, 
                start_position: object_position_start) with:
                rotation(yaw: (180degree - object_entering_angle))
    with: duration([10..30]s)

            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

            end_pos: stationed_objects.move(
                    object_position_end, 
                    start_position: object_position_start)

enum esa_ego_with_oncoming_object_kind : [
    esa_ego_with_oncoming_object, 
    esa_ego_with_oncoming_object_and_neighbor_in_fda, 
    esa_ego_with_oncoming_object_and_neighbor_in_sda, 
    esa_ego_with_oncoming_object_and_neighbors] 

extend sut.esa_ego_with_oncoming_object:

    turn_sign_value: int
    keep( ego_turning_side == left => turn_sign_value == 1)
    keep( ego_turning_side == right => turn_sign_value == -1)
    
    # for separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: esa_ego_with_oncoming_object_kind
    keep(default kind == esa_ego_with_oncoming_object)

    keep(default overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object == 100)
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        (stationed_objects.get_width()/2)*
        overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object/100) - 
        (stationed_objects.get_width()/2))
    

    esa_turn_shape: esa_turn_shape with:
        keep(it.ego_speed_during_shape == ego_speed)
        keep(it.shape_psi == ego_turning_angle)
        keep(it.shape_radius==radius)
        keep(it.ego_shape_duration == time_offset_to_trigger_esa)
        keep(it.ego_turning_side == turn_sign_value)

    
    esa_off_road_coord: esa_off_road_coord with:
        keep(it.relative_speed_between_ego_and_object == ego_speed)
        keep(default it.safe_acceleration == 3mpsps)

    top.position_along_drive(object_position_start,
        ego_drive_at_start,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: (time_to_travel_for_object*ego_speed))

    top.position_along_drive(object_position_end,
        ego_drive_at_start,
        path_fraction: path_fraction,
        lat_offset: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object,
        lon_offset: (ego_time_gap_to_object_before_turn*ego_speed))

    event arrival is @ego_drive_at_start.start
    do esa_ego_with_oncoming_object: parallel(overlap: equal):
        ego_drive: serial():
            esa_ego_on: sut.car.request_ESA_mode(state: active)
            ego_drive_at_start: sut.car.drive() with:
                avoid_collisions(false)
                s1: speed(ego_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                along(ego_drive_path)
                lane(lane_num, from: curb)
            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

        plain_object_movement_path: serial():
            end_pos: stationed_objects.move(
                object_position_end, 
                start_position: object_position_start) with:
                rotation(yaw: 180degree)
    with: duration([10..30]s)

    esa_ego_with_lead_vehicle_and_neighbors] 


extend sut.esa_ego_with_lead_vehicle:

    turn_sign_value: int
    keep( ego_turning_side == left => turn_sign_value == 1)
    keep( ego_turning_side == right => turn_sign_value == -1)

    # for separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: esa_ego_with_lead_vehicle_kind 
    keep(default kind == esa_ego_with_lead_vehicle)

    keep(default overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object == 100)
    keep(overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object == (
        (lead_vehicle.get_width()/2)*
        overlap_percentage_between_ego_and_object/100) -
        (lead_vehicle.get_width()/2))

    esa_turn_shape: esa_turn_shape with:
        keep(it.ego_speed_during_shape == ego_speed)
        keep(it.shape_psi == ego_turning_angle)
        keep(it.shape_radius == radius)
        keep(it.ego_shape_duration == time_offset_to_trigger_esa)
        keep(it.ego_turning_side == turn_sign_value)

    esa_off_road_coord: esa_off_road_coord with:
        keep(it.relative_speed_between_ego_and_object == ego_speed)
        keep(default it.safe_acceleration == 3mpsps)

    do esa_ego_with_lead_vehicle: parallel(overlap: equal):
        ego_drive: serial():
            esa_ego_on: sut.car.request_ESA_mode(state: active)
            ego_drive_at_start: sut.car.drive() with:
                avoid_collisions(false)
                speed(ego_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                lane(lane_num, from: curb)
            ego_drive_with_shape: sut.car.drive() with:
                p1: position(time : ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_before_turn, 
                    behind: lead_vehicle, time_tolerance: 1s, at: start)
                shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: esa_turn_shape)

        lead_vehicle_drive: serial():
            lead_vehicle_drive_start: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                speed(lead_vehicle_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                lateral(distance: overlap_distance_between_ego_and_object, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                along(ego_drive_path)
                along(road_curvature, run_mode: best_effort)
    with: duration([10..30]s)

    road_container: constrained_road_curvature

    keep(soft road_container.min_radius_lb == 50meter)
    keep(soft road_container.max_radius_ub == 1500meter)

    start_lat_offset: length with:

        keep(it.shape_v_lat == lat_speed)
        keep(it.shape_psi == psi)

            sut.car.turn_signal(turn_signal_state: driver_signal)

                driver_controls(steering: disabled)
                keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                duration([3..6]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            s3: speed(gvt_speed)
            override(s3, run_mode: best_effort)
            along(opp_road.opposite, end_offset: offset, at: end)
            lane(1, from: center)
            l2: lateral(distance: 1.5m, line: left)
            override(l2, run_mode: best_effort)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend sut.alca_free_drive_with_slow_neighbors:

    # Keep lane behavioral model is set for the car group following
    # slow neighbor_vehicle and speed is set as neighbor_vehicle_speed
    dm: ftx_group_driver_model
    
    # Prevent cars from switching lanes
    keep(dm.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    keep(dm.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(default dm.target_speed in neighbor_vehicle_speed)
    for car in car_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == dm)
 
    # Slow neighbor_vehicle side
    neighbor_vehicle_side: av_side

    on @start: neighbor_vehicle_speed_actual = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed

    # The slow neighbor vehicles should be placed on the same direction where 
    # turn_signal_state is getting triggered.
    keep(alca_free_drive_phase.turn_signal_state == left_on => neighbor_vehicle_side == left)
    keep(alca_free_drive_phase.turn_signal_state == right_on => neighbor_vehicle_side == right)
    keep(default ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.drive_duration in [5..20]s)
    do alca_free_drive_with_slow_neighbors: parallel(overlap: equal):

        # In alca_free_drive_phase and ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase
        # ego moves with ACC, LCA on.
        # The neighbor_vehicle with car_group behind it travels 
        # in turn_signal_state direction
        # of ego. The ego tries to change the lane where 
        # slow neighbor_vehicle with its car_group is moving.
        alca_free_drive_phase: alca_free_drive() with:
            keep(it.activate_alca_phase.adjacent_vehicle == \
                ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.neighbor_vehicle)
        ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase: ego_drive_and_neighbor(neighbor_vehicle: 
            neighbor_vehicle, gen_neighbor_vehicle_side: neighbor_vehicle_side) with:
            keep(it.gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed == self.neighbor_vehicle_speed)
        car_group_drive: car_group.group_drive()

    in ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence with:
        override_intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence: \
            override(intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence, run_mode: best_effort)
        override_intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence: \
            override(intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence, run_mode: best_effort)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/lead_vehicle/lead_vehicle/lead_vehicle_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/ego_drive_and_neighbor/ego_drive_and_neighbor_top.osc"
import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/sumo/builtin/sumo_builtin_bme.osc"
import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/sumo/common/sumo_demo_profiles.osc"

scenario sut.alca_lead_vehicle_with_slow_neighbors:

    # Slow neighbor_vehicle attributes
    slow_neighbor_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [10..60]kph)
    neighbor_vehicle: vehicle

    # Normal keep lane behavioral model is set for the car group following
    # slow neighbor_vehicle and speed is set as slow_neighbor_vehicle_speed
    dm: sumo_idm_driver_model
    keep(default dm.idm_driver_kind == normal_keep_lane)
    keep(dm.speed_mode.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(default dm.speed_mode.target_speed == slow_neighbor_vehicle_speed)
    for car in car_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == dm)
    car_group: single_lane_car_group with(reference_car: neighbor_vehicle):
        keep(it.cars.size() == 2)

    # ACC cruise speed
    acc_cruise_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_cruise_speed_range)
    
    # Turn signal state attribute
    turn_signal_state: turn_signal_state
    keep(default turn_signal_state == left_on)

    # Road attribute
    road_lanes: one_way_road with:
        keep(road_lanes.min_lanes >= 3)

extend sut.alca_lead_vehicle_with_slow_neighbors:

    # Slow neighbor_vehicle side
    neighbor_vehicle_side: av_side

    # The slow neighbor vehicles should be placed on the same direction where 
    # turn_signal_state is getting triggered.
    keep(alca_lead_vehicle_phase.turn_signal_state == left_on => neighbor_vehicle_side == left)
    keep(alca_lead_vehicle_phase.turn_signal_state == right_on => neighbor_vehicle_side == right)

    # Duration specified 
    keep(default ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.drive_duration in [5..25]s)
    keep(default ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_thw_to_ego_at_start in [-5..5]s)
    keep(default ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_thw_to_ego_at_end in [0..10]s)

    do alca_lead_vehicle_with_slow_neighbors: parallel(overlap: equal):

        # In alca_lead_vehicle_phase and ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase
        # ego moves with ACC, LCA on. The lead vehicle moves in same
        # lane of ego. The neighbor_vehicle with car_group behind 
        # it travels in turn_signal_state direction
        # of ego. The ego tries to change the lane where 
        # slow neighbor_vehicle with its car_group is moving.
        alca_lead_vehicle_phase: alca_lead_vehicle() with:
            keep(it.activate_alca_phase.adjacent_vehicle == \
                ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.neighbor_vehicle)
        ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase: ego_drive_and_neighbor(neighbor_vehicle: 
            neighbor_vehicle, gen_neighbor_vehicle_side: neighbor_vehicle_side, 
                gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed: slow_neighbor_vehicle_speed)
        car_group.group_drive()

    override_intent_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: \
        override(ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.intent_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_start, run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence: \
        override(ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence, run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence: \
        override(ego_drive_and_neighbor_phase.intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence, run_mode: best_effort)

extend vehicle.activate_alca:

    do activate_alca: serial():
        
        # Before requesting ACC and LCA on pre drive of [2..4]s with cruise 
        # speed is given
        acc_pre_drive: sut.car.drive(duration: [2..4]s) with:
            cruise_speed_at_pre_drive: speed(acc_cruise_speed, at: end, 
                tolerance: acc_tolerance)
            override(cruise_speed_at_pre_drive, run_mode: best_effort)
        
        # ACC and LCA to turned on. ACC is provided with set_speed of 
        # acc_cruise_speed

        acc_on: \
            sut.car.request_ACC_on(cruise_speed: acc_cruise_speed)
        lca_on: sut.car.request_LCA_on()
        
        # The initial_drive before turning ALCA on. ego drives with 
        # set cruise speed
        initial_drive: sut.car.drive(duration: [2..5]second) with:
            speed(acc_cruise_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
            along(ego_drive_road)
            along(road_lanes)
            lane(2)
        
        # ALCA turned on
        alca_on: sut.car.request_ALCA_on()

        # The pre drive after turning ALCA on with acc_cruise_speed
        alca_pre_drive: sut.car.drive(duration: [0.2..3]second) with:
            speed(acc_cruise_speed, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.lca_lead_vehicle_lane_hugger:
    # Default values of 0meter to be able to keep the values unconstrained.
    # Pass down constraints to the road element only when these are externally
    # constrained to a non-zero value
    keep(default min_road_radius == 0meter)
    keep(default max_road_radius == 0meter)

    keep((min_road_radius > 0meter) => curved_road.min_radius >= min_road_radius)
    keep((max_road_radius > 0meter) => curved_road.max_radius <= max_road_radius)

    lead_vehicle: vehicle
    do lca_lead_vehicle_lane_hugger: serial:
        LCA_on: sut.car.request_LCA_on()

            keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == lca_cruise_speed)

                ego_road_at_end: along(curved_road, end_offset: [20..50]m, at: end)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sut::ego_passing_parked_vehicles
# In this scenario, Ego is passing parked vehicles 
# Configurable parameters: distance_between_parked_vehicles, lateral_distance_between_ego_and_parked_vehicles

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/common/metrics_checks/ego_standstill_watcher.osc"

extend sut.ego_passing_parked_vehicles:

    max_time_ego_stops: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)
    watcher standstill_watcher is standstill_watcher(vehicle: sut.car,
        standstill_threshold: 3.5kph, max_interval_time :max_time_ego_stops)

    ego_distance_to_parked_vehicles_after_passing: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
    event ego_stops_for_max_time is @standstill_watcher.i_end if \
        (standstill_watcher.data.end_time - standstill_watcher.data.start_time \
        >= max_time_ego_stops)
    
    event ego_passes_objects is @clk if \
        sut.car.road_distance_to_global_coordinates(left_parked_vehicle.objects[gen_number_of_parked_vehicles-1].state.global_position.coord, center, lon, lane) < \
            -ego_distance_to_parked_vehicles_after_passing


     
    left_parked_vehicle: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(default it.objects.size() == gen_number_of_parked_vehicles)
        keep(it.objects_kind == stationary_vehicle)
        
    right_parked_vehicle: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(default it.objects.size() == gen_number_of_parked_vehicles)
        keep(it.objects_kind == stationary_vehicle)

    lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles : length with:
        keep(it == 10m + gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        
    left_parked_vehicle_position: msp_position
    right_parked_vehicle_position: msp_position

    left_parked_vehicle_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset == gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset == gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.min_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
    
    right_parked_vehicle_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset == -gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset == -gen_ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.min_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects == gen_distance_between_parked_vehicles)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_road(\
        left_parked_vehicle_position_params,left_parked_vehicle,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: parked_vehicle_lon_offset,leftmost_lane: true)
    
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_road(\
        right_parked_vehicle_position_params,right_parked_vehicle,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: parked_vehicle_lon_offset,rightmost_lane: true)

    # The road should be long enough to accommodate the parked vehicles plus a buffer at start and end
    keep(road_with_lanes.length > (distance_to_first_parked_vehicle*2 + \
        lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles * \
        gen_number_of_parked_vehicles))


    on @phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.start:
        number_of_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle.objects.size()
        number_of_parked_vehicles_right = right_parked_vehicle.objects.size()

        # Checking only minimum values of each group because min and max are equal, so every obj must be at a constant distance from each other
        distance_between_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it < result ? it : result)
        distance_between_parked_vehicles_right = right_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it < result ? it : result)

        # Checking only minimum values of each group because min and max are equal, so every obj must be at a constant lat_offset from Ego
        # Getting math.abs from right vehicle group because their offset is -1 * the constant we're sampling 
        ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles_left = left_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_lat_offset.reduce(it < result ? it : result)
        ego_lat_distance_to_parked_vehicles_right = math.abs(right_parked_vehicle_position_params.each_lat_offset.reduce(it < result ? it : result))


    do phase_essence: first_of:
        ego_passing_parked_vehicles: serial():

            phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: lane(middle: true, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: along(road_with_lanes, 
                        start_offset: ego_longitudinal_position_on_road_at_start,
                        at: start)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_end: along(road_with_lanes, 
                        start_offset: distance_to_first_parked_vehicle * 4 +\
                             lon_distance_between_left_parked_vehicles * \
                             gen_number_of_parked_vehicles, tolerance: 60m,
                            at: end)
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    # best effort for lateral as Ego might try to bypass the vehicles with a different
                    # lateral offset
                    intent_assist_ego_lateral_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_start: lateral(distance: ego_lateral_offset_at_start, line:left, at:start, run_mode: best_effort)

                left_parked_vehicle_at_essence: left_parked_vehicle.group_exists(
                    left_parked_vehicle_position_params)
                right_parked_vehicle_at_essence: right_parked_vehicle.group_exists(
                    right_parked_vehicle_position_params)
                                        
            with:
                intent_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_1: serial():
            wait @ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("Ending the scenario as Ego was standing still for > $(max_time_ego_stops)")

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_2: serial():
            wait @ego_passes_objects
            log_info("Ending the scenario as Ego passed by the parked vehicles")

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/common/metrics_checks/ego_standstill_watcher.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects/vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects_top.osc"

extend sut.vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects_with_traffic: 
    # Ego complete stand_still time
    max_time_ego_stops: time with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_stand_still_time)

    watcher standstill_watcher is standstill_watcher(vehicle: sut.car,
        standstill_threshold: 0kph, max_interval_time :max_time_ego_stops)

    event ego_stops_for_max_time is @standstill_watcher.i_end if \
        ((standstill_watcher.data.end_time - standstill_watcher.data.start_time) >= max_time_ego_stops)
    
    event clock is (sut.car.state != null)

    var last_vehicle: int
    keep(last_vehicle == gen_number_of_adjacent_traffic_group_vehicles-1)

    # Bypassing distance between Ego and object after which scenario will end
    ego_bypassing_object_end_distance : length with:
        keep(default it == 5m)
    
    var ego_bypassed_bool: bool = false

    # Condition to end scenario once Ego passes object
    event ego_bypassed is @clock if ego_bypassed_bool==true
        
    on @top.clk:
        if sut.car.road_distance(to_object: \
            vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence.stationary_object_group.\
            objects[last_vehicle],reference: closest, to_reference: closest,
            direction: lon, route_type: road) < -ego_bypassing_object_end_distance:
                set ego_bypassed_bool = true
    
    # adjacent_traffic_group with normal_driver_model
    normal_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    keep(normal_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(normal_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    
    keep(normal_driver_model.target_speed == \
        vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence.\
        vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_at_essence_vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_objects.gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed)

    keep(adjacent_traffic_group.cars.size() == 
        gen_number_of_adjacent_traffic_group_vehicles)

    keep(adjacent_traffic_group.reference_car_index == 0)

    for car in adjacent_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_safety_distance_lon)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_response_time == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_min_response_time)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.\
            lon_ca_cautious_factor == \
            gen_adjacent_traffic_group_lon_ca_cautious_factor)
 
    for params in adjacent_traffic_group.members_params:
        keep(params.min_initial_ttc == gen_adjacent_traffic_group_min_initial_ttc)




    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_traffic: parallel(overlap: equal):
            vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence: vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

            traffic_at_essence: adjacent_traffic_group.group_drive() 
        
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_1: serial:
            wait @ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("$(self): Ending the scenario as Ego was standing still for > $(max_time_ego_stops)s.")
        
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_2: serial:
            wait @ego_bypassed
            log_info("Ending the scenario: Ego did bypass")

    override(vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_object_at_essence.\
        vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_at_essence_vehicle_driving_next_to_ego_with_objects.\
        intent_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_accompany, run_mode: best_effort)

    on @start:
        number_of_adjacent_traffic_group_vehicles = adjacent_traffic_group.cars.size()
        
        # Sampling values from first member_param only as all cars receive the same exact parameters
        adjacent_traffic_group_min_initial_ttc = adjacent_traffic_group.members_params[0].min_initial_ttc
        
        # Sampling values from first car only as all cars receive the same exact parameters
        adjacent_traffic_group_safety_distance_lon = adjacent_traffic_group.cars[0].ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon
        adjacent_traffic_group_min_response_time = adjacent_traffic_group.cars[0].ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_response_time
        adjacent_traffic_group_lon_ca_cautious_factor = adjacent_traffic_group.cars[0].ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.lon_ca_cautious_factor

extend sut.mix_ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_with_stationary_object:
      top.position_along_drive(stationary_object_position,
        ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles,
        path_fraction: ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.parked_vehicle_path_fraction,
        lat_offset: gen_stationary_object_lat_pos,
        lon_offset: gen_stationary_object_lon_pos)
      
      var start_time_of_ego_drive_phase: time
      var ego_drive_phase_duration: time
      var lon_offset_calculated: length
      var ego_drive_phase_start: bool = sample(true, @ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.start)
      var ego_drive_phase_end: bool = sample(true, @ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.end)
      var stop_sampling: bool = false
      event ego_drive_phase_is_active is @top.clk if ego_drive_phase_start and not ego_drive_phase_end and not stop_sampling
      event ego_drive_phase_end_event is @ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.end

      on @start:
        ego_drive_phase_duration = ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.duration

      on @ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles.start: # starts right after drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles's event ends
        start_time_of_ego_drive_phase = top.time

      on @ego_drive_phase_is_active:
        if top.time >= start_time_of_ego_drive_phase + (ego_drive_phase_duration * ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence.parked_vehicle_path_fraction / 100):
          lon_offset_calculated = stationary_object_position.lane_position.lon_offset - sut.car.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lon_offset 
          stop_sampling = true

          stationary_object_lat_pos = stationary_object_position.lane_position.lat_offset
          stationary_object_lon_pos = lon_offset_calculated
      
      
      do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
        
            ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles_at_essence: ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles()
            stationary_object_at_essence: stationary_object.exists_at(stationary_object_position)

        min_distance_between_vehicles = parked_vehicles_positon_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it < result ? it : result)
        max_distance_between_vehicles = parked_vehicles_positon_params.each_distance_between_objects.reduce(it > result ? it : result)

        ego_drive_by_parked_vehicles: serial ():

            phase_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: parallel(overlap: equal):

                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                parked_vehicles_exists: parked_vehicles.group_exists(parked_vehicles_positon_params)
            with: 
                intent_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_ego_drive_with_parked_vehicles)

                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_by_the_parked_vehicles: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_by_the_parked_vehicles: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_1: serial():
            wait @ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("Ending the scenario as Ego was standing still for > $(max_time_ego_stops)")

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_2: serial():
            wait @ego_passes_objects

#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:

extend vehicle:

    keep(ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_safety_speed_lat == 0.00)

extend sut.vehicle_lane_hugger:

    #  For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)
    position_tolerance: length
    keep(default position_tolerance == 3m)
    speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)
    keep(gen_lane_hugger_side == left => gen_vehicle_closing_in_from_side == right)
    keep(gen_lane_hugger_side == right => gen_vehicle_closing_in_from_side == left)

    do phase_essence: serial():
            
        phase_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lane_hugger_vehicle_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: lane_hugger_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_lane_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_lane_hugger_side, at: start)
                intent_assist_lane_hugger_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_position_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start: position(distance: [gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego..gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego], ahead_of: sut.car, tolerance: position_tolerance, measure_by: nearest, at: start)
                intent_assist_lane_hugger_vehicle_position_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_end: position(distance: [gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego..gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego], 
                    ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start: lateral(distance: gen_vehicle_approaching_ego_lateral_distance, line: center, at: start)
                intent_assist_lane_hugger_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_end: lateral(distance: gen_vehicle_approaching_ego_lateral_distance, line: gen_vehicle_closing_in_from_side, at: end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_speed_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start: speed(gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start, tolerance: speed_tolerance)  # Since otherwise lateral move is limited
        with:
            intent_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego) # To overcome slowdowns such as in curves
        emit ego_lane_change_event   
        phase_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lane_hugger_vehicle_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: lane_hugger_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_lane_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_lane_hugger_side)
                intent_assist_lane_hugger_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lane_hugger_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego_end: lateral(distance: gen_vehicle_approaching_ego_lateral_distance, line: gen_vehicle_closing_in_from_side, at: end, tolerance: 0.5m)
                # This will make the plan ask the sut to proceed together with the vehicle
                intent_assist_lane_hugger_vehicle_position_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego_end: position(distance: \
                    [gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego..gen_lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego], \
                        ahead_of: sut.car, tolerance: position_tolerance, \
                            measure_by: nearest, \
                                at: end, \
                                    run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego)


    on @start:
        lane_hugger_vehicle_speed_at_start = lane_hugger_vehicle.state.speed


    lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego_record: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: minimum)
    lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego_record: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: maximum)

    event phase_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start_event is @phase_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego.start

    on @phase_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego_start_event:
        if (sut.car.road_distance(lane_hugger_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) < 0m):
            lane_hugger_side = right
        if (sut.car.road_distance(lane_hugger_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) > 0m):
            lane_hugger_side = left

        vehicle_closing_in_from_side = lane_hugger_side == right ? left : right

        vehicle_approaching_ego_lateral_distance = lane_hugger_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset

        lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))
        lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))

    on @phase_essence_vehicle_approaching_ego.end:
        lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))
        lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))

    on @phase_essence_vehicle_driving_closely_to_ego.end:
        lane_hugger_vehicle_min_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))
        lane_hugger_vehicle_max_distance_to_ego_record.add_sample(lane_hugger_vehicle.road_distance(sut.car, closest_compound, closest_compound, lon, road))

# In this  scenario a neighbor_vehicle is overtaking the 
# `Ego` on an adjacent lane. During the overtake the `neighbor_vehicle` can change it's velocity, 
#  can overtake while braking the speed limit, can overtake 
#  where overtaking is not allowed and can optionally
#  perform a lateral swirling
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_ego_speed_at_start - Speed of Ego
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start - Speed of neighbor_vehicle relative to Ego at start
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end - Speed of neighbor_vehicle relative to Ego at end
#    . gen_leading_time_neighbor - Leading time gap of Neighbor Vehicle from Ego  
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver - The neighbor_vehicle maneuvers either with or without swirl. This
#      will set the gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude to 0m if it is without_swirl and
#      gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude as greater than 0m if it is with_swirl.
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude - Amplitude of the neighbor_vehicle parameter should be 0m or

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/adjacent_vehicles_family_base/adjacent_vehicles_family_base_top.osc"

enum neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type: [without_swirl, with_swirl]

        inherits adjacent_vehicles_family_base(with_swirl == true):

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl")
    # The neighbor_vehicle maneuver either with_swirl or without swirl
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_maneuver", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver: neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type with:
        keep(default it in [with_swirl, without_swirl])
    var neighbor_vehicle_maneuver: neighbor_vehicle_maneuver_type
    # The gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude will be 0m if
    # gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver is without_swirl
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver == (without_swirl) => \
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude == 0m) and 
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start == 0s) and
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end == 0s))

    # The gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude will greater 0m if
    # gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver is with_swirl
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_maneuver == (with_swirl) => \
        (gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude > 0m))

    # The neighbor_vehicle speed parameters
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl: speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_approach_start.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start : speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)
    var neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start : speed

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end: speed with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_speed_range)   
    var neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end: speed
    
    leading_distance_ego: length
    keep(default leading_distance_ego in [-7..7]m)

    # The neighbor_vehicle time gap from the Ego
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_approach_end.leading_time_neighbor", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_leading_time_neighbor")
    gen_leading_time_neighbor: time
    keep(default gen_leading_time_neighbor in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    var leading_time_neighbor: time
    
    # The neighbor_vehicle side relative to Ego
    keep(gen_neighbor_vehicle_side in [right,left])

    # The neighbor_vehicle swirling parameters
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude: length with:
        keep(default it == 1m)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude: length

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start: time with:
        keep(default it == 3s)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start: time
    
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end.neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl.start.gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end")
    gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end: time with:
        keep(default it == 3s)
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end: time

    swirl_shape_duration: time
    keep(swirl_shape_duration in [5..7]s)
    lane_section: lane_section

    duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

extend sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl:
    # In this scenario, since we cannot react to the ego's actions during shape, 
    # we assume that ego might accelerate due to the fact it has a free lane
    # since we need to overtake ego, we will add an acceleration delta to shape to endure the swirling
    # vehicle accelerates slightly harder
    neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl: acceleration with:
        keep (default it == 1mpsps) 

    lateral_shift_shape: lateral_shift_shape_ref_vehicle_rel_acc with:
        keep(it.transform == lane_relative)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 20.0)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_start_cpp == 0.5)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_end_cpp == 1.2)
        keep(it.sin_period_start == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start)
        keep(it.sin_period_end == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == neighbor_vehicle)
        keep(it.shape_duration == swirl_shape_duration)
        keep(it.ref_vehicle == sut.car)
        keep(it.rel_acceleration == neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl)
        keep(it.lat_offset == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude)
    do phase_essence: serial():
        # Intial phase - neighbor_vehicle on the adjacent lane of Ego
        emit ego_drive_start
        phase_essence_approach: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_approach: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph], 
                    tolerance: 4kph, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approach: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_approach_start: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_approach: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start, faster_than: sut.car,
                    at: start)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_approach_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, at: start)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_approach: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approach_end: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 0.5m, at: end)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_approach_end: position(time: gen_leading_time_neighbor, \
                    behind: sut.car, at: end, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_approach_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_approach, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_approach)

        # The neighbor_vehicle drives with an optional swirl on the adjacent lane
        phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl, 
                    faster_than: sut.car, at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                # a hint to the planner for the fact that the swirling vehicle will accelerate
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl + \    
                    (neighbor_vehicle_rel_acceleration_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl*swirl_shape_duration), 
                        faster_than: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)    
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_shape_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: shape(quantity: position, request: both, \
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)
                #A hint for planning, making sure that swirl is not happening in junction turns 
                #(otherwise, swirl vehicle gets out of control)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, run_mode: best_effort)

        emit ego_lane_change_event
        # The neighbor_vehicle reaches [10..]m ahead of the Ego
        phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: parallel(overlap: equal): 
            drive_ego_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 1.5m, at: start, \
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end: speed(gen_neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end, 
                    at: end, faster_than: sut.car,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_start: position(distance: [10..]m, tolerance: 2m, ahead_of: sut.car, \
                    at: start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl)

        emit ego_drive_end


    event phase_essence_approach_start is @phase_essence_approach.start
    event phase_essence_approach_end is @phase_essence_approach.end
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl.start
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_active is phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start_bool and not phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl.end
    event phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end is @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl.end

    var phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    var phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end)

    var swirling_period_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    event swirling_period_sample is @top.clk if (not phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end_bool and \ 
        swirling_period_start_bool and neighbor_vehicle.prev_state != null)
    var lat_count : int = 10
    var prev_cycle_time : time
    var start_time : time = sample(top.time, @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start)
    var first_adjusted_lat_offset: length
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period: time

    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: maximum)

    var neighbor_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance: length = 0.1m  
    var neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance : speed = 0.5mps

    neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: standard_deviation)
    neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: maximum)

    def reached_lane_count_record() is:
        # Offset used to ensure negative lateral offsets are avoided
        const avoid_negative_lat_offset : length = 10m
        const lat_offset_tolerance : length = 0.01m
        var current_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        var previous_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.prev_state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        if lat_count == 10: 
            first_adjusted_lat_offset = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
            lat_count = 0
            
        if lat_count == 0 and  math.abs(first_adjusted_lat_offset-current_lat_value) >= lat_offset_tolerance: 
            if current_lat_value > first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = -1
            if current_lat_value < first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = 1
        else:   
            if lat_count == 1 and current_lat_value > previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false  
            elif lat_count == -1 and current_lat_value < previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false

    on @swirling_period_sample:
        call reached_lane_count_record()

    on @phase_essence_approach_start:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed
        if (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) < 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_side = right
        elif (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lat, road) > 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_side = left

    on @phase_essence_approach_end:
        leading_time_neighbor = neighbor_vehicle.get_time_gap(sut.car)

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_start:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_lateral_swirl = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_active:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.add_sample(math.abs(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset))
        neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed.add_sample((math.abs(neighbor_vehicle.state.road_speed.lat)))

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_with_optional_swirl_end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.compute()

        if (neighbor_vehicle_lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.compute() >= neighbor_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance) and (neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed.compute() >= neighbor_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance):
            neighbor_vehicle_maneuver = with_swirl   
        else:
            neighbor_vehicle_maneuver = without_swirl

    on @phase_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl_end:
        neighbor_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_end = neighbor_vehicle.state.speed - sut.car.state.speed

extend vehicle.global_checkers:
    # Deactivate the off-road check, aligning with the intended objective of the scenario.
    override(off_road_checker, run_mode: freeze)


extend sut.vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_ego_warm_up: neighbor_vehicle_family_ego_warm_up(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

        # invoke adjacent_vehicles scenario
        phase_scenario: vehicle_overtaking_ego_with_optional_swirl(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_post: neighbor_vehicle_family_post(neighbor_vehicle: neighbor_vehicle)

    # Main scenario block
    do phase_essence: serial():

                drive_ego_at_essence_approaching: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_essence_approaching_start: speed(\
                        [gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph],

                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approaching: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

                    intent_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_approaching_start: position(time: \
                        gen_ego_time_gap_to_neighbor_vehicle,

                        measure_by: nearest)
                    intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_approaching: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approaching: lateral(gen_neighbor_vehicle_lat_offset, line: center, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                intent_essence_approaching_duration: duration(duration_at_approaching_phase, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_approaching_phase)

            # neighbor_vehicle drives with ego_speed
            phase_essence_accompany: parallel(overlap: equal): 
                drive_ego_at_essence_accompany: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_road_at_essence_accompany: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_road_at_essence_accompany: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_road_at_essence_accompany: along(ego_road, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_accompany: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_accompany: lane(side_of: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_along_at_essence_accompany: along(ego_road, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_accompany: keep_lane()
                    intent_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_accompany: \
                        lateral(gen_neighbor_vehicle_lat_offset, line: center, 
                        tolerance: lateral_tolerance)
                    intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_accompany: \
                        position_behind_ego(distance: gen_neighbor_vehicle_lon_distance)
            with:
                intent_essence_accompany_duration: duration(duration_at_accompany_phase, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_accompany_phase)

    on @phase_essence.start: emit ego_drive_start

    var phase_essence_accompany_start_bool: bool =sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany_start)
    var phase_essence_accompany_end_bool: bool =sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany_end)
    event phase_essence_accompany_start is @phase_essence_accompany.start
    event phase_essence_accompany_active is phase_essence_accompany_start_bool and not phase_essence_accompany_end_bool
    event phase_essence_accompany_end is @phase_essence_accompany.end
    event phase_essence_approaching_start is @phase_essence_approaching.start
    event phase_essence_approaching_end is @phase_essence_approaching.end

    on @phase_essence_approaching_end:

        neighbor_vehicle_lat_offset = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset
