extend sut.vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed:

    time_tolerance: time
    keep(default time_tolerance == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_time_tolerance)
    
    # In behavioral tracking mode, the system searches for the point closest 
    # to the vehicle's current position on the calculated trajectory. The 
    # objective is set based on a point ahead by the look_ahead_time and is 
    # updated either every update_period or when the vehicle reaches the current 
    # objective. This objective is then evaluated by other behaviors in the 
    # driver's stack, such as speed adaptation or collision avoidance. When the 
    # vehicle is within look_ahead_time of the trajectory's end, the final point 
    # becomes the objective.
    keep(neighbor_vehicle.ftx_driver.shape_behavior.tracking_mode == behavioral)

    # The neighbor_vehicle Swirling definition
    # The shape_duration is equal to duration_at_essence_accompany to make swirling 
    # Duration 8s. Use shape_duration value > 0s. 
    lateral_shift_shape: lateral_shift_shape_variable_amplitude with:
        keep(it.transform == lane_relative)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 20.0)
        keep(it.shape_duration == duration_at_essence_accompany)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_start_cpp == 0.5)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_end_cpp == 1.2)
        keep(it.sin_period_start == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start)
        keep(it.sin_period_end == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == neighbor_vehicle)
        keep(it.lat_offset == gen_neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude)

    # The neighbor_vehicle collision_avoidance_behavior enabled
    keep(neighbor_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled)

    # var accompany_phase_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    # var accompany_phase_end_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.end)
    # event accompany_phase_active is accompany_phase_start_bool and not accompany_phase_end_bool
    

    # Main scenario block 
    do phase_essence: serial():

        emit ego_drive_start

        # Initial phase
        # In this phase the neighbor_vehicle start driving along the Ego
        phase_essence_approaching: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_approaching: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_approaching_start: speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph], 
                    at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approaching: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_approaching: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_approaching_start: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_neighbor_vehicle_at_start, 
                    time_tolerance: time_tolerance, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start,
                    measure_by: nearest)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_approach_start: speed([gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed-2kph..gen_neighbor_vehicle_speed+2kph], 
                    tolerance: 4kph, at: start)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_approaching: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicle_side)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approaching_end: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 0.5m, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_position_at_essence_approaching_end: \
                    position(distance: gen_neighbor_vehicle_lon_distance, 
                    tolerance: 3m, ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, 
                    measure_by: nearest)
        with:
            intent_essence_approaching_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_approaching, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_approaching)

        # neighbor_vehicle swirls with speed of ego
        phase_essence_accompany: parallel(overlap: equal): 
            drive_ego_at_essence_accompany: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_accompany: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_accompany: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_accompany: along(ego_road, run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_accompany: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_speed_at_essence_accompany: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_shape_at_essence_accompany: shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_accompany: lane(side_of:sut.car, run_mode:best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_along_at_essence_accompany: along(ego_road, run_mode: best_effort)

        emit ego_lane_change_event

        # neighbor_vehicle continues with ego speed 
        phase_essence_post_accompany: parallel(overlap: equal): 
            drive_ego_at_essence_post_accompany: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_post_accompany: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_post_accompany: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_neighbor_vehicle_at_essence_post_accompany: neighbor_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lane_at_essence_post_accompany: lane(side_of: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_neighbor_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_accompany: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_post_accompany: lateral(0meter, line: center, tolerance: 1.5m, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_neighbor_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_post_accompany: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_post_accompany_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_neighbor_vehicle_post_swirl, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_post_accompany)

        emit ego_drive_end

    # Deactivate the off_road check at the start of the phase_essence_accompany, aligning with the intended objective of the scenario.
    on @phase_essence_accompany.start:
        override(neighbor_vehicle.global_checkers.off_road_checker,freeze)


    # Auxiliar function and events to calculate swirling period start and end
    var phase_essence_accompany_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    var phase_essence_accompany_end_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.end)
    var swirling_period_start_bool: bool = sample(true, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    event swirling_period_sample is @top.clk if (not phase_essence_accompany_end_bool and \ 
        swirling_period_start_bool and neighbor_vehicle.prev_state != null)
    var lat_count : int = 10
    var prev_cycle_time : time
    var start_time : time = sample(top.time, @phase_essence_accompany.start)
    var first_adjusted_lat_offset: length
    var neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period: time

    def reached_lane_count_record() is:
        # Offset used to ensure negative lateral offsets are avoided
        const avoid_negative_lat_offset : length = 10m
        const lat_offset_tolerance : length = 0.01m
        var current_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        var previous_lat_value : length = neighbor_vehicle.prev_state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
        if lat_count == 10: 
            first_adjusted_lat_offset = neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset+ avoid_negative_lat_offset
            lat_count = 0
            
        if lat_count == 0 and  math.abs(first_adjusted_lat_offset-current_lat_value) >= lat_offset_tolerance: 
            if current_lat_value > first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = -1
            if current_lat_value < first_adjusted_lat_offset:
                lat_count = 1
        else:   
            if lat_count == 1 and current_lat_value > previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false  
            elif lat_count == -1 and current_lat_value < previous_lat_value:
                    # The first peak occurs at four times the period
                    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period  = 4*(top.time - start_time)
                    swirling_period_start_bool = false

    on @swirling_period_sample:
        call reached_lane_count_record()

    on @phase_essence_accompany.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_start = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period_end = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_period/2
    
    
    # Sampling metrics for coverage    
    on @phase_essence_approaching.start: 
        ego_time_gap_to_neighbor_vehicle_at_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(neighbor_vehicle)

    on @phase_essence_approaching.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_lon_distance = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle,closest_compound,closest_compound,lon,road))
        if (sut.car.road_distance(neighbor_vehicle, center, center, lon, road) > 0m):
            neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego = neighbor_vehicle_ahead_of_ego
        else:
            neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego = neighbor_vehicle_behind_ego


    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: maximum)
    neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: minimum)

    on @accompany_phase_active:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.add_sample(neighbor_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)

    on @phase_essence_accompany.end:
        neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude = neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_max.compute() - neighbor_vehicle_swirling_amplitude_min.compute()

# In this scenario, the sut car is driving in a lane adjacent to a lane where

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/adjacent_vehicles_family_base/adjacent_vehicles_family_base_top.osc"

scenario sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles inherits slow_neighbor_vehicles_family:

    keep(vehicle_1.color == green)
    keep(vehicle_2.color == blue)
    keep(vehicle_3.color == white)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.phase_essence_start_event.neighbor_vehicles_side", gen_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.start.gen_neighbor_vehicles_side")
    gen_neighbor_vehicles_side: av_side
    var neighbor_vehicles_side: av_side

    gen_neighbor_vehicles_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [10..30]kph)
    neighbor_vehicles_speed_range: range of speed with:
        keep(default it in [gen_neighbor_vehicles_speed-5kph..gen_neighbor_vehicles_speed+5kph])
    var neighbor_vehicles_speed_min: speed 
    var neighbor_vehicles_speed_max: speed 
    var neighbor_vehicles_speed_range_sampled: range of speed

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.phase_essence_start_event.vehicle_1_distance_to_ego", gen_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_1_distance_to_ego")
    gen_vehicle_1_distance_to_ego: length with:
        keep(it in [30..70]m)
    var vehicle_1_distance_to_ego: length 

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.phase_essence_start_event.vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1", gen_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1")
    gen_vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1: length with:
        keep(it in [15..30]m)
    var vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1: length 

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.phase_essence_start_event.vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2", gen_cover: "sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2")
    gen_vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2: length with:
        keep(it in [15..30]m)
    var vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2: length 

    duration_at_essence: time with:
        keep(it in [3..9]s)
    duration_tolerance_at_essence: time with:
        keep(it == 3s)

    distance_between_vehicles: length with:
        keep(it in [5..35]meter)
    ego_distance_to_vehicle_1: length with:
        keep(it in [10..90]meter)

enum slow_neighbors_kind: [slow_neighbor_vehicles]
extend sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles:
    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)
    pos_tolerance: length with: keep(default it == 5m)
    #Parameters to reduce the sensitivity of the collision avoidance of the cut_in_vehicle 
    keep(vehicle_1.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 1meter)
    keep(vehicle_1.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat == 0.1)
    keep(vehicle_1.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_safety_speed_lon == 3.6kph)
    keep(vehicle_2.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 1meter)
    keep(vehicle_2.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat == 0.1)
    keep(vehicle_2.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_safety_speed_lon == 3.6kph)
    keep(vehicle_3.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 1meter)
    keep(vehicle_3.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat == 0.1)
    keep(vehicle_3.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.min_safety_speed_lon == 3.6kph)

    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event

    var min_speed_sampled: speed = 300kph
    var max_speed_sampled: speed = 0kph

    on @start:
        
        if vehicle_1.state.speed < min_speed_sampled:
            min_speed_sampled = vehicle_1.state.speed
        elif vehicle_1.state.speed > max_speed_sampled:
            max_speed_sampled = vehicle_1.state.speed
        
        if vehicle_2.state.speed < min_speed_sampled:
            min_speed_sampled = vehicle_2.state.speed
        elif vehicle_2.state.speed > max_speed_sampled:
            max_speed_sampled = vehicle_2.state.speed
        
        if vehicle_3.state.speed < min_speed_sampled:
            min_speed_sampled = vehicle_3.state.speed
        elif vehicle_3.state.speed > max_speed_sampled:
            max_speed_sampled = vehicle_3.state.speed

        neighbor_vehicles_speed_range_sampled = [min_speed_sampled..max_speed_sampled]
        neighbor_vehicles_speed_min = min_speed_sampled
        neighbor_vehicles_speed_max = max_speed_sampled


    on @phase_essence_start_event:
        vehicle_1_distance_to_ego = math.abs(sut.car.road_distance(vehicle_1, center, center, lon, road))
        vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1 = math.abs(vehicle_2.road_distance(vehicle_1, center, center, lon, road))
        vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2 = math.abs(vehicle_3.road_distance(vehicle_2, center, center, lon, road))
        
        if (sut.car.road_distance(vehicle_3, center, center, lat, road) < 0m):
            neighbor_vehicles_side = right
        if (sut.car.road_distance(vehicle_3, center, center, lat, road) > 0m):
            neighbor_vehicles_side = left


    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
        
        drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
            intent_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
            intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort) 
        drive_vehicle_1_at_essence: vehicle_1.drive() with:
            intent_assist_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence: speed(neighbor_vehicles_speed_range, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_vehicle_1_lane_at_essence_start: lane(same_as: vehicle_2, at: start)
            intent_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane()
            intent_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: ego_distance_to_vehicle_1, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, tolerance: pos_tolerance)
        drive_vehicle_2_at_essence: vehicle_2.drive() with:
            intent_assist_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence: speed(neighbor_vehicles_speed_range, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_vehicle_2_lane_at_essence_start: lane(same_as: vehicle_3, at: start)
            intent_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane()
            intent_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: distance_between_vehicles, behind: vehicle_1, at: start, tolerance: pos_tolerance)
            intent_assist_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_end: position(distance: distance_between_vehicles, behind: vehicle_1, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
        drive_vehicle_3_at_essence: vehicle_3.drive() with:
            intent_assist_vehicle_3_speed_at_essence: speed(neighbor_vehicles_speed_range, run_mode: best_effort)
            intent_vehicle_3_lane_at_essence_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, side: gen_neighbor_vehicles_side, at: start)
            intent_vehicle_3_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane()
            intent_vehicle_3_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: distance_between_vehicles, behind: vehicle_2, at: start, tolerance: pos_tolerance)
            intent_assist_vehicle_3_position_at_essence_end: position(distance: distance_between_vehicles, behind: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
    with:
        intent_essence_duration: duration(duration_at_essence, tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence)

    on @phase_essence.start: emit ego_lane_change_event

    in_drive_vehicle_1_at_essence:in drive_vehicle_1_at_essence with: 
        intent_assist_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: [gen_vehicle_1_distance_to_ego-2m..gen_vehicle_1_distance_to_ego+2m], 
            ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
        
    in_drive_vehicle_2_at_essence:in drive_vehicle_2_at_essence with: 
        intent_assist_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: [gen_vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1-2m..gen_vehicle_2_distance_to_vehicle_1+2m], 
            behind: vehicle_1, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in_drive_vehicle_3_at_essence:in drive_vehicle_3_at_essence with: 
        intent_assist_vehicle_3_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: [gen_vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2-2m..gen_vehicle_3_distance_to_vehicle_2+2m], 
            behind: vehicle_2, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)


extend sut.slow_neighbor_vehicles_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_ego_warm_up: slow_neighbor_vehicles_family_ego_warm_up(vehicle_1: vehicle_1, vehicle_2: vehicle_2, vehicle_3: vehicle_3)

        # invoke adjacent_vehicles scenario
        phase_scenario: slow_neighbor_vehicles(vehicle_1: vehicle_1, vehicle_2: vehicle_2, vehicle_3: vehicle_3)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the adjacent_vehicles family
        phase_post: slow_neighbor_vehicles_family_post(vehicle_1: vehicle_1, vehicle_2: vehicle_2, vehicle_3: vehicle_3)

#    . gen_ego_time_gap_to_neighbor_vehicle_at_start - Time gap between ego and neighbor_vehicle at start
#    . gen_neighbor_vehicle_side - Side of the neighbor_vehicle
#    . gen_stationary_object_count - Number of stationary objects

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed/vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vehicles/adjacent_vehicles_family_base/adjacent_vehicles_family_base_top.osc"

enum relative_position_to_ego: [ahead_of, behind]

scenario sut.vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects inherits generic_base_scenario:

    keep(default scenario_str == "vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects")
    neighbor_vehicle: vehicle

    gen_neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego: relative_position_to_ego_type
    var neighbor_vehicle_relative_position_to_ego: relative_position_to_ego_type
    # Stationary object group parameters and definition
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects.start.stationary_object_count", gen_cover: "sut.vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_with_similar_speed_stationary_objects.start.gen_stationary_object_count")
    gen_stationary_object_count: int with:
        keep(default it in [2..6])
    var stationary_object_count: int

    random_object_placement_fraction: int
    keep(random_object_placement_fraction in [50..90])
    stationary_object_group: plain_object_group with:
        keep(it.objects_type == random)
        keep(it.objects.size() == gen_stationary_object_count)

    # Maximum distance between the group objects
    max_distance_between_group_objects: length with:
        keep(default it == 2m)

    # Object group lateral position
    objects_positon_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset == -1.3m)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset == 1.3m)
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects == max_distance_between_group_objects)

    # The distance between ego and nearest object at start of phase_essence_accompany
    # This variable is necessary to avoid positioning Ego very close to the
    # Object group
    ego_min_distance_to_nearest_object_at_accompany_phase_start: length with:
        keep(it == 10m)

    # Variable to obtain upper limit of the longitudinal offset
    ego_planned_path_distance_accompany_phase: length with:
        keep(it == vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_at_essence.duration_at_essence_accompany*vehicle_swirling_next_to_ego_at_essence.gen_ego_speed_at_start)

    # Minimum longitudinal offset to avoid a Ego and Object overlap
    object_group_min_lon_offset: length with:
        keep(it == (sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2))
        keep(it < ego_planned_path_distance_accompany_phase)

    # Longitudinal offset of Object on the Ego drive
    object_group_lon_offset: length with:
        keep(it == object_group_min_lon_offset + (random_object_placement_fraction/100)*\
            ((ego_planned_path_distance_accompany_phase-object_group_min_lon_offset)) + \
            ego_min_distance_to_nearest_object_at_accompany_phase_start)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_traffic_light:

    # Duration of the traffic light states
    green_tl_state_time: time
    red_tl_state_time: time

    keep(default green_tl_state_time in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_tl_state_time)
    keep(default gen_yellow_tl_state_time in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_tl_state_time)
    keep(default red_tl_state_time in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_tl_state_time)

    # Make sure the junction has a traffic light
    keep(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_path.internal_road.traffic_light_id != -1)

    # Traffic light id of the Junction
    tl_id_trigger: uint
    keep(tl_id_trigger == ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_path.internal_road.traffic_light_id)

    # Defining variable for traffic light position on the route
    var tl_pos: msp_road_position = sample(top.get_tl_position(ref_vehicle: sut.car, tl_id: tl_id_trigger), @top.clk)
    
    # Sampled event when Ego is travelling towards the traffic light when tl_pos in not equal to null 
    event ego_travelling_to_tl is @top.clk if tl_pos != null

    # Calculating Ego distance to tl with respect to the tl position on the route
    var ego_rel_distance_to_tl: length = sample(map.get_road_distance_along_route(\
                    sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position, tl_pos,
                        sut.car.planned_path), @ego_travelling_to_tl)
    
    do phase_essence: serial():

        ego_traverse_junction_at_essence: sut.ego_traverse_junction() with:
            ego_tl: one_tl_triple_semantic_unprotected(\
                tl_internal_road: it.ego_internal_road,
                repeat_always: true,
                first_duration: green_tl_state_time, 
                second_duration: gen_yellow_tl_state_time, 
                third_duration: red_tl_state_time,
                tl_transitions_start_index: gen_ego_tl_transitions_start_index)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/crossing_vrus_family/crossing_vru_group/crossing_vru_group_top.osc"

# Scenario definition
scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru inherits generic_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str == "ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru")

    # Ego lane at start
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.ego_in_road_drive_start.ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive")

        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_lane)
        
    # Trigger time definition for VRU group move
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.vru_move_start.trigger_time", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_trigger_time")
    gen_trigger_time: time
    keep(default gen_trigger_time in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_trigger_time)

    # VRU group crossing variant [crossing, shape_crossing, 
    # start_and_stop_crossing, go_and_return]
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.phase_essence_start_event.crossing_variant", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_crossing_variant")

        keep(default it == crossing)

    # VRU group positioning at the start
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.phase_essence_start_event.vru_group_1_side_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start")
    gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start: vru_group_positioning with:
        keep(default it == right)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.finish.vru_group_2_side_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start")
    gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start: vru_group_positioning with:
        keep(default it == left)

    # Number of VRU's in VRU group
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.phase_essence_start_event.vru_group_size", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru.start.gen_vru_group_size")
    gen_vru_group_size: uint with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_group_size)
    
    gen_essence_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [25..30]s)

extend issue_kind: [ego_did_not_move]
extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru:

    # Configuring parameters for the crossing VRU group scenario
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_crossing_variant == gen_crossing_variant)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_move_vru_group_duration_1 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_move_vru_group_duration_2 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)

    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_size_group == gen_vru_group_size)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_crossing_variant == gen_crossing_variant)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_side_at_start == gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_trigger_time == gen_trigger_time)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_move_vru_group_duration_1 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_move_vru_group_duration_2 == vru_group_move_duration)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end == vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.min_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(crossing_vru_group_2.vru_group_end_position_params.max_lat_offset == 0m)
    keep(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_path.in_road.min_lanes >= 1)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the start
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start: angle with:
        keep(default it in [90..150]degree)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road at the end
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end: angle with:
        keep(default it in [30..90]degree)
    
    # VRU group move duration
    vru_group_move_duration: time 
    keep(default vru_group_move_duration in [3..5]s)

    # Trigger event for move of VRU group to start
    event move_trigger_event_1 is (sut.car.state.speed > 1kph)
    event move_trigger_event_2 is @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        ego_enters_junction if sut.car.state.speed > 1kph

    # Longitudinal distance of vru_group_1 to ego, w.r.t internal_road
    keep(crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing == \
        -1*(crossing_vru_group_1.vru_group_end_position_params.\
        max_distance_between_objects * crossing_vru_group_1.gen_vru_size_group))

    # Longitudinal distance of vru_group_2 to ego
    vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it == 0m)
        keep(crossing_vru_group_2.gen_vru_group_lon_offset_to_ego_start_at_crossing == \
             vru_group_2_lon_offset_to_ego_at_start)

    # These angles are defined to avoid VRU colliding with Ego, In cases,
    # If VRU is traveling in opposite direction to the Ego (Ex:
    # go_and_return variant)
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start == right =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [80..90]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [90..100]degree)    
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_1_side_at_start == left =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [90..100]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [80..90]degree)    
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start == left =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [90..100]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [80..90]degree)
    keep(gen_crossing_variant == go_and_return and \
        gen_vru_group_2_side_at_start == right =>
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_start in [80..90]degree and \
            vru_group_rel_angle_to_road_at_end in [90..100]degree)

    # Enable collision avoidance for Ego
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == \
        always_enabled)


    # Main do
    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru: parallel(start_to_start: 0s, overlap: any):
                
            ego_traverse_junction_at_essence: ego_traverse_junction()

            crossing_vru_group_1_at_essence: serial:
                wait @move_trigger_event_1
                crossing_vru_group_1: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                    ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road)
                    
            crossing_vru_group_2_at_essence: serial:
                wait @move_trigger_event_2
                crossing_vru_group_2: top.crossing_vru_group(ref_drive: \
                    ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
                    drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_essence_duration, 
            run_mode: best_effort)

        # Scenario stopping condition - Ego standstill
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_stops_for_max_time
            log_info("Ego speed was slower than " +\
                "$(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.standstill_threshold_speed) " +\
                "for longer than " +\
                "$(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.max_time_ego_stops)")

    in ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        pass
        lane(outer.gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    on @ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.ego_stops_for_max_time:
        call sut_warning(ego_did_not_move, 
            " The Ego stopped for $(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.max_time_ego_stops)")

    keep(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        gen_essence_internal_road_duration in [2..5]s)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_main:
    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru()
        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_post()

    # To avoid lane change after warm_up
    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lane(outer.phase_essence.gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb,
        run_mode: best_effort)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ego::ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle

# In this scenario, Ego approaches a junction and is trying to perform
# a turn which is unprotected by traffic light. From the opposite lane a
# single vehicle is oncoming and exiting in any direction.

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/junction_family_base/junction_family_base_top.osc"

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle inherits junction_family_base:

    oncoming_vehicle: vehicle

    # Time gap between Ego and junction at the start
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.phase_essence_start_event.ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.start.gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start")
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_junction)

    # Direction of oncoming_vehicle while crossing junction
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.phase_essence_start_event.oncoming_vehicle_direction", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.start.gen_oncoming_vehicle_direction")
    gen_oncoming_vehicle_direction: drive_direction with:
        keep(default it in [left, right, straight])   
    
    # Speed of oncoming_vehicle at start parameter
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.phase_essence_start_event.oncoming_vehicle_speed", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.start.gen_oncoming_vehicle_speed")
    gen_oncoming_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.finish.joint_arrival_time", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle.start.gen_joint_arrival_time")
    gen_joint_arrival_time: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_joint_arrival_time_range)

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle_main inherits junction_family_base_main:

    # Oncoming vehicle definition
    oncoming_vehicle : vehicle

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle/ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle:
    top.roads_enter_junction_relation(ego_one_way_road, oncoming_one_way_road, 
        relative_direction: opposite)
        
     # Road element definition for oncoming vehicle
    oncoming_vehicle_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction

    # Road element to keep Ego and oncoming vehicle move in opposite direction
    ego_one_way_road: one_way_road
    oncoming_one_way_road: one_way_road
    
    keep(ego_path.internal_road.junction_id == 
        oncoming_vehicle_path.internal_road.junction_id)
    
    var oncoming_vehicle_speed: speed 

    initial_phase_duration : time with:
        keep(default it in [1..15]s)
    
    # Minimum distance of Ego to the junction
    min_ego_distance_to_junction: length with:
        keep(it >= ftlx_lib_base_config.default_min_ego_distance_to_junction)
    
    oncoming_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in [3..15]s)

    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - \
        oncoming_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction_at_start \
        == gen_joint_arrival_time)
    
    road_with_sign_track: sut.car.track_road_element(road_with_sign, trigger: all)
    
    # Sampling the speed of oncoming vehicle at start
    on @start: oncoming_vehicle_speed= oncoming_vehicle.state.speed

    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event

    # Calculating distance to junction for both vehicles
    ego_distance_to_junction_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it == (gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start * \
            gen_ego_speed_at_start))

    oncoming_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it == (oncoming_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction_at_start * \
            gen_oncoming_vehicle_speed))
    
    do phase_essence: serial():
        ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle_at_essence: \
            ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle(\
                ego_path: ego_path,
                ego_one_way_road_path: ego_one_way_road,
                gen_ego_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction,
                gen_ego_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                ego_distance_to_junction_at_start: ego_distance_to_junction_at_start,
                vehicle: oncoming_vehicle,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_oncoming_vehicle_speed,
                vehicle_path: oncoming_vehicle_path,
                vehicle_one_way_road_path: oncoming_one_way_road,
                vehicle_path_direction: gen_oncoming_vehicle_direction,
                vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: \
                    oncoming_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle_main:
    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_ego_warm_up(\
            vehicle: oncoming_vehicle)

        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_oncoming_vehicle(\
            oncoming_vehicle: oncoming_vehicle)

        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_post(\
            vehicle: oncoming_vehicle)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/vehicle_traverse_junction/vehicle_traverse_junction_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle: 
    
    # Path of vehicle
    vehicle_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 

    vehicle_one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    ego_one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    
    vehicle_time_gap_to_junction_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_junction)

    vehicle_path_direction: drive_direction 
    
    # Constraints both the vehicles the same junction_id
    keep(default ego_path.internal_road.junction_id == vehicle_path.internal_road.junction_id)

    # Calculating distance to junction for both vehicles    
    ego_distance_to_junction_at_start: length 

    vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: length

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle: parallel(overlap:equal):
            ego_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(
                vehicle: sut.car,
                vehicle_path: ego_path,
                one_way_road_path: ego_one_way_road_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: ego_distance_to_junction_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction) 

            vehicle_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(
                vehicle: vehicle,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_path,
                one_way_road_path: vehicle_one_way_road_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_speed_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start: vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: vehicle_path_direction)
        
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @vehicles_stopped_in_inroad
            log_info("Ego and vehicle stopped in the in_road for > $(max_time_vehicles_wait)")

    override_intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: \
    override(vehicle_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_main:
    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_ego_warm_up(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_post(\
            vehicle: vehicle)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru/ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign:

    # Road element defintion for Ego drive with traffic sign at the junction
    signed_junction: road_with_sign
    keep(signed_junction.sign_type == gen_traffic_sign_type)
    
    # The number of vehicles in random_traffic_vehicle_group is assigned
    random_traffic_group: common_route_car_group with(reference_car: sut.car):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_random_traffic)
        keep(it.reference_car_index == 0) 
    random_traffic_group_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model

    # Setting parameters for ftx_driver
    keep(random_traffic_group_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    keep(random_traffic_group_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(random_traffic_group_driver_model.target_speed == gen_traffic_group_target_speed)

    # Setting the behavior model of each vehicle in random traffic
    # vehicle group as ftx_driver 
    for vehicle in random_traffic_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == random_traffic_group_driver_model)
    
    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):

        ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru()
        drive_random_traffic_group_at_essence: random_traffic_group.group_drive()

    ego_at_sign: in ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence.\
        ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.vehicle_traverse_junction_at_essence.\
        drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
            intent_ego_along_at_essence_internal_road_start: along(
                outer.signed_junction, at: start)

    
extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_vehicle_and_crossing_vru_and_traffic_sign()
        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_post()

    # To avoid lane change after warm_up
    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        lane(outer.phase_essence.ego_traverse_junction_with_crossing_vru_at_essence.\
        gen_ego_lane_at_ego_inroad_drive, from: curb,
        run_mode: best_effort)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ego::ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles
# In this scenario, The Ego approaches a junction on a random junction leg
# and random lane with a configurable time gap, Each other Vehicle 
# (vehicle_1 - vehicle_5) will also approach (and later leave) the junction
# on a random leg and random lane with a configurable time gap, The scenario
# ends when the Ego is 5s away from the junction after traversing it.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start - The speed of vehicle_1 at start
#    . gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start - The speed of vehicle_1 at start
#    . gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start - The speed of vehicle_1 at start
#    . gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start - The speed of vehicle_1 at start
#    . gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start - The speed of vehicle_1 at start
#    . gen_joint_arrival_time - The time difference between arrivals of
#      the vehicles at the junction
   

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/junction_family_base/junction_family_base_top.osc"

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles inherits junction_family_base:

    vehicle_1: vehicle
    vehicle_2: vehicle
    vehicle_3: vehicle
    vehicle_4: vehicle
    vehicle_5: vehicle

    # Time gap between Ego and junction at the start
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.phase_essence_start_event.ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start")
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_junction)

    # Initial speed of other Vehicle
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.vehicle_1_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start")
    gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.vehicle_2_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start")
    gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.vehicle_3_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start")
    gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.vehicle_4_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start")
    gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.vehicle_5_speed_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles.start.gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start")
    gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)

    gen_joint_arrival_time: time with:    
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_joint_arrival_time_range)

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_main inherits junction_family_base_main:

    vehicle_1: vehicle
    vehicle_2: vehicle
    vehicle_3: vehicle
    vehicle_4: vehicle
    vehicle_5: vehicle

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/vehicle_traverse_junction/vehicle_traverse_junction_top.osc"

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles:
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event

    # Initial other Vehicle time gap
    vehicle_1_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_2_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_3_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_4_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)
    vehicle_5_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_junction)

    ego_speed_at_end: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_speed_range)
    
    keep(max_time_vehicles_wait  == 30s)

    var vehicle_1_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_2_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_3_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_4_speed_at_start: speed
    var vehicle_5_speed_at_start: speed

    # Junction paths
    vehicle_1_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_2_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_3_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_4_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction 
    vehicle_5_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction  

    road_with_sign_track: sut.car.track_road_element(road_with_sign, trigger: all)

    # Sampling the speed of the Vehicle's at start
    on @start: vehicle_1_speed_at_start = vehicle_1.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_2_speed_at_start = vehicle_2.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_3_speed_at_start = vehicle_3.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_4_speed_at_start = vehicle_4.state.speed
    on @start: vehicle_5_speed_at_start = vehicle_5.state.speed

    # Constraints all the vehicles the same junction_id
    keep(vehicle_1_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_2_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_3_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_4_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
    keep(vehicle_5_path.internal_road.junction_id == ego_path.internal_road.\
        junction_id) 
   
    ego_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_ego_speed_at_start*gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start)
    vehicle_1_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start*vehicle_1_time_gap)
    vehicle_2_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start*vehicle_2_time_gap)
    vehicle_3_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start*vehicle_3_time_gap)
    vehicle_4_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start*vehicle_4_time_gap)
    vehicle_5_distance_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start*vehicle_5_time_gap)


    keep(gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_1_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_2_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_3_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_4_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time or \
        gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - vehicle_5_time_gap == gen_joint_arrival_time)

    # Distance offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length with:
        keep(it == 20m)
    
    # The scenario ends when Ego travels 5s outside the junction
    drive_time_after_junction: time with:
        keep(it == 10s)
    
    # Event definition to define the sampling clock
    event clock is sut.car.state != null 

    var out_road_start_position := sample(ego_path.internal_road.get_position_on_road(\
        ego_path.internal_road.length), @start)
    
    event ego_junction_drive_on_out_road_event is @clock if map.distance_from_ref_position(
        sut.car.state.msp_pos.road_position, out_road_start_position) in [-0.5..0.5]m

    event ego_exited is @ego_junction_drive_on_out_road_event 
    var ego_exited_bool: bool = sample(true, @ego_exited)
    var triggered_clock: time = sample(top.time, @ego_exited)
    event exit_timer is ego_exited_bool == true
    event scenario_stopper is @exit_timer if (top.time - triggered_clock == drive_time_after_junction)

    distance_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
        
    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_ego_traverse_junction_with_multiples_vehicle: parallel(overlap: equal):
       
            ego_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: sut.car,
                vehicle_path: ego_path,
                gen_vehicle_traversal_direction: gen_ego_traversal_direction,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start) 

            vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_1,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_1_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_1_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_2,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_2_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_2_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_3,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_3_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_3_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_4,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_4_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_4_speed_at_start)
            
            vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence: vehicle_traverse_junction(\
                vehicle: vehicle_5,
                vehicle_path: vehicle_5_path,
                gen_vehicle_speed_at_start: gen_vehicle_5_speed_at_start)

        phase_essence_scenario_stopper : serial():
            wait @scenario_stopper
            log_info("Ego drove for $(drive_time_after_junction) 
            after exiting junction")

    override_intent_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\ 
        override(vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end ,
             run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)
    override_intent_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_in_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end , 
            run_mode: disable)

    override_intent_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)
    override_intent_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_out_road_end:\
        override(vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
            run_mode: best_effort)

    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
        vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, \
            vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end,\
         vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road.end, 0s)

    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)
    synchronize(ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, \
        vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road.end, 0s)

    
    in vehicle_1_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_1_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
                outer.vehicle_1_path.in_road, 
                end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_1_distance_at_start], 
                at: start,
                run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_2_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_2_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_2_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_3_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_3_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_3_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_3_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_4_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_4_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_4_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_4_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in vehicle_5_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road with:
        intent_assist_vehicle_5_along_at_essence_in_road_start: along(\
            outer.vehicle_5_path.in_road, 
            end_offset: [0m..outer.vehicle_5_distance_at_start], 
            at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in ego_traverse_junction_at_essence.drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road with:

        intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_out_road: speed(\
                outer.ego_speed_at_end, run_mode: best_effort)

extend sut.vehicle_traverse_junction:

    override_intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road:\
        override(intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road,
        run_mode: disable)
    
    keep(gen_essence_in_road_duration in [5..30]s)
    keep(gen_essence_out_road_duration in [5..40]s)

extend ftx_driver:

    keep(collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat == 0.5)

extend sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
    
        phase_warm_up: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_ego_warm_up(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

        phase_essence: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

        phase_post: ego_traverse_junction_with_multiple_vehicles_post(
            vehicle_1: vehicle_1,
            vehicle_2: vehicle_2,
            vehicle_3: vehicle_3,
            vehicle_4: vehicle_4,
            vehicle_5: vehicle_5)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ego::ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group
# In this scenario, The Ego, crosspath_vehicle, and group of traffic vehicles 
# approach the junction to perform a turn protected by a traffic light. 
# Here, the traffic vehicles follow the path of the crosspath_vehicle.
# The crosspath_vehicle and traffic vehicles enter from the 
# left or right leg of the Ego. Both the crosspath_vehicle and the traffic vehicles 
# go straight to the out road, but the Ego can take any of the junction's exits
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
# . gen_ego_speed_at_start - Ego speed at in_road drive
# . gen_crosspath_vehicle_speed_at_start - Crosspath_vehicle speed at start
# . gen_ego_time_gap_to_junction_at_start - Ego time gap to the junction at start
# . gen_joint_arrival_time - Joint arrival time of Ego and crosspath_vehicle
# . gen_ego_traversal_direction - Ego junction drive direction
# . gen_cross_path_vehicle_entry_side - Crosspath_vehicle entry side
# . gen_cross_path_traffic_group_min_initial_ttc - Minimum initial TTC of cross_path_traffic_group
# . gen_number_of_cross_path_traffic_group_vehicles - Number of vehicles in cross_path_traffic_group
# . gen_traffic_light_transition_delay - Delay between the traffic light state transition
# . gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior - Whether crosspath_vehicle's junction behavior is enabled

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group/ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/junction_family/traffic_light_controller_common/tl_controller_top.osc"

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light inherits generic_base_scenario:
    crosspath_vehicle: vehicle

    cross_path_traffic_group: single_lane_car_group with(\
        reference_car: crosspath_vehicle)

scenario sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles inherits \
    ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light (tl_state_type == unprotected):

        # Delay between the traffic light state transition
        @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.tl_state_change_on_both_sides.traffic_light_transition_delay", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.start.gen_traffic_light_transition_delay")
        gen_traffic_light_transition_delay: time with:
            keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_traffic_light_transition_delay)

        # Whether oncoming_vehicle's junction behavior is enabled
        @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.start.crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior", gen_cover: "sut.ego_traverse_junction_with_cross_path_vehicle_and_traffic_group_and_traffic_light_with_circles.start.gen_crosspath_vehicle_junction_behavior")

This file should contain the actual code implementing the vehicle's behavior when approaching and navigating through the intersection, including the conditional logic for left/right turns or straight movement based on parameters, the distance calculation and triggering mechanism when the vehicle is 1 meter from the intersection, and the execution of the vehicle's passing intention through the complex junction.

extend sut.vehicle_traverse_junction:

    # The distance between the vehicle and the junction at the end
    vehicle_distance_from_junction_at_end: length with:
        keep(default it in [5..40]m)

    # Tolerance for distance of the vehicle from the junction at start/end
    distance_tolerance: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
        
    # To ensure the vehicle drives on a one-way road during the in-road phase
    one_way_road_path: one_way_road
    
    junction_offset: length with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_junction_dist_offset)

    # Path of the vehicle
    vehicle_path: roads_follow_in_urban_junction
    keep(vehicle_path.internal_road.junction_category == complex)

    # The junction behavior of the vehicle is enabled by default
    keep(default vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == true) 
    
    event clock is @top.clk if (vehicle.state != null and vehicle_path != null)
    
    event vehicle_on_in_road_end is @clock if (
        map.distance_from_ref_position(
        vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position, 
        vehicle_path.in_road.get_position_on_road(\
        vehicle_path.in_road.length)) <= 1m)

    on @vehicle_on_in_road_end:
        override(intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    # The distance between Ego and out road start after which
    # the along modifier in out road can be disabled
    ego_out_road_distance: range of length
    keep(default ego_out_road_distance in [-10..-9]m)

    # Override the along as vehicle may enter in the next junction
    # if out road is short
    event vehicle_on_out_road_start is @clock if (
        map.distance_from_ref_position(
        vehicle.state.msp_pos.road_position, 
        vehicle_path.out_road.get_position_on_road(\
        0m)) in ego_out_road_distance)

    on @vehicle_on_out_road_start:
        override(intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end, 
        run_mode: best_effort)

    # Constraining the direction of junction drive to be equal to
    # 'gen_vehicle_traversal_direction' parameter
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == left => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction in [slight_left, left, sharp_left])
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == right => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction in [slight_right, right, sharp_right])
    keep(gen_vehicle_traversal_direction == straight => \
    vehicle_path.internal_road.direction == straight)

    do phase_essence: serial():

        # Vehicle drives on an in-road
        phase_essence_in_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_in_road: vehicle.drive() with :
                intent_assist_vehicle_speed_at_essence_in_road_start: speed(\
                    gen_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road: along(
                    one_way_road_path, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_distance_at_essence_in_road: distance(
                    gen_vehicle_distance_to_junction_at_start, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)    
                intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_in_road_end: along( 
                    vehicle_path.in_road, end_offset: junction_offset, at: end,
                    tolerance: distance_tolerance)
        with:
            intent_essence_in_road_duration: duration( 
                gen_essence_in_road_duration, 
                tolerance : gen_duration_tolerance)

        # vehicle drives through the junction, it can even stop if
        # there is any obstacle, so override the modifier
        phase_essence_internal_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_internal_road: vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_internal_road_end:\
                    along(vehicle_path.internal_road, at: end, 
                     run_mode: best_effort) 
        with:
            intent_essence_internal_road_duration: duration(
                gen_essence_internal_road_duration, 
                tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance)

                    
        # vehicle drives on out road 
        phase_essence_out_road: serial:
            drive_vehicle_at_essence_out_road: vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: along(
                    vehicle_path.out_road, at: end, 
                    start_offset: vehicle_distance_from_junction_at_end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_along_at_essence_out_road_end: along(
                    vehicle_path.out_road, at: end)
        with:
            intent_assist_essence_out_road_duration: \
                duration(gen_essence_out_road_duration, run_mode: best_effort )

# sut::motorcycle_splitting_lanes
# In this scenario, motorcycle is travelling between the lanes beside SUT
#
extend sut.motorcycle_splitting_lanes:

    var motorcycle_speed: speed
    motorcycle_speed_tolerance: speed with: 
        keep(it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)
        
    on @start: motorcycle_speed = motorcycle.state.speed

    # Road attributes
    ego_path: one_way_road
    number_of_lanes: int
    keep(number_of_lanes >= 2)
    keep(ego_path.max_lanes == number_of_lanes)
    keep(ego_path.min_lanes >= number_of_lanes)
    keep(number_of_lanes==2 => adjacent_vehicle_side==left)

    # To ensure the lateral offset is within the lane
    lane_width: length with:
        keep(default it == 3m)
    keep(motorcycle_lat_pos_rel_to_ego < lane_width/2)

    half_of_ego_width: length with:
        keep(it ==(sut.car.get_width()/2))
    half_of_motorcycle_width: length with:
        keep(it ==(motorcycle.get_width()/2))
    motorcycle_lat_pos_rel_to_ego: length

    keep(gen_motorcycle_split_side == left => 
        (motorcycle_lat_pos_rel_to_ego == 
        (half_of_ego_width + gen_motorcycle_lat_offset_to_ego
         +half_of_motorcycle_width )))

    keep(gen_motorcycle_split_side == right => 
        (motorcycle_lat_pos_rel_to_ego == 
        ((half_of_ego_width + gen_motorcycle_lat_offset_to_ego 
        + half_of_motorcycle_width) * -1)))

    # Motorcycle behavior configuration
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled) 
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 2meter)
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    # optimal control trajectory generator allows the motorcycle to navigate more freely between vehicles
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.trajectory_manager_params.oc_trajectory_generator_params.enable == true)
    # disable lane boundary cost to allow motorcycle to navigate more freely between lanes
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.trajectory_manager_params.oc_trajectory_generator_params.lane_boundary_cost == 0.0)
    
    adjacent_vehicle_side: av_side

    motorcycle_pos_rel_ego_at_end: range of length with:
        keep(default it in [2..]m)
    lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence : length with:
        keep(default it in [0.2..0.5]m)

    lead_vehicle_side: line
    keep(gen_motorcycle_split_side==left=>lead_vehicle_side==right)
    keep(gen_motorcycle_split_side==right=>lead_vehicle_side==left)
    keep(gen_duration_at_essence in [25..30]s)
    do phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
            # The lead vehicle and adjacent vehicles(adjacent_vehicle_1 and adjacent_vehicle_2)
            # creates a traffic ahead and beside SUT, where SUT drives 
            # in the leftmost lane of the road
            # The motorcycle drives behind the SUT and tries to move between the 
            # lane lines of SUT to move ahead of the traffic
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with: 
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_vehicle_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_lane_at_essence:\
                    lane(outermost: true, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence:\
                    along(ego_path, run_mode: best_effort)

            # Lead vehicle behavior
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_start:\
                    position(time: gen_lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence:\
                    lane(same_as: sut.car)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence:\
                    lateral(distance: lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence, line: lead_vehicle_side)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_vehicle_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence:\
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

            # Adjacent vehicle 1 behavior
            drive_adjacent_vehicle_1_at_essence: adjacent_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_start:\
                    position(time: gen_adjacent_vehicle_1_rel_pos_to_ego_at_split_phase_start, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_1_lane_at_essence:\
                    lane(side_of: sut.car, side: left, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_1_along_at_essence:\
                    along(ego_path, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_1_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_vehicle_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_essence:\
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

            # Adjacent vehicle 2 behavior
            drive_adjacent_vehicle_2_at_essence: adjacent_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_start:\
                    position(time: gen_adjacent_vehicle_2_rel_pos_to_ego_at_split_phase_start, 
                        behind: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_2_lane_at_essence:\
                    lane(side_of: sut.car, side: adjacent_vehicle_side,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_vehicle_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_adjacent_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_essence:\
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_adjacent_vehicle_2_along_at_essence:\
                    along(ego_path)

            # Motorcycle behavior
            drive_motorcycle_at_essence: motorcycle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_motorcycle_speed_at_essence_start:\
                    speed(gen_motorcycle_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_position_at_essence_start:\
                    position(time: gen_motorcycle_rel_pos_to_ego_at_start, behind: sut.car, 
                        measure_by: nearest, at : start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lateral_at_essence:\
                    lateral(motorcycle_lat_pos_rel_to_ego, 
                        line: center,  
                        run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_position_at_essence_end:\
                    position(motorcycle_pos_rel_ego_at_end, ahead_of: sut.car,
                        measure_by: nearest, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lane_at_essence:\
                    lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_motorcycle_avoid_collisions :\
                    avoid_collisions(false)

    with: 
        intent_essence_duration : duration(gen_duration_at_essence, 
            tolerance : gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
 
    # Disable collision avoidance of motorcycle only for SUT
    def post_plan() is also:
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(sut.car)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(adjacent_vehicle_1)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(adjacent_vehicle_2)

extend sut.motorcycle_splitting_lanes_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_drive_with_motorcycle_and_vehicles_ego_warm_up(
            lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle,
            adjacent_vehicle_1: adjacent_vehicle_1,
            adjacent_vehicle_2: adjacent_vehicle_2,
            motorcycle: motorcycle)
        phase_essence: motorcycle_splitting_lanes(
            lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle,
            adjacent_vehicle_1: adjacent_vehicle_1,
            adjacent_vehicle_2: adjacent_vehicle_2,
            motorcycle: motorcycle)
        phase_post: ego_drive_with_motorcycle_and_vehicles_post(
            lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle,
            adjacent_vehicle_1: adjacent_vehicle_1,
            adjacent_vehicle_2: adjacent_vehicle_2,
            motorcycle: motorcycle)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/adjacent_vrus_family/adjacent_vrus_family_base/adjacent_vrus_family_base_top.osc"

# Main scenario definition
scenario sut.vru_walking_around_stopped_omv inherits adjacent_vrus_family_base:
