    keep(default gen_stopped_vehicle_yaw in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_yaw_angle)

    # Ego lane number from center of the map
    gen_ego_lane_num: int
    keep(default gen_ego_lane_num in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_lane_num)

    # VRU heading angle while moving from stopped vehicle
    # Constrained as per spec
    gen_vru_heading_angle_start: angle
    keep(default gen_vru_heading_angle_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_heading_angle)

    gen_vru_heading_angle_end: angle
    keep(default gen_vru_heading_angle_end in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_heading_angle)

    # VRU change time represents the wait time for VRU before moving
    gen_vru_time_start: time
    keep(default gen_vru_time_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_time_start)

    # Ego time gap to stopped vehicle
    # Constrained as per spec
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle: time
    keep(default gen_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle)

    # Offset of vru's position to stopped_veh's bounding box
    gen_vru_offset: length
    keep(default gen_vru_offset in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_offset)
    
    vru_group: common_plain_object_group

    # Defined a plain object of kind stationary vehicle
    stopped_vehicle: stationary_vehicle

arguments.content:
# Copyright (C) 2025 Foretellix Ltd (“Foretellix”)
# This source code file is licensed to you under Foretellix’ End User License
# Agreement, you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You are not allowed to distribute it to any third party without Foretellix’
# written approval.

# you do it at your own risk, and Foretellix will no longer supply any
# support or maintenance services for this source code.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

extend sut.vru_walking_around_stopped_omv:
    number_of_vrus: int
    keep(default number_of_vrus == 1)

    # Essence duration variable
    duration_at_essence: time
    keep(default duration_at_essence in [15..35]s)
    
    duration_at_essence_tolerance: time
    keep(default duration_at_essence_tolerance == 20s)

    # VRU definition of kind person,cyclist or animal
    keep(vru_group.objects_kind in [person,cyclist,animal])
    keep(vru_group.objects.size() == number_of_vrus)

    # Distance between ego and stopped vehicle when VRU starts moving
    ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle: length
    keep(ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle == gen_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle*gen_ego_speed_at_start)
    keep(default ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle in [0..450]meter)

    # Ego reached the stopped_vehicle distance parameter
    # When the ego's rear is at exactly same as stopped vehicle front
    # periphery assuming stopped vehicle is placed at 0 degree yaw
    # the method 'distance_to_point_along_path' gives a distance equal to
    # 'sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 + stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2'. So using
    # the same distance as reference with a addition of 10m to make sure that
    # ego drive passed stopped vehicle.
    ego_scenario_ends_distance: length
    keep(ego_scenario_ends_distance == -1*(sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 +
        stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2 + 10m))
    
    #  Road element definition
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes >= 2)

    # VRU's msp positions
    # Constrained to be calculated msp positions relative to stopped
    # vehicle msp position
    vru_group_position: msp_position

    # The stopped vehicle will only be on the innermost or outermost lane
    max_lanes_of_road: uint with:
        keep(it == road.max_lanes)
    keep(stopped_vehicle_lane_num in [1..max_lanes_of_road])
    # Stopped vehicle lane number from center of the map
    stopped_vehicle_lane_num: int

    # Stopped vehicle msp position
    stopped_vehicle_position: msp_position

    # How many lanes is stopped vehicle away from ego lane
    # The difference gives how many lanes apart the stopped vehicle should be
    # placed relative to ego.
    ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle: int
    keep(default ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle == -1)
    keep(ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle == (gen_ego_lane_num-\
        stopped_vehicle_lane_num))

    # Reference int type for placing VRU (first and second positions)
    ref_pos_start: int
    keep(ref_pos_start in [-1,1])
    keep(gen_vru_heading_angle_start<180degree => ref_pos_start==1)
    keep(gen_vru_heading_angle_start>180degree => ref_pos_start==-1)

    ref_pos_end: int
    keep(ref_pos_end in [-1,1])  
    keep(gen_vru_heading_angle_end<180degree => ref_pos_end==1)
    keep(gen_vru_heading_angle_end>180degree => ref_pos_end==-1)

    # VRU msp positions
    # It is calculated with respect to VRU angle start and end
    vru_group_start_position: msp_position
    vru_group_first_position: msp_position 
    vru_group_sec_position: msp_position
    vru_group_end_position: msp_position

    # Distances covered by VRU
    vru_start_distance:length
    vru_sec_distance:length
    vru_end_distance:length


    # Get  the displacement distance for the object's movement
    # based on  the angle_between_vehicle_and_object
    move_distance_start: move_distance with:
        keep(it.angle_between_vehicle_and_object == gen_vru_heading_angle_start)
        keep(it.stopped_veh_width == stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2)
        keep(it.offset == gen_vru_offset)
        keep(it.stopped_veh_length == stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2)
    move_distance_end: move_distance with:
        keep(it.angle_between_vehicle_and_object == gen_vru_heading_angle_end)
        keep(it.stopped_veh_width == stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2)
        keep(it.offset == gen_vru_offset)
        keep(it.stopped_veh_length == stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2)

    keep(vru_group_position == stopped_vehicle_at_essence.calculated_position())
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
    # Positioning the stopped vehicle relative to ego drive
    top.position_along_drive(stopped_vehicle_position,drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru,
        lon_offset: ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle,
        lane_offset: ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle)

    keep(vru_group_start_position == vru_group_position.at_rotated_offset(\
        offset:move_distance_start.move_distance(),
         yaw: gen_vru_heading_angle_start))


    keep(vru_group_first_position == vru_group_position.at_offset_local( -1 *\
        (stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2 + gen_vru_offset) \
        ,ref_pos_start*(stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2 + gen_vru_offset),0m))

    keep(vru_group_sec_position == vru_group_position.at_offset_local( -1 *\
        (stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2 + gen_vru_offset), ref_pos_end*\
        (stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2 + gen_vru_offset),0m))

    keep(vru_group_end_position == vru_group_position.at_rotated_offset(\
        offset:move_distance_end.move_distance(),
         yaw: gen_vru_heading_angle_end))

    # Get the distances between VRU positions
    keep(vru_start_distance== map.abs_distance_between_positions
        (vru_group_start_position.road_position, 
          vru_group_first_position.road_position))

    keep(vru_sec_distance== map.abs_distance_between_positions
        (vru_group_first_position.road_position, 
          vru_group_sec_position.road_position))

    keep(vru_end_distance== map.abs_distance_between_positions
        (vru_group_sec_position.road_position, 
          vru_group_end_position.road_position))

    vru_group_start_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)

    vru_group_first_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)

    vru_group_sec_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)

    vru_group_end_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)


    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_start_position_params, vru_group,vru_group_start_position)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_first_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_first_position)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_sec_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_sec_position)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_end_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_end_position)

    # Event to check if the Ego passed stopped vehicle and the vru's 
    # destination position, both the condition are synced to the distance 
    # parameter 'ego_scenario_ends_distance'.
    event ego_passes_obstacle is @clock if (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(\
        stopped_vehicle_position.lane_position) < ego_scenario_ends_distance 
            and sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(vru_group_end_position.\
                lane_position) < ego_scenario_ends_distance )
    
    # since vru can not rotate in an instance we are calculating the duration of move based om the vru type
    # we assume that person/animal will rotate in around 90deg per sec and cyclist will rotate in 90 deg per sec 
    # the calculation below assumes that we need between 0-360 rotation angles
    vru_move_duration:time 
    keep(vru_group.objects_kind == cyclist => vru_move_duration in [9..10]s)
    keep(vru_group.objects_kind != cyclist => vru_move_duration in  [5..10]s)

    on @drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru.start: emit ego_drive_start
    on @drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru.end: emit ego_drive_end

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        # Scenario with parallel configuration
        phase_essence_vru_walking_around_stopped_omv: parallel(overlap:any,start_to_start:0s):
            # Phase where VRU appears and starts moving while Ego tries to drive
            phase_essence_ego_drive_with_vru: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru_start:\
                        speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru:\
                        keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru_start:\
                        lane(gen_ego_lane_num, at: start, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru:\
                        keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru: along(road, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_distance_at_essence_ego_drive_with_vru:\
                        distance(ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle+
                        sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2+50m,
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                
                phase_essence_vru_group_move: serial:
                    wait @vru_appear_event
                    vru_group_appear_at_essence_vru_group_move: call vru_group.appear(\
                        vru_group_start_position_params)
                    
                    wait elapsed(gen_vru_time_start)                                   
                    emit vru_group_move_start                    
                    # VRU Initial move
                    # The duration is determined based on the distance and vru_speed.
                    vru_group_first_move_at_essence_vru_group_move: vru_group.group_move(\
                        vru_group_first_position_params,
                        start_at_speed: false,
                        duration: vru_move_duration)
                    # VRU second move
                    vru_group_second_move_at_essence_vru_group_move: vru_group.group_move(\
                        vru_group_sec_position_params,
                        start_at_speed: false,
                        duration: vru_move_duration)
                    # VRU end move
                    vru_group_end_move_at_essence_vru_group_move: vru_group.group_move(\
                        vru_group_end_position_params,
                        start_at_speed: false,
                        duration: vru_move_duration)
                    emit vru_group_move_end
            stopped_vehicle_at_essence: stopped_vehicle.\
                    exists_at(stopped_vehicle_position) with:
                    intent_stopped_vehicle_rotation_at_essence: \
                        rotation(yaw: gen_stopped_vehicle_yaw)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration(duration_at_essence, 
                tolerance:duration_at_essence_tolerance) #the tolerance here is extended, to allow ego to do a bypass after a short halt
    
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_1: serial:
                wait @ego_passes_obstacle
                log_info("Ending scenario since ego drive passed stopped vehicle
                    and vru group")
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper_2: serial:
                wait @ego_stopped_for_time
                call logger.log_info("Ending scenario as Ego stopped for $(time_delay)")


# Set lights to green so that Ego does not stop for red light
extend sim_config:
    set default_tl_color = green

extend sut.vru_walking_around_stopped_omv_main:

    do phase_main: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_drive_ego_warm_up()
        
        phase_essence: vru_walking_around_stopped_omv()
        
        phase_post: ego_drive_post()

# Copyright (c) 2019-2020 Foretellix Ltd. All Rights Reserved.
# This scenario consists of common elements of vru_group_change_with_stopped_vehicle
# scenario. The two combinations of this scenario are
# 'vru_group_leaves_stopped_vehicle' and 'vru_group_enters_stopped_vehicle'.
# The common coverage and KPI are defined in the base scenario
# 'vru_group_change_with_stopped_vehicle'.
# 'Changing' in this scenario in the context of VRU means it is either
# entering or leaving from the stopped vehicle.

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/osc/utils/get_min_time_headway_common.osc"

# Enum definition for categorizing the inherited scenario
enum vru_group_change_kind: [leaving, entering]

# Enum definition for side of ego where stopped vehicle is placed
enum stopped_vehicle_side: [right, left]

# Enum definition to be able to select side of VRU changing at stopped vehicle
enum vru_group_side_type: [right, left]

# Main scenario definition
scenario sut.vru_group_change_with_stopped_vehicle inherits adjacent_vrus_family_base:


    keep(default scenario_str == "vru_group_change_with_stopped_vehicle")

    # scenario kind
    scenario_kind: vru_group_change_kind

    # Defined a plain object of kind stationary vehicle
    # Defined it to be of sedan category as per spec
    stopped_vehicle: stationary_vehicle

    # VRU definition of kind animal or person
    vru_group: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(it.objects_kind in [animal, person])
        keep(it.objects.size() == gen_number_of_vrus)
        
    gen_number_of_vrus: int with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_group_size)

    # Side of stopped vehicle where vru changes
    gen_vru_group_side: vru_group_side_type
    keep(default gen_vru_group_side == left)

    #VRU's move speed
    # Constrained as per spec
    gen_vru_group_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in  ftlx_lib_base_config.default_person_speed_range)
   
    # Distance between ego and stopped vehicle when VRU starts moving
    # Constrained as per spec
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle: time with :
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_larger_time_gap_to_vehicle )

    # Ego lane number from center of the map
    gen_ego_lane_num: int with: 
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_lanes_range)
   
    # Stopped vehicle lane number from center of the map
    gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num: int with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_lanes_range)

    # Distance moved by the VRU
    # Added a default constraint of 15m to make sure it crosses the road
    gen_vru_group_move_distance: length with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vru_movie_distance)

    # VRU heading angle while moving from stopped vehicle
    # Constrained as per spec
    gen_vru_group_heading_angle: angle with:

extend sut.vru_group_leaves_stopped_vehicle:
    
     #  Road element definition
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes >= 2)

    keep(vru_group_dist_from_stopped_vehicle_at_start == 2m)

    # Duration to be multiple of step time
    # The move time of the VRU has to be a multiple of simulation step time
    # So make constraining it to be that using actual value
    
    keep(default actual_vru_group_move_time in [vru_group_move_time..vru_group_move_time + config.test.step_time - 1ms])

    # Duration in which VRU has to move from start to end of it's drive
    # From 'vru_group_start_position' to 'vru_group_dest_position'
    # Constrained it to be equal to time=distance/speed
    # So here it is gen_vru_group_move_distance/gen_vru_group_speed
    vru_group_move_time: time
    keep(vru_group_move_time * gen_vru_group_speed == gen_vru_group_move_distance)

    keep(vru_group_position == stopped_vehicle_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves.calculated_position())
    keep(vru_group.objects_kind in [animal, person])

    keep(gen_duration_at_essence in [10..20]s)
    keep(gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence == 5s)
    
    #junction_behavior_disable
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

    # Stopped vehicle msp position
    stopped_vehicle_position: msp_position

    speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)
        
    keep(gen_ego_lane_num < gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num => vru_move_yaw ==\
        gen_vru_group_heading_angle)
    keep(gen_ego_lane_num > gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num => vru_move_yaw ==(180degree-\
        gen_vru_group_heading_angle))
    keep(gen_ego_lane_num != gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num)

    # VRU start msp position
    # It is calculated with respect to 'vru_group_position',
    # depending on the VRU whether it is leaving or entering the
    # stopped vehicle the msp position is calculated.
    vru_group_start_position: msp_position

    # VRU destination msp position
    # It is calculated with respect to 'vru_group_position',
    # depending on the VRU whether it is leaving or entering the
    # stopped vehicle the msp position is calculated.
    vru_group_dest_position: msp_position

    # How many lanes is stopped vehicle away from ego lane
    # Added a default constraint of 1 lane.
    # It is a subtraction of ego lane number and stopped vehicle lane number
    # The difference gives how many lanes apart the stopped vehicle should be
    # placed relative to ego.
    ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle: int
    keep(default ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle == -1)
    keep(default ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle == (gen_ego_lane_num-\
        gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num))

    # Ego initial drive time to approach distance
    # Constrained as per spec
    ego_time_dist_to_approach_dist_start: time
    keep(default ego_time_dist_to_approach_dist_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    # Reference to place VRU either on the left or right of the stopped vehicle
    # Constrained relative to the input value of 'gen_vru_group_side'
    vru_group_side_ref: int
    keep(vru_group_side_ref in [-1,1])
    keep(gen_vru_group_side== left => vru_group_side_ref == 1)
    keep(gen_vru_group_side== right => vru_group_side_ref == -1)

    # Ego reached the stopped_vehicle distance parameter
    # When the ego's rear is at exactly same as stopped vehicle front
    # periphery assuming stopped vehicle is placed at 0 degree yaw
    # the method 'distance_to_point_along_path' gives a distance equal to
    # 'sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 + stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2'. So using
    # the same distance as reference with a addition of 10m to make sure that
    # ego drive passed stopped vehicle.
    ego_scenario_ends_distance: length
    keep(ego_scenario_ends_distance == -1*(sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 +
        stopped_vehicle.get_length()/2 + 10m))

    # Reference int type for placing stopped vehicle - linked
    # to position along drive parameter
    move_ref: int
    keep(gen_ego_lane_num < gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num => move_ref == 1)
    keep(gen_ego_lane_num > gen_stopped_vehicle_lane_num => move_ref == -1)

    # VRU's msp position
    # Constrained it to be a calculated msp position relative to stopped
    # vehicle msp position
    vru_group_position: msp_position

    ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle: length
    keep(default ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle == 
        (gen_ego_time_gap_to_stopped_vehicle * gen_ego_speed_at_start))

    # Positioning the stopped vehicle relative to ego drive
    top.position_along_drive(stopped_vehicle_position,
        drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move,
        lon_offset: ego_lon_dist_to_stopped_vehicle,
        lane_offset: ego_rel_lane_offset_to_stopped_vehicle)
    
    keep(vru_group_dest_position == vru_group_position.at_rotated_offset(\
        offset:move_ref*\
        (gen_vru_group_move_distance + stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2+\
        vru_group_dist_from_stopped_vehicle_at_start) ,
         yaw: vru_move_yaw))
    
    keep(vru_group_start_position == vru_group_position.at_offset_local(\
        0m,vru_group_side_ref*\
        (stopped_vehicle.get_width()/2 \
        + vru_group_dist_from_stopped_vehicle_at_start),0m))
        
    vru_group_start_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset==-1.5m)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset==1.5m)

    vru_group_dest_position_params: plain_object_group_position_params with:
        keep(default it.max_distance_between_objects==1m)
        keep(default it.min_lat_offset==-1.5m)
        keep(default it.max_lat_offset==1.5m)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_start_position_params, vru_group,vru_group_start_position)

    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(\
        vru_group_dest_position_params, vru_group, vru_group_dest_position)

    # Event to check if the Ego passed stopped vehicle and the vru's 
    # destination position, both the condition are synced to the distance 
    # parameter 'ego_scenario_ends_distance'.
    event scenario_ends is @clock if (sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(\
        stopped_vehicle_position.lane_position) < ego_scenario_ends_distance 
            and sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(vru_group_dest_position.\
                lane_position) < ego_scenario_ends_distance )

    on @phase_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves.start:
        if(vru_group.objects[0].state != null) :
            emit vru_group_moves_start

    on @phase_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves.end:
        emit vru_group_moves_end

    do phase_essence: first_of:

        phase_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves: parallel (overlap: equal):
            
            drive_ego_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move_start:\ 
                    speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, 
                    tolerance: speed_tolerance, 
                    at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move: \
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move_start: \
                    lane(gen_ego_lane_num, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move:\
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_move:\
                    along(road)
    
            
            phase_essence_vru_group_move: serial:

                vru_group_appear_at_essence_vru_group_move: call vru_group.appear(\
                    vru_group_start_position_params)

                wait elapsed(gen_vru_group_change_time)

                vru_group_move_at_essence_vru_group_move: vru_group.group_move(\
                    vru_group_dest_position_params,
                    start_at_speed:false) with:
                        intent_essence_duration_at_essence_vru_group_move: \
                            duration(actual_vru_group_move_time,
                            tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

            stopped_vehicle_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves: stopped_vehicle.\
                exists_at(stopped_vehicle_position) with:
                intent_stopped_vehicle_rotation_at_essence: \
                    rotation(yaw: gen_stopped_vehicle_yaw)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: \
                duration(gen_duration_at_essence_ego_drive_while_vru_group_moves,\
                    tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)
        
            
        # Scenario stopping event is passed here to wait
        # Once the event occurs, the scenario stops.
        phase_essence_scenario_stopper: serial:
            wait @scenario_ends
            log_info("Ending scenario since ego drive passed stopped vehicle
                and vru group")

# Disable vru_behavior to allow continuous VRU movement, the VRU crosses
# the road without stopping.
extend vru_driver:
    keep(default vru_behavior.enable == false)


extend sut.vru_group_change_with_stopped_vehicle_main :
    
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes >= 2)

    keep(default phase_ego_warm_up.gen_duration_tolerance_at_ego_warm_up in [3..5]s)

    do phase_main: serial:
        phase_ego_warm_up: ego_drive_ego_warm_up()
        phase_essence: vru_group_leaves_stopped_vehicle()
        phase_post: ego_drive_post()

    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        intent_ego_distance_at_ego_warm_up: distance([10..]m)
        intent_ego_along_at_ego_warm_up: along(outer.road)

# In this scenario, a VRU Group walks on the oncoming road in case of 
# a bidirectional road (or on the innermost side in case of absence of 
# oncoming road). The VRU Group can travel in the same direction as 
# Ego or in opposite direction.
#
# In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . vru_kind: The kind of VRU (person, cyclist)
#    . gen_vru_speed: Speed of VRU 
#    . ego_lane: Lane of Ego on the road (rightmost, leftmost, middle)
#    . gen_ego_speed_at_start: Speed of Ego at start 
#    . gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start: Longitudinal distance between Ego 
#      and VRU (in seconds) when the VRU starts moving 
#    . gen_vru_move_duration: Duration the VRU moves 
#    . random_traffic_count: Traffic (neighbor_vehicle_group) count around 
#      Ego 
#    . vru_group_count: Number of VRUs in the VRU Group 
#    . gen_vru_approach_kind: VRU group approach kind with respect to Ego
#    . gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road: VRU group relative angle to road when crossing
#    . gen_vru_travel: VRU group crossing distance

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/common/ego_with_traffic_on_side/ego_with_traffic_on_side_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"

enum vru_travel_type: [without_crossing, with_crossing]
enum approach_kind: [along, oncoming]
enum scenario_variant_type: [farside, nearside]

scenario sut.vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing inherits generic_base_scenario:

    gen_scenario_variant: scenario_variant_type

    gen_vru_approach_kind: approach_kind with:
        keep(default it == along)

    # The VRU either crosses or does not cross
    gen_vru_travel: vru_travel_type with:
        keep(default it in [without_crossing, with_crossing])

    gen_vru_group_count: int
    keep(default gen_vru_group_count in [1..5])
    # The VRU group
    gen_vru_kind: object_kind
    keep(default gen_vru_kind in [person, cyclist])
    vru_group: common_plain_object_group with:
        keep(it.objects.size() == gen_vru_group_count)
        keep(it.objects_kind == gen_vru_kind)

    # Ego and VRU start speed
    gen_vru_speed: speed with:
        keep(it in [0..25]kph)

    # Longitudinal distance between Ego and VRU (in seconds) 
    gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_wider_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_vru_rel_lat_pos_to_lane_marking: int with:
        keep(default it in [-10..110])
    
    # Distance the VRU moves - Internal variable
    vru_move_distance: length with:
        keep(default it in [5..]meter)

    # Duration of VRU move
    gen_vru_move_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [3..30]second)    

    # VRU start and end position
    vru_start_position: msp_position
    vru_end_position: msp_position
    vru_end_position_cross: msp_position

    # VRU farside start and end position
    vru_farside_start_position: msp_position
    vru_farside_end_position: msp_position

    # VRU leftmost start and end position projection
    vru_leftmost_start_position: msp_position
    vru_leftmost_end_position: msp_position

    # VRU oncoming road start and end position
    vru_oncoming_start_position: msp_position
    vru_oncoming_end_position: msp_position
    vru_oncoming_end_cross_position: msp_position

    # Road definition
    road_with_lanes: one_way_road 
    road_length: length
    keep(road_length == road_with_lanes.length)

    # Duration for which VRU Group stays still after moving along road
    vru_still_duration: time with:
        keep(default it == [0..3]s)

    # Duration of VRU Group standstill before crossing
    # The upper bound is fixed at 10s to be used when gen_vru_travel == without_crossing 
    # For gen_vru_travel == with_crossing the value is 0s
    vru_still_duration_without_crossing: time with:
        keep(default it == [0..10]s)
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (without_crossing) => \
        (vru_still_duration_without_crossing == 10s))
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (with_crossing) => \
        (vru_still_duration_without_crossing == 0s))

    # Relative VRU move angle to road definition
    gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road: angle with:
        keep(default it in [10..170]degree)

    # Relative VRU move angle to road definition
    vru_group_rel_angle_to_ego_path: angle

    # Length parameter for VRU, which defines distance moved by VRU from
    # start position when crossing
    vru_group_move_dist: length

    # gen_vru_travel without_crossing
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (without_crossing) => \
        vru_group_move_dist == 0m)

    # gen_vru_travel with_crossing
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (with_crossing) => \
        vru_group_move_dist in [20..25]m)

extend issue_kind: [vru_behind_ego_at_start_error]
# avoiding bypass behavior since VRUs are moving and it may cause collisions
extend vehicle:
    keep(ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing:

    event vru_group_moves_start
    event vru_group_moves_end

    # VRU move distance
    keep(vru_move_distance == (gen_vru_move_duration * gen_vru_speed))

    # Longitudinal end position of VRU. Depending on gen_vru_approach_kind
    # The value of lon_pos_of_vru_at_end and lon_pos_of_vru_at_start
    # Are farthest or nearest on the road_with_lanes
    lon_pos_of_vru_at_start: length
    lon_pos_of_vru_at_end: length
    keep(gen_vru_approach_kind == along => lon_pos_of_vru_at_end == \
        lon_pos_of_vru_at_start + vru_move_distance)
    keep(gen_vru_approach_kind == oncoming => lon_pos_of_vru_at_end == \
        lon_pos_of_vru_at_start - vru_move_distance)

    # Constraint to keep VRU position within road length
    keep(lon_pos_of_vru_at_start > 0m)
    keep(lon_pos_of_vru_at_start < road_length)
    keep(lon_pos_of_vru_at_end > 0m)
    keep(lon_pos_of_vru_at_end < road_length)

    # Constraint between gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start and gen_vru_move_duration
    # When the VRU Group is oncoming
    keep(gen_vru_approach_kind == oncoming => gen_vru_move_duration + vru_still_duration <= \
        (0.5*gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start))
    keep(gen_vru_approach_kind == along => gen_vru_move_duration + vru_still_duration <= \
        gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start)

    # Lane width hard coded
    lane_width_at_vru_start_pos: length
    keep(lane_width_at_vru_start_pos == 3.5m)

    # Lateral offset of VRU from center of rightmost lane
    lat_offset_of_vru_at_start: length with:
        keep(it == (-0.5 * lane_width_at_vru_start_pos) + \
            (gen_vru_rel_lat_pos_to_lane_marking * lane_width_at_vru_start_pos / 100))

    # VRU Group crossing duration
    vru_group_cross_duration: time

    # gen_vru_travel without_crossing, duration is 0s
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (without_crossing) => \
        (vru_group_cross_duration == 3s))

    # gen_vru_travel with_crossing
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (with_crossing) => \
        (vru_group_cross_duration == vru_group_move_dist/gen_vru_speed))

    # The post_drive_duration has gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start seconds added to
    # take into account Ego coming to standstill 
    post_drive_duration: time
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (with_crossing) => \
        (post_drive_duration == gen_vru_move_duration + vru_still_duration + vru_group_cross_duration + gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start))
    keep(gen_vru_travel == (without_crossing) => \
        (post_drive_duration == gen_vru_move_duration + vru_still_duration + vru_still_duration_without_crossing))

    # Sample time gap between EGO and VRU
    # Value is 10000s if ego state is null or speed == 0mps
    # To avoid false start of VRU
    var ego_time_to_meet_vru: time = sample(
        (sut.car.state == null or sut.car.state.speed == 0mps) ? 10000s :
            sut.car.get_time_gap(vru_group.objects[ego_nearest_vru_id]),
        @top.clk)
    set ego_time_to_meet_vru = 10000s

    # Variable - Ego distance to VRU Group
    var ego_distance_to_vru: length = sample(sut.car.distance_to_point_along_path(\
        vru_start_position.lane_position), @top.clk)

    # Event to trigger VRU Group movement
    # Trigger when VRU Group is less than gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start second
    # ahead of EGO or less than ego_distance_to_vru meter
    event move_trigger_event is (not vru_move_started and (ego_time_to_meet_vru < \
        gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start)) or (not vru_move_started and (ego_distance_to_vru < 4m)) \
        or (not vru_move_started and ego_stopped_for_standstill_duration)

    # The below internal state variable 'vru_group_cross' is added to make sure the 
    # VRU Group does not execute the Crossing maneuver after traveling along road
    # In 'without_crossing' variant
    vru_group_cross: bool
    keep(gen_vru_travel == with_crossing => vru_group_cross == true)
    keep(gen_vru_travel == without_crossing => vru_group_cross == false)

    # Event to trigger VRU Group crossing movement
    var vru_move_started: bool = sample(true, @move_trigger_event)
    var vru_move_start_time: time = sample(top.time, rise(vru_move_started))
    event cross_trigger_event is vru_group_cross == true and \
        top.time >= vru_move_start_time + gen_vru_move_duration + vru_still_duration + vru_still_duration_without_crossing

    # VRU Group position parameters at end position
    vru_group_end_pos_params: plain_object_group_position_params
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_params.max_distance_between_objects == 1m)
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_params.max_lat_offset == 1.5m)
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_params.min_lat_offset == -1.5m)

    # VRU Group position parameters at end position
    vru_group_end_pos_cross_params: plain_object_group_position_params
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_cross_params.max_distance_between_objects == 1m)
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_cross_params.max_lat_offset == 1.5m)
    keep(default vru_group_end_pos_cross_params.min_lat_offset == -1.5m)

    # VRU Group position parameters at start position
    vru_group_start_pos_params: plain_object_group_position_params
    keep(default vru_group_start_pos_params.max_distance_between_objects == 1m)
    keep(default vru_group_start_pos_params.max_lat_offset == 1.5m)
    keep(default vru_group_start_pos_params.min_lat_offset == -1.5m)

    # Main scenario Block - Checks for the conditions in serial blocks below
    # the first serial block
    do first_of:
        # Serial scenario block consisting of the scenario phases defining the
        # Vehicle and VRU behaviors
        parallel:
            serial:
            # Initial scenario phase where the Ego and neighbor_vehicle (and
            # group) start
                initial_phase: serial:
                    ego_init_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
                        speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph], \
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                        keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                with:
                    initial_duration: duration([4..8]s, tolerance: 2s)

                # Ego drive (vru_group_traveling_along_road phase) start and
                # VRU Group start at same time
                vru_group_traveling_along_road: serial:
                    ego_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
                        speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph],\
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                        # The start_offset is assigned range of distance, Lower bound is
                        # 0.9*lon_pos_of_vru_at_end.
                        along(road_with_lanes, at: end, start_offset: \
                            [0.9*lon_pos_of_vru_at_start..lon_pos_of_vru_at_start],
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                        keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                with:
                    duration([gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start..(1.1*gen_ego_rel_time_gap_to_vru_at_start)], tolerance: 1s)

                # Post drive phase to extend the planned path
                ego_post_drive: serial:
                    sut.car.drive() with:
                        speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-2kph..gen_ego_speed_at_start+2kph],\
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                        keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                with:
                    duration(post_drive_duration, tolerance: 1s)

            adjacent_traffic_scenario: sut.ego_with_traffic_on_side() with:
                keep(road_with_lanes.max_lanes == 1 => \
                    it.traffic_group.occupy_reference_car_lane == true)

            # VRU starts moving after the move_trigger_event
            vru_behavior: serial:
                wait @move_trigger_event
                call logger.log_info("move trigger event")
                # The duration of vru_move is assigned to range of values
                # Between 0.95*gen_vru_move_duration and gen_vru_move_duration to
                # Avoid incomplete scenarios (where the VRU stops moving when
                # The end of road is reached)
                emit vru_group_moves_start
                vru_move: vru_group.group_move(vru_group_end_pos_params, \
                    duration: [0.95*gen_vru_move_duration..gen_vru_move_duration], \
                    start_position_params: vru_group_start_pos_params)
                emit vru_group_moves_end

                wait @cross_trigger_event
                call logger.log_info("cross trigger event")
                vru_move_cross: vru_group.group_move(vru_group_end_pos_cross_params,
                    duration: [0.9*vru_group_cross_duration..vru_group_cross_duration], start_at_speed: false)

        # Scenario ends after Ego ahead of VRU Group
        serial:
            wait @ego_ahead_of_vru
            log_info("$(self): Ending scenario after Ego ahead of VRU.")

        # Scenario ends after Ego follows VRU Group for follow_time
        serial:
            wait @ego_following_vru_for_ego_follow_vru_time
            log_info("$(self): Ending scenario after Ego follows VRU for " +
                "a time of $(ego_follow_vru_time).")

        # Scenario marked as invalid if the VRU Group placed behind Ego
        serial:
            wait @vru_behind_ego_at_start_event
            call top.scenario_completion_error(vru_behind_ego_at_start_error,
                "VRU behind Ego at start of scenario")


# Map function to find intermediate points between two msp positions divided into equal number of
# sections defined by "from" and select the point at number "ind"
extend map:
    def get_intermediate_position(start: msp_position, end: msp_position, ind: uint, from: uint)-> msp_position is:
        var start_coord := start.global_position.coord
        var end_coord := end.global_position.coord
        var dist := start_coord.distance(end_coord)
        var ang := start_coord.angle_to(end_coord)
        var step: length = (dist / (from+1)) * ind
        var coord := start_coord.get_point_at(step, ang)
        var lane_poss := global_to_lane_coordinates(coord, 1m)
        if(lane_poss.size() > 0):
            return lane_poss[0].to_msp_position()
        return null

# Map function to find if there is no oncoming road
extend map:
    def no_oncoming(start: msp_position, end: msp_position, start_1: msp_position, end_1: msp_position)-> bool is:
        var start_coord := start.global_position.coord
        var end_coord := end.global_position.coord
        var dist := start_coord.distance(end_coord)
        var start_coord_1 := start_1.global_position.coord
        var end_coord_1 := end_1.global_position.coord
        var dist_1 := start_coord_1.distance(end_coord_1)
        var tolerance: length = 1.2m
        var no_oncoming_var : bool = (dist < tolerance) and (dist_1 < tolerance)
        return no_oncoming_var

# The nearside variant has the VRU Group positioned with respect to the rightmost lane.
# The possible positions are the width of right lane and 10% of width outside the lane
# boundaries on both sides
scenario sut.vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing_nearside inherits \
        vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing(gen_scenario_variant == nearside):

    keep(vru_group_rel_angle_to_ego_path == gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road)

    # The msp_position of start, end and end of crossing
    vru_start_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_start_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_start,
        lat_offset: lat_offset_of_vru_at_start, rightmost_lane: true)
    vru_end_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_end_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_end,
        lat_offset: lat_offset_of_vru_at_start, rightmost_lane: true)
    keep(vru_end_position_cross == vru_end_position.at_rotated_offset( \
        offset: vru_group_move_dist, yaw: gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road))

    # Assigning the positon paramters and position to vru_group
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_end_pos_params,\
        vru_group, vru_end_position)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_start_pos_params,\
        vru_group, vru_start_position)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_end_pos_cross_params,\
        vru_group, vru_end_position_cross)


# The farside variant has the VRU Group positioned on the oncoming road (or on the
# innermost side in case of absence of oncoming road)
scenario sut.vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing_farside inherits \
        vru_group_traveling_along_road_with_optional_crossing(gen_scenario_variant == farside):

    # The msp_position of VRU Group start and end positions
    vru_start_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_start_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_start,
        lat_offset: -1m, rightmost_lane: true)
    vru_end_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_end_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_end,
        lat_offset: -1m, rightmost_lane: true)

    # The msp_position of VRU Group start and end positions on leftmost lane
    vru_start_leftmost_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_leftmost_start_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_start,
        lat_offset: 1m, leftmost_lane: true)
    vru_end_leftmost_position_along_road: top.position_along_road(vru_leftmost_end_position,
        road_with_lanes, lon_offset: lon_pos_of_vru_at_end,
        lat_offset: 1m, leftmost_lane: true)

    # The msp_position of VRU Group start and end positions on the edge of oncoming road (if present)
    vru_farside_start_position_along_road: top.get_crossing_position(in_position: vru_start_position,
        out_position: vru_farside_start_position)
    vru_farside_end_position_along_road: top.get_crossing_position(in_position: vru_end_position,
        out_position: vru_farside_end_position)

    # The number of equal divisions on the oncoming road (if present)
    max_index: uint with:
        keep(default it == 20)

    # The integer index to select a point on equal divisions (max_index) oncoming road (if present)
    index: uint with:
        keep(default it in [1..max_index])

    # Constraint to make sure the invalid index value returns an error
    keep(index <= max_index)

    # The msp_position of VRU Group start and end positions on the oncoming road (if present)
    keep(vru_oncoming_start_position == map.get_intermediate_position(start: vru_leftmost_start_position, \
        end: vru_farside_start_position, ind: index, from: max_index))
    keep(vru_oncoming_end_position == map.get_intermediate_position(start: vru_leftmost_end_position, \
        end: vru_farside_end_position, ind: index, from: max_index))
    keep(map.no_oncoming(start: vru_leftmost_end_position, end: vru_farside_end_position, \
        start_1: vru_leftmost_start_position, end_1: vru_farside_start_position) == true => \
        vru_group_rel_angle_to_ego_path == 360degree - gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road)
    keep(map.no_oncoming(start: vru_leftmost_end_position, end: vru_farside_end_position, \
        start_1: vru_leftmost_start_position, end_1: vru_farside_start_position) == false => \
        vru_group_rel_angle_to_ego_path == gen_vru_group_rel_angle_to_road)
    keep(vru_oncoming_end_cross_position == vru_oncoming_end_position.at_rotated_offset( \
        offset: vru_group_move_dist, yaw: vru_group_rel_angle_to_ego_path))

    # Assigning the positon paramters and position to vru_group
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_end_pos_params,\
        vru_group, vru_oncoming_end_position)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_start_pos_params,\
        vru_group, vru_oncoming_start_position)
    top.plain_object_group_position_along_ref_position(vru_group_end_pos_cross_params,\
        vru_group, vru_oncoming_end_cross_position)

# sut::vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations
# In this scenario the Ego, follow_vehicle_1, and lead_vehicle form a 
# group that drive along a path within the same lane towards a 
# forced_merge_location. The Merge vehicle attempts to merge into a gap 
# from the forced merge location to ahead of the Ego. Forced merge 
# locations are locations, where vehicles need to merge onto an adjacent 
# lane and/or into adjacent traffic as they are prevented from continuing 
# on the same lane or path. These locations include lane endings, 
# highway on-ramp, road_split or ramp exit.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    gen_ego_speed_at_start (Ego speed at start [0..150]kph)
#    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start (Ego time gap to forced 
#    merged location at start [4..25]s)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_speed (Merge vehicle speed [0..150]kph)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start (Lead vehicle relative 
#    speed to  Ego at start [-20..20]kph)
#    gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start (Lead vehicle time gap to 
#    Ego at start [3..15]s)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start 
#    (Lead vehicle time 
#    gap to forced merge location at merge phase start [1..5]s)
#    lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_merge_phase_start 
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to Ego at merge phase start [1..5]s)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_initial_phase 
#    (follow vehicle time gap to ego at initial phase [1..5]s)
#    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego (follow vehicle time 
#    gap to ego maintained in merge 
#    and post merge phase [1..3]s)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type(Merge vehicle conspicuity  
#    [no_lights, left_indicator_on, 
#    right_indicator_on, hazard_lights_on])
#    gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start
#    The merge_vehicle lon lane distance to start of merge location
#    at start

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/common/ego_with_traffic_on_side/ego_with_traffic_on_side_top.osc"

enum conspicuity_state_list: [no_lights, left_indicator_on, \
    right_indicator_on, hazard_lights_on]
enum merge_vehicle_merge_location_between_vehicles_list: [\
    merged_behind_follow_vehicle, merged_behind_lead_vehicle, 
        merged_behind_ego, merged_ahead_lead_vehicle,
        merge_vehicle_did_not_merge]
enum ego_merge_location_between_vehicles_list: [\
    ego_merge_behind_lead_vehicle, 
    ego_merge_ahead_lead_vehicle, ego_merge_behind_follow_vehicle_1, 
    ego_merge_behind_follow_vehicle_2]

scenario sut.vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations inherits generic_base_scenario:

    # Type of merge location between vehicles
    merge_vehicle_merge_location_between_vehicles: \
        merge_vehicle_merge_location_between_vehicles_list
    ego_merge_location_between_vehicles: \
        ego_merge_location_between_vehicles_list

    # Ego attributes
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start)

    # Distance from forced merge location calculation (distance = speed * time)
    ego_distance_to_merge_location_at_start: length
    keep(ego_distance_to_merge_location_at_start in \
            [(gen_ego_speed_at_start*gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start - 0.1m)..\
            (gen_ego_speed_at_start*gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start + 0.1m)])

    
    # Lead vehicle attributes
    lead_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start: speed
    keep(default gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start in [-20..20]kph)
    lead_vehicle_speed: speed
    keep(lead_vehicle_speed in [gen_ego_speed_at_start - \
        gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start..gen_ego_speed_at_start + \
        gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start])
    gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_start)
    lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start: length
    keep(lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start in \
            [(lead_vehicle_speed*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start - \
            lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)..\
            (lead_vehicle_speed*gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start + \
            lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)])
    
    # Merge vehicle attributes
    merge_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start: length 
    keep(default gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start in [200..400]m)
    gen_merge_vehicle_speed: speed
    keep(default gen_merge_vehicle_speed in [0..150]kph)
    # Merge vehicle conspicuity
    gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type: conspicuity_state_list with:
        keep(soft it == no_lights)
    hazard_light_type: av_state with:
        keep(soft it == off)
    turn_signal_state: turn_signal_state with:
        keep(soft it == off)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        hazard_lights_on => hazard_light_type == active)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        left_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == left_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        right_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == right_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        no_lights => (turn_signal_state == off and \
            hazard_light_type == off))

    # follow vehicle 1 attributes   
    follow_vehicle_1: vehicle
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_initial_phase: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_initial_phase in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start: speed
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start in [-20..20]kph)

    # Car group followed by follow_vehicle_2 attributes
    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_merge_car_group: int with:
        keep(default it in [1..5])
    merge_vehicle_group: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: merge_vehicle):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_merge_car_group)
    
    # Road attributes
    road_to_force_merge_location: road_to_force_merge

extend sim_config:

extend vehicle:

    keep(ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations:

    # Offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 20m)
    distance_tolerance: length
    keep(default distance_tolerance == 20m)
    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset)
    time_offset: time
    keep(default time_offset == 2s)
    merge_vehicle_distance_offset: length
    keep(default merge_vehicle_distance_offset == 40m)

    ego_lon_distance_to_vehicle: length

    merge_vehicle_group_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the merge_vehicle_group vehicles
    # merge_vehicle_group_time_gap is 
    # the TTC provided to car_group which maintains it
    # throughout the scenario
    for member in merge_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == \
            merge_vehicle_group_time_gap)

    # Driver model is provided to car group which will be
    # aggressive in changing lane
    aggresive_driver_model:  ftx_group_driver_model
    for vehicle in merge_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == aggresive_driver_model)
    keep(aggresive_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)

    # Speed to car group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle_1
    # and follow_vehicle_2
    keep(aggresive_driver_model.target_speed in \
        [gen_merge_vehicle_speed - speed_offset..
            gen_merge_vehicle_speed+ speed_offset])
    keep(aggresive_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 100)

    # The Ego will be compared with this value and if 
    # Ego being slower than standstill_threshold for longer than 10s
    # then the scenario will end
    time_delay: time with:
        keep(default it == 10s)
    
    standstill_threshold: speed with:
        keep(default it == 2kph)

    # Ego state is not null
    event clock is (sut.car.state != null)

    # The Event checks the following:
    # 1. Egos speed is less than standstill_threshold
    # 2. Egos previous state was not null and also prev state speed 
    # was greater than standstill_threshold to ensure that timer should reset if Ego 
    # speed goes above standstill_threshold after slowing.
    event ego_stopped is @clock if (sut.car.state.speed < standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed > standstill_threshold)

    var ego_stopped_time: time = sample(top.time, @ego_stopped)
    var ego_stopped_bool: bool = sample(true, @ego_stopped)
    set ego_stopped_bool = false
    
    # Ego stopped event
    # Checks if Ego is slower than standstill_threshold for a delay of 'time_delay'
    event scenario_stopper is @clock if (ego_stopped_bool == true and top.time \
        > (ego_stopped_time + time_delay))

    # Event to reset the timer once Ego speeds up after slowing down
    event ego_stops_and_moves is @clock if (sut.car.state.speed > standstill_threshold \
        and sut.car.prev_state != null 
        and sut.car.prev_state.speed < standstill_threshold)
    
    on @ego_stops_and_moves:
        set ego_stopped_time = 0s
        set ego_stopped_bool = false

    lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_merge_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in [0..5]s)

    do vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations: first_of:
        serial():
            # In this phase the Ego drives with the defined speed as
            # gen_ego_speed_at_start and having a time gap from forced merge location with
            # gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start. The merge_vehicle drives with the
            # speed specified by gen_merge_vehicle_speed throughout the phase
            # and travels distance of 
            # gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start
            # and tries to reach at force_merge_offset_from_end. 
            # The lead_vehicle drives
            # ahead of Ego in same lane with the relative speed to Ego by
            # lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start and maintains the time gap
            # from Ego by gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start.
            # The follow_vehicle_1 drives in the same lane behind the Ego
            # with a relative time gap of gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_initial_phase
            # and a relative speed of gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start.
            # Throughout the phase it follows the Ego and aims to keep a constant
            # distance above gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego
            phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_ego_warm_up: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_distance_to_merge_at_ego_warm_up: distance([(ego_distance_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(ego_distance_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(lead_vehicle_speed, at: start, tolerance: speed_offset)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_position_to_ego_at_ego_warm_up: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest, 
                            time_tolerance: time_offset)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_position_to_merge_at_ego_warm_up: position(time: lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_merge_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase, 
                        ahead_of: merge_vehicle, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_merge_vehicle_distance_at_ego_warm_up: distance([(gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    tolerance: merge_vehicle_distance_offset)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_merge_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(gen_merge_vehicle_speed, at: start)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_speed_at_ego_warm_up: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_merge_vehicle_along_road_at_ego_warm_up: along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                    start_offset: [10..20]m,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_group_at_ego_warm_up: merge_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_follow_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up: position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_initial_phase, 
                        behind: sut.car, at: start)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start - gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start ..\
                        gen_ego_speed_at_start +\
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start], at: start)
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ max_merge_vehicle_speed)..\
                # 2 * (max_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ max_merge_vehicle_speed)]
                # This will ensure that Merge vehicle travels the distance and reach at start_offset of 
                # road_to_force_merge_location
                intent_phase_ego_warm_up_duration: duration(default [5..20]s, tolerance: 10s) 

            #Conspicuity state of Merge vehicle
            intent_merge_vehicle_hazard_lights: merge_vehicle.turn_hazard_lights_state(hazard_light_type)
            intent_merge_vehicle_turn_signal: merge_vehicle.turn_signal_lights_state(turn_signal_state)

            # At the start of this phase the Ego, follow_vehicle_1, 
            # lead_vehicle and the merge_vehicle
            # approach the merging location from different paths/lanes.
            # At the end of the phase, the merge_vehicle merges into the lane of Ego.
            phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_road_at_essence: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_essence: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start, end_offset:
                        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start, 
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence: position(time: lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego_at_merge_phase_start,
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_essence: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_merge_vehicle_along_road_at_essence: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_speed_at_essence: speed(gen_merge_vehicle_speed,run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_group_at_essence: merge_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_essence: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_follow_vehicle_position_at_essence: position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_ego, behind: sut.car, 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                intent_phase_essence_duration: duration([3..15]s, tolerance: 5s)

            # In this phase the merge vehicle maintains the position behind the lead vehicle and
            # all other traffic continues the drive
            phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_post: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    #Continue same speed for this complete phase
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_post: speed(lead_vehicle_speed, tolerance: speed_offset, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_post: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_group_at_post: merge_vehicle_group.group_drive()
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_post: follow_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            with:
                intent_phase_post_duration: duration([1..5]s, tolerance: 5s)

        scenario_end: serial():
            wait @scenario_stopper
            log_info("Ego speed was slower than $(standstill_threshold) for +\
                longer than $(time_delay)")

# This scenario runs with traffic on side of merge_vehicle
# Input: number_of_vehicles_in_side_traffic_group
scenario sut.vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations_with_traffic_on_side:
    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_side_traffic_group: int with:
        keep(default it in [1..10])
    
    keep(ego_with_traffic_on_side_essence.traffic_group_size == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_side_traffic_group)

    do parallel(overlap: equal):
        vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations_essence: sut.vehicle_merge_at_characteristic_forced_merge_locations()
        ego_with_traffic_on_side_essence: sut.ego_with_traffic_on_side()

# sut::ego_approach_mobile_operation
# In this scenario, the shadow_vehicle_1 and work_vehicle
# are placed on leftmost/rightmost lane of road with defined
# speed as gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed. The shadow_vehicle_2
# is placed on the shoulder of the road. Ego travels on any lane 
# on the road. The shadow_vehicle_1, work_vehicle and shadow_vehicle_2
# are vehicles that have symbol over it. 
#
#   In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed - Speed of shadow_vehicle_1 
#      and work_vehicle
#    . gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start - The 
#      longitudinal distance between shadow_vehicle_1 and shadow_vehicle_2
#    . gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start - The 
#      longitudinal distance between shadow_vehicle_1 and work_vehicle
#    . gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego - The 
#      longitudinal distance between shadow_vehicle_2 and Ego
#    . gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle - The 
#      side of symbol vehicles

scenario sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation inherits construction_sites_family_base:

    keep(default scenario_str == "ego_approach_mobile_operation")

    # Side of shadow_vehicle_1 and work_vehicle
    # If gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle is is_innermost then both the vehicles
    # will be placed at innermost lane of road and same for 
    # is_outermost both vehicles will be placed at outermost lane
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.phase_essence_start.side_of_symbol_vehicle", gen_cover: 
        "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.start.gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle")
    gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle: side_of_symbol_vehicle_kind
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.phase_essence_start.shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed", gen_cover: 
        "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.start.gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed")
    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed: speed
    keep(default gen_shadow_vehicle_1_and_work_vehicle_speed in [0..10]kph)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.phase_essence_start.shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start", 
        gen_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.start.gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start")
    gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start: length
    keep(default gen_shadow_vehicle_1_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_2_at_start in \
        [150..250]m)
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.phase_essence_start.work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start", 
        gen_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.start.gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start")
    gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start: length
    keep(default gen_work_vehicle_lon_distance_to_shadow_vehicle_1_at_start in [5..15]m)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.phase_essence_start.shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego", 
        gen_cover: "sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation.start.gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego")
    gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego: length
    keep(default gen_shadow_vehicle_2_lon_distance_to_ego in [400..550]m)
    
scenario sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation_main inherits construction_sites_family_base_main:

    keep(default scenario_str == "ego_approach_mobile_operation_test")
# If gen_side_of_symbol_vehicle is rightmost/leftmost then
# shadow_vehicle_2 are placed according to
# rightmost/leftmost side
scenario sut.ego_approach_mobile_operation_rightmost_main inherits ego_approach_mobile_operation_main(\
