extend sut.ego_approach_congestion:

    #keep(default congestion_drive.duration in [10..20]s)
    #Commented as of now because of generation error for some input speed values

    # Adding offsets to traffic speed, so we can see the varying speeds of vehicles
    traffic_speed_2: speed with:
        keep( it in [gen_traffic_speed-ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset..\
            gen_traffic_speed+ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset])
    
    traffic_speed_3: speed with:
        keep( it in [gen_traffic_speed-10kph..gen_traffic_speed+10kph])

    # Adding lateral distances for traffic during congestion drive
    traffic_lateral_distance: length with:
        keep(default it in [-1.5..1.5]m)

    ego_to_congestion_dist_tolerance: length with: keep(default it in [10..15]m)
    
    vehicles_speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)

    #preventing bypass of vehicles. since we want them to keep the lanes
    keep (default vehicle_1.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep (default vehicle_2.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep (default vehicle_3.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)

    do ego_approach_congestion: serial():
        
        # in the ego warm-up phase, vehicles are positioned and start driving with initial speeds
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_vehicle_1_at_ego_warm_up: vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_1_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_1_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, at: start)
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_speed_override_at_ego_warm_up: override(intent_vehicle_1_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_1_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)

            drive_vehicle_2_at_ego_warm_up: vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_2_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(left_of:sut.car)
                intent_vehicle_2_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(traffic_speed_2, at: start)
                intent_assist_vehicle_2_speed_override_at_ego_warm_up: override(intent_vehicle_2_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_2_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)
           
            drive_vehicle_3_at_ego_warm_up: vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_3_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(right_of:sut.car)
                intent_vehicle_3_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(traffic_speed_3, at: start)
                intent_assist_vehicle_3_speed_override_at_ego_warm_up: override(intent_vehicle_3_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_vehicle_3_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start)
        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration(default [1..10]s, tolerance: 2s)

        # in the essence phase, ego approaches the congestion and maintains relative speed to traffic
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(ego_speed_rel_to_congestion, 
                    faster_than: vehicle_1, 
                    at: start, tolerance: vehicles_speed_tolerance)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_vehicle_1_at_essence: vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_1_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: ego_to_congestion_dist,
                    ahead_of: sut.car,
                    measure_by: nearest, at: start,
                    tolerance: ego_to_congestion_dist_tolerance)
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                control_vehicle_1_lateral_at_essence_start: lateral(distance: traffic_lateral_distance, 
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_vehicle_2_at_essence: vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_2_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: [ego_to_congestion_dist-10m..\
                    ego_to_congestion_dist+10m],
                    ahead_of: sut.car,
                    measure_by: nearest, at: start,
                    tolerance: ego_to_congestion_dist_tolerance)
                intent_assist_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                control_vehicle_2_lateral_at_essence_start: lateral(distance: traffic_lateral_distance, 
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_vehicle_3_at_essence: vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_vehicle_3_position_at_essence_start: position(distance: [ego_to_congestion_dist-5m..\
                    ego_to_congestion_dist+5m],
                    ahead_of: sut.car,
                    measure_by: nearest, at: start,
                    tolerance: ego_to_congestion_dist_tolerance)
                intent_assist_vehicle_3_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_3_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                control_vehicle_3_lateral_at_essence_start: lateral(distance: traffic_lateral_distance, 
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration([5..10]s, tolerance: 2s)

        # in the post phase, all vehicles continue driving with their current behaviors
        phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_vehicle_1_at_post: vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_vehicle_2_at_post: vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_vehicle_3_at_post: vehicle_3.drive() with:
                intent_assist_vehicle_3_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_vehicle_3_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 2s)

# sut::lead_traffic_slows_and_comes_to_stop
# In this scenario, lead_vehicle, left_lead_vehicle and right_lead_vehicle drive ahead of the Ego. All the lead vehicles move slowly
# and come to a stop . 
# Configurable parameters: gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, gen_ego_distance_to_lead_vehicle

extend sut.lead_traffic_slows_and_comes_to_stop:

    # Define the speed tolerance
    speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == 5kph)
        
    # Define the time tolerance for position modifier
    time_tolerance: time with:
        keep(default it == 5s)

    do lead_traffic_slows_and_comes_to_stop: serial():

        # in the ego warm-up phase, ego drives with lead vehicles on the right, left and in the same lane, along one-way road
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(middle: true, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(straight_road, start_offset: [10..20]m, at: start)
                intent_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, tolerance: speed_tolerance)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_ego_warm_up: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(same_as: sut.car)
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, tolerance: speed_tolerance)
                intent_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_end: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle, 
                    measure_by: nearest, ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, track: projected, time_tolerance: time_tolerance)
                intent_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_ego_warm_up: along(straight_road)

            drive_right_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: right_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(right_of: sut.car)
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, tolerance: speed_tolerance)
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_ego_warm_up: along(straight_road)
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_end: position(time: [gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle - time_tolerance..gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle + time_tolerance], measure_by: nearest, 
                    ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, track: projected)

            drive_left_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: left_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(left_of: sut.car)
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, tolerance: speed_tolerance)
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_ego_warm_up: along(straight_road)
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_end: position(time: [gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle - time_tolerance..gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle + time_tolerance], measure_by: nearest,
                    ahead_of: sut.car, at: end, track: projected)

        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration(default [10..30]s, tolerance: 5s)

        # in the traffic moving slow phase, the lead vehicles slow down, resulting in the ego to decelerate
        phase_traffic_moving_slow: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_traffic_moving_slow: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_traffic_moving_slow: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_traffic_moving_slow: along(straight_road)
                
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_moving_slow: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_moving_slow: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_traffic_moving_slow: along(straight_road)
                
            drive_right_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_moving_slow: right_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_right_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_moving_slow: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_right_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_traffic_moving_slow: along(straight_road)

            drive_left_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_moving_slow: left_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_left_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_moving_slow: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_left_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_start_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_moving_slow_end: speed(0kph, at: end)
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_traffic_moving_slow: along(straight_road)
        with:
            intent_traffic_moving_slow_duration: duration(default [5..20]s, tolerance: 5s)    

        # in the traffic comes to stop phase, all vehicles come to a complete stop
        phase_traffic_comes_to_stop: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: keep_lane()
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: speed(0kph)
            
            drive_right_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: right_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_right_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: keep_lane()
                intent_right_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: speed(0kph)
            
            drive_left_lead_vehicle_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: left_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_left_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: keep_lane()
                intent_left_lead_vehicle_speed_at_traffic_comes_to_stop: speed(0kph)
        with:
            intent_traffic_comes_to_stop_duration: duration(default [5..10]s, tolerance: 2s)

        # in the post phase, the vehicles maintain their lanes and speeds
        phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_post: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_right_lead_vehicle_at_post: right_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_right_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_right_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_left_lead_vehicle_at_post: left_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_left_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_left_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 2s)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend sut.motorcycle_passing_through_high_traffic_between_gaps:
    # Road element
    road: one_way_road
    number_of_lanes: int
    keep(number_of_lanes == 3)
    keep(road.min_lanes >= number_of_lanes)

    # Motorcycle's side w.r.t to Ego
    gen_motorcycle_split_side: line with:
        keep(it in [left,right])

    # Driver model
    fast_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        # Prevent cars from switching lanes
        keep(it.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    traffic_vehicle_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        keep(it.change_lane_eagerness == 20)

    # Setting behavioral driver model, target speed for fast lane traffic vehicles
    for vehicle in fast_vehicles_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == fast_lane_driver_model)
    keep(fast_lane_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(fast_lane_driver_model.target_speed in [fast_lane_traffic_speed..1.4*fast_lane_traffic_speed])

    # Setting behavioral driver model, speed in percentage and min tcc to traffic vehicle group
    for vehicle in traffic_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(vehicle.initial_bm == traffic_vehicle_driver_model)
    for member in traffic_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(default member.initial_speed_percentage in [120..170])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc in [3..5]s)

    keep(default slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane_side == left)
    keep(default gen_fast_lane_side == left)
    slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane: int
    keep(slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane_side == left => slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane == gen_ego_lane + 1)
    keep(slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane_side == right => slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane == gen_ego_lane - 1)
    fast_vehicle_lane: int
    keep(gen_ego_lane == 1 and gen_fast_lane_side == left => fast_vehicle_lane == slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane + 1)
    keep(gen_ego_lane == 2 and gen_fast_lane_side == left => fast_vehicle_lane == gen_ego_lane + 1)
    keep(gen_ego_lane == 2 and gen_fast_lane_side == right => fast_vehicle_lane == gen_ego_lane - 1)

    vehicle_behind_rel_distance_to_ego: time
    keep(default vehicle_behind_rel_distance_to_ego in [1..2]s)

    #Calculation:
    # 1. Distance from ego to slow vehicle at start(ego_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start) = (gen_ego_speed_at_start - slow vehicle speed) * gen_slow_vehicle_position_to_ego
    # 2. Distance from motorcycle to slow vehicle at start(motorcycle_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start) = motorcycle relative distance to ego + distance from ego to slow vehicle at start
    # 3. Relative speed of motorcycle to slow vehicle(motorcycle_rel_speed_to_slow_vehicle) = Distance from motorcycle to slow vehicle at start/ gen_slow_vehicle_position_to_ego
    # 4. Absolute speed of motorcycle(motorcycle_speed) = Relative speed of motorcycle to slow vehicle + slow vehicle speed
    ego_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start: length
    keep(default ego_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start ==
         (gen_ego_speed_at_start - slow_vehicle_speed)* gen_slow_vehicle_position_to_ego)
    motorcycle_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start: length
    keep(default motorcycle_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start ==
         gen_motorcycle_rel_distance_to_ego_at_start + ego_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start)
    motorcycle_rel_speed_to_slow_vehicle: speed
    keep(default motorcycle_rel_speed_to_slow_vehicle ==
         (motorcycle_distance_to_slow_vehicle_at_start/gen_slow_vehicle_position_to_ego))
    motorcycle_speed: speed
    keep(motorcycle_speed == motorcycle_rel_speed_to_slow_vehicle + slow_vehicle_speed)

    # To ensure the lateral offset is within the lane
    lane_width: length with:
        keep(default it == 3m)

    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.end_of_road_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.enabling_policy == always_enabled) 
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 2meter)
    keep(motorcycle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)

    traffic_vehicle_ahead_position_to_ego: time
    keep(default traffic_vehicle_ahead_position_to_ego in [3..5]s)

    motorcycle_lateral_offset: length
    keep(motorcycle_lateral_offset == 0m)

    lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side: length 
    keep(lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side == motorcycle.get_width() + 
        motorcycle_lat_offset_to_ego + 
        motorcycle_lat_offset_to_ego)

#   Overtaking Phase
#   Ego moves in dense traffic approaching a group of slow vehicles.
#   There is possibility for Ego to change lane to avoid a traffic jam. 
#   In the same time the Motorcycle approaches the Ego from behind, moving between adjacent lane and Ego lane.
    do motorcycle_passing_through_high_traffic_between_gaps: serial():
        # in the ego warm-up phase, ego moves in dense traffic approaching a group of slow vehicles
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_ego_warm_up: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(gen_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_ego_lateral_at_ego_warm_up_start: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side)
        
            drive_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_ego_warm_up: slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(slow_vehicle_speed, tolerance: ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(gen_ego_lane, from: curb)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(gen_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lateral_at_ego_warm_up: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side)

            drive_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(gen_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_lateral_at_ego_warm_up: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side,
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side)

            drive_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_at_ego_warm_up: slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego.drive() with:
                intent_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(slow_vehicle_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()

            drive_fast_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed(fast_lane_traffic_speed, tolerance: ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_fast_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(lane: fast_vehicle_lane, from: curb)
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_ego_warm_up: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()

            drive_motorcycle_at_ego_warm_up: motorcycle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_motorcycle_speed_at_ego_warm_up: speed([motorcycle_speed - ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset.. \
                    motorcycle_speed + ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset],
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lane_at_ego_warm_up: lane(lane: gen_ego_lane, from: curb, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lateral_at_ego_warm_up: lateral(motorcycle_lateral_offset, line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration(default [1..10]s, tolerance: 2s)

        # in the essence phase, the motorcycle approaches the ego from behind, moving between adjacent lane and ego lane
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
            # Ego Drive
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_essence: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lateral_at_essence: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side)

            # Slow vehicle drives ahead of Ego
            drive_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_essence: slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_position_at_essence_start: position(time: gen_slow_vehicle_position_to_ego,
                         ahead_of: traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego, measure_by: nearest, 
                         at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lane_at_essence: lane(gen_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_speed_at_essence: speed(slow_vehicle_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lateral_at_essence: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            # Vehicle drives in between Ego and slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego
            drive_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_essence: traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_position_at_essence_start: position(time: traffic_vehicle_ahead_position_to_ego,
                         ahead_of: sut.car,
                         measure_by: nearest, at:start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lateral_at_essence: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            # Vehicle drives behind of Ego
            drive_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_at_essence: traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_position_at_essence_start: position(time: vehicle_behind_rel_distance_to_ego,
                         behind: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, 
                         at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_lateral_at_essence: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            # Slow vehicle drives adjacent to Ego with traffic vehicle group behind it
            drive_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_at_essence: slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego.drive() with:
                intent_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_position_at_essence_start: position([-1.5..20]m, ahead_of: slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego,
                          measure_by: nearest, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane_at_essence: lane(slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_lane, from: curb)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_speed_at_essence: speed(slow_vehicle_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_at_essence: traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()

            # Fast vehicle drives on fast lane , adjacent to Ego with fast vehicle group behind it
            drive_fast_vehicle_at_essence: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_fast_vehicle_lane_at_essence: lane(lane: fast_vehicle_lane, from: curb)
                intent_fast_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: position(time:[1..1]s, ahead_of:sut.car, measure_by: nearest,
                    at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_essence: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()

            # Motorcycle overtaking Ego
            drive_motorcycle_at_essence: motorcycle.drive() with:
                intent_motorcycle_position_at_essence_start: position(gen_motorcycle_rel_distance_to_ego_at_start,
                    behind: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_motorcycle_position_at_essence_end: position(motorcycle_pos_rel_ego_at_end, ahead_of: sut.car,
                    measure_by: nearest, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lane_at_essence: lane(lane: gen_ego_lane, from: curb, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lateral_at_essence: lateral(motorcycle_lateral_offset, line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_motorcycle_avoid_collisions_at_essence: avoid_collisions(false)
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration([10..30]s, tolerance: 10s)

        # in the post phase, all vehicles maintain their current behaviors
        phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_lateral_at_post: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_post: slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lateral_at_post: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_at_post: traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego_lateral_at_post: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_at_post: traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego_lateral_at_post: lateral(distance: lat_offset_rel_to_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_at_post: traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()

            drive_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_at_post: slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego.drive() with:
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)

            drive_fast_vehicle_at_post: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_post: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()

            drive_motorcycle_at_post: motorcycle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_motorcycle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_motorcycle_lateral_at_post: lateral(motorcycle_lateral_offset, line: gen_motorcycle_split_side, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 2s)

    # Disable collision avoidance of motorcycle only for Ego
    def post_plan() is also:
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(sut.car)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(traffic_vehicle_ahead_of_ego)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(traffic_vehicle_behind_of_ego)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(slow_vehicle_adjacent_to_ego)
        motorcycle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.ignore_list.add(fast_vehicle)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sut.high_traffic_with_multiple_lane_changes
# In this scenario, the Ego drives in a dense traffic spread 
# on all the lanes. Some of the vehicles which are in front 
# of the Ego change their lanes.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc (the initial ttc of the traffic vehicles 
#      within [1..5]s) 
#    . gen_traffic_speed (the speed of traffic vehicles within [36..144]kph)

#      the staying_in_lane_vehicle_group within [3..8])

#      changing_lane_vehicle_group within [1..3])
#    . duration_of_maneuver_phase (duration of maneuver_phase within 
#      [10..20]s)
#    . duration_of_post_phase (duration of post_phase within [5..10]s)
#    . gen_traffic_speed_deviation (Initial speed deviation of the traffic_vehicles 
#      within [90..110])
#    . gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed (The speed change of vehicles of
#      staying_in_lane_vehicle_group within [0.9..1.1])
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/osc/utils/high_dense_traffic_common.osc"

scenario sut.high_traffic_with_multiple_lane_changes inherits generic_base_scenario:
    # Traffic attributes
    gen_traffic_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [36..144]kph)
    
    gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..5]s)

    # changing_lane_vehicle_group attributes
    changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle: vehicle
    
    gen_number_of_changing_lane_vehicles: int with:
        keep(default it in [1..3])
    
    changing_lane_vehicle_group: all_lanes_car_group with( 
        reference_car: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle)

    # staying_in_lane_vehicle_group attributes
    gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles: int with:
        keep(default it in [3..8])
    
    staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle: vehicle
    
    staying_in_lane_vehicle_group: all_lanes_car_group with(
        reference_car: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle)
    
    gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed: int with:
        keep(default it in [90..110])

    post_phase_duration: time
    keep(default post_phase_duration in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend sut.high_traffic_with_multiple_lane_changes:
 
    # Road element
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes >= 3)
    
    lane_section: lane_section

    # changing_lane_vehicle_group with aggressive driver
    aggressive_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    keep(aggressive_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 100)
    
    keep(changing_lane_vehicle_group.cars.size() == 
        gen_number_of_changing_lane_vehicles)
    
    for car in changing_lane_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == aggressive_driver_model)

    for member in changing_lane_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)

    # staying_in_lane_vehicle_group with keep lane driver
    keep_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
    
    keep(staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.cars.size() == 
        gen_number_of_staying_in_lane_vehicles)
    
    for car in staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.cars: 
        keep(car.initial_bm == keep_lane_driver_model)

    # Speed change of the staying_in_lane_vehicle_group vehicles
    staying_in_lane_vehicles_new_speed_value: speed
    
    keep(staying_in_lane_vehicles_new_speed_value == \
        (gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed/100.0) * gen_traffic_speed)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.target_speed == \
        staying_in_lane_vehicles_new_speed_value)
    
    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the vehicles of 
    # staying_in_lane_vehicle_group
    for member in staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(member.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_min_initial_ttc)

    do high_traffic_with_multiple_lane_changes: serial:
        
        # in the ego warm-up phase, vehicles are positioned and start driving with initial speeds
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(middle: true)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(road)

            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [3..6]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_at_ego_warm_up: changing_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()

            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_assist_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_ego_warm_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle, at: start, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_at_ego_warm_up: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration([2..10]s, tolerance: 3s)

        # in the essence phase, the staying_in_lane vehicles change their speed and the changing_lane vehicles change their lane
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_essence_start: lane(middle: true)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_essence: along(road)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, 
                    measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_start: lane(side_of: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_end: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_essence: along(road)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_at_essence: changing_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            
            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_essence: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end: speed(staying_in_lane_vehicles_new_speed_value, at: end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_start: position(time: [2..4]s, ahead_of: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle, 
                    at: start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_essence: along(road)

            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_at_essence: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration([15..30]second, tolerance: 3s)

        # in the post phase, the vehicles continue to drive with the speed and lane adjusted in the previous phase
        phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_road_at_post: along(road)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_post: changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_changing_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_post: along(road)
            
            drive_changing_lane_vehicle_group_at_post: changing_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            
            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_at_post: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_lead_vehicle_along_road_at_post: along(road)
            
            drive_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_at_post: staying_in_lane_vehicle_group.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 3s)

# sut.high_traffic_on_multiple_lanes_except_one
# In this scenario, Ego drives in a dense traffic spread
# on all the lanes except on fast lane. Some of the vehicles which are in front
# of Ego change their lanes. Fast lane has low density traffic.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_traffic_density (the initial ttc of the traffic vehicles within [1..5]s)
#    . gen_traffic_speed (the speed of traffic vehicles within [10..40]mps)
#    . gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles_in_lane (number of vehicles forming
#      the staying_in_lane_vehicle_group within [3..8]
#    . gen_number_of_fast_vehicles (number of vehicles forming the
#      fast vehicle group within [0..4])
#    . gen_ego_on_fast_lane (whether Ego drives on the fast lane)
#    . duration_of_maneuver_phase (duration of maneuver_phase within
#      [5..20]s)
#    . duration_of_end_phase (duration of end_phase within [5..15]s)
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/scenarios/generic_base_scenario/generic_base_scenario_top.osc"
import "$FTX_PACKAGES/common/osc/utils/high_dense_traffic_common.osc"

scenario sut.high_traffic_on_multiple_lanes_except_one inherits generic_base_scenario:

    # Traffic attributes
    gen_traffic_speed: speed
    keep(default gen_traffic_speed in [20..40]kph)

    gen_fast_lane_traffic_speed: int
    keep(default gen_fast_lane_traffic_speed  in [100..140])
    
    gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed: int 
    keep(default gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed in [70..110])

    gen_traffic_density: time
    keep(default gen_traffic_density in [1..5]s)

    # Minimum initial ttc for the fast vehicle group.
    fast_vehicle_min_init_ttc: time
    keep(default fast_vehicle_min_init_ttc in [3..6]s)

    gen_traffic_vehicle_speed_deviation: int 
    keep(default gen_traffic_vehicle_speed_deviation in [-80..10])

    initial_traffic_speed_deviation_percentage: int 
    keep(default initial_traffic_speed_deviation_percentage ==  \
        (100+gen_traffic_vehicle_speed_deviation))
    
    # Refrence vehicles for traffic group
    fast_vehicle: vehicle with: keep(it.color == blue)
    change_lane_vehicle_1: vehicle
    change_lane_vehicle_2: vehicle
    gen_number_of_fast_vehicles: int with: keep(default it in [0..2])
    gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles_in_lane: int with: keep(default it in [1..3])

    # Vehicle groups are single lane car groups change lane vehicles
    # are part of traffice vehicles
    fast_vehicles_group: single_lane_car_group with(reference_car: fast_vehicle):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_fast_vehicles)
    traffic_vehicle_group_1: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: change_lane_vehicle_1):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles_in_lane)
    traffic_vehicle_group_2: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: change_lane_vehicle_2):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_traffic_vehicles_in_lane)

    # Placement of all traffic vehicles
    fast_lane_side: av_side with: keep(default it == left)
    traffic_vehicle_group_2_lane_side: av_side
    gen_ego_on_fast_lane: bool with:
        keep(default it == false)

    # fast_lane_traffic_new_speed
    fast_lane_traffic_speed_percentage_of_traffic_speed: speed
    keep(default fast_lane_traffic_speed_percentage_of_traffic_speed == \
        (gen_fast_lane_traffic_speed/100)* gen_traffic_speed)

    # Staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_new speed
    staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed_value : speed
    keep(default staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed_value == \
        (gen_staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed/100)* gen_traffic_speed )

    post_phase_duration: time
    keep(default post_phase_duration in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_post_phase_duration)

import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

extend sut.high_traffic_on_multiple_lanes_except_one:
    # Road element
    road:one_way_road
    keep(soft road.min_lanes >= 3)
    lane_section: lane_section

   
    # Fast-lane group with keep lane driver.
    fast_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        keep(it.change_lane_eagerness == 0)
        keep(it.use_target_speed == true)
        keep(default it.target_speed ==\
             fast_lane_traffic_speed_percentage_of_traffic_speed)

    for car in fast_vehicles_group.members_params:
        keep(default car.initial_speed_percentage ==\
             initial_traffic_speed_deviation_percentage)
        keep(car.min_initial_ttc == fast_vehicle_min_init_ttc)
        
    for car in fast_vehicles_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == fast_lane_driver_model)

    # Traffic group with normal driver that may or may not change lane.
    normal_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model with:
        keep(it.use_target_speed == true)
        keep(default it.target_speed == \
            staying_in_lane_vehicle_group_speed_value)
        
    for car in traffic_vehicle_group_1.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)
    for car in traffic_vehicle_group_2.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == normal_driver_model)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the traffic vehicles
    for car in traffic_vehicle_group_1.members_params:
        keep(default car.initial_speed_percentage == initial_traffic_speed_deviation_percentage)
        keep(car.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_density)
        keep(car.lon_distance in [5..15]m)
    for car in traffic_vehicle_group_2.members_params:
        keep(default car.initial_speed_percentage == initial_traffic_speed_deviation_percentage)
        keep(car.min_initial_ttc == gen_traffic_density)
        keep(car.lon_distance in [5..15]m)

    # Side of the fast lane and other traffic lane relative to Ego lane
    keep(fast_lane_side == left => traffic_vehicle_group_2_lane_side == right and ego_side == right)
    keep(fast_lane_side == right => traffic_vehicle_group_2_lane_side == left and ego_side == left)

    ego_lane: int
    ego_side: av_side
    keep(gen_ego_on_fast_lane == false => ego_lane == 1)
    keep(gen_ego_on_fast_lane == true => ego_lane == 0)

    
    do high_traffic_on_multiple_lanes_except_one: serial():

        # in the ego warm-up phase, vehicles are positioned and start driving with initial speeds
        phase_ego_warm_up: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(ego_lane, side_of: fast_vehicle, side: ego_side)
            
            drive_fast_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(fast_lane_traffic_speed_percentage_of_traffic_speed,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_fast_vehicle_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side: fast_lane_side, side_of: change_lane_vehicle_1)
                intent_fast_vehicle_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[2..5]s,
                    ahead_of:sut.car, run_mode: best_effort, at: start)
                intent_fast_vehicle_along_road_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(road)
                intent_fast_vehicle_along_lane_section_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(lane_section, end_offset: [100..]m, at: start)
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_ego_warm_up: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_1_at_ego_warm_up: change_lane_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_1_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time: [3..8]s, ahead_of: sut.car,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_1_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_1_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(middle: true)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_1_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_vehicle_group_1.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_2_at_ego_warm_up: change_lane_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                # Add 2s to account for vehicle length in the initial time gap
                # between Ego and vehicle.
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_2_position_at_ego_warm_up_start: position(time:[1..5]s, ahead_of: sut.car, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_2_speed_at_ego_warm_up_start: speed(gen_traffic_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_2_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(side: traffic_vehicle_group_2_lane_side, 
                    side_of: change_lane_vehicle_1)
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_2_along_lane_section_at_ego_warm_up_start: along(lane_section, end_offset: [100..]m, at: start)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_2_at_ego_warm_up: traffic_vehicle_group_2.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_ego_warm_up_duration: duration([1..10]s, tolerance:3s)

        # in the essence phase, the change_lane_vehicles change their lane and traffic_vehicles change their speed
        phase_essence: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive()
            
            drive_fast_vehicle_at_essence: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane()
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_essence: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_1_at_essence: change_lane_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_1_change_lane_at_essence: change_lane([1..2])
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_1_at_essence: traffic_vehicle_group_1.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_2_at_essence: change_lane_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_change_lane_vehicle_2_change_lane_at_essence: change_lane([1..2], run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_2_at_essence: traffic_vehicle_group_2.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_essence_duration: duration([5..20]s, tolerance:3s)

        # in the post phase, all vehicles continue driving with their current behaviors
        phase_post: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_post: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_fast_vehicle_at_post: fast_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_fast_vehicle_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_fast_vehicles_group_at_post: fast_vehicles_group.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_1_at_post: change_lane_vehicle_1.drive() with:
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_1_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_1_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_1_at_post: traffic_vehicle_group_1.group_drive()
            
            drive_change_lane_vehicle_2_at_post: change_lane_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_post: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_change_lane_vehicle_2_keep_speed_at_post: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            
            drive_traffic_vehicle_group_2_at_post: traffic_vehicle_group_2.group_drive()
        with:
            intent_post_duration: duration(post_phase_duration, tolerance: 2s)

extend sut.lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_with_swirl:

    event crash_phase_end_event is @phase_essence_crash.end
    event initial_phase_start_event is @phase_essence_initial.start
    event pre_crash_phase_end_event is @phase_essence_pre_crash.end

    event pre_crash_phase_start_event is @phase_essence_pre_crash.start
    var pre_crash_phase_start : bool = sample(true, @pre_crash_phase_start_event)
    var pre_crash_phase_end : bool = sample(true, @pre_crash_phase_end_event)
    event pre_crash_phase_active is(pre_crash_phase_start and not pre_crash_phase_end)

    var time_pre_crash_phase_start: time
    var sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle: bool = false
    event sample_at_pre_crash_phase_fraction

    lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: maximum)

    lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: standard_deviation)
    
    # Values above or equal to this tolerances can be considered a swirling maneuver
    var lead_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance: length = 0.1m  
    var lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance : speed = 0.5mps

    # Values above this tolerance are high enough to consider that the vehicles have crashed
    var tolerance_for_lead_vehicle_to_stationary_object_time_gap: time = 1000s


    on @initial_phase_start_event:
        ego_position_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(lead_vehicle)
        stationary_vehicle_kind = stationary_crash_vehicle.kind

    on @pre_crash_phase_start_event:
        time_pre_crash_phase_start = top.time
        time_gap_to_lead_vehicle = sut.car.get_time_gap(lead_vehicle)

    on @pre_crash_phase_active:
        lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.add_sample(lead_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed.add_sample((math.abs(lead_vehicle.state.road_speed.lat)))
        if top.time > time_pre_crash_phase_start + (path_fraction_lead_vehicle_drive / 100.0) * duration_at_phase_essence_pre_crash and not (sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle):

            else:
                lead_vehicle_position_to_stationary_crash_vehicle_at_pre_crash_start = lead_vehicle.get_time_gap(stationary_crash_vehicle)
            sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle = true
            emit sample_at_pre_crash_phase_fraction

    on @pre_crash_phase_end_event:
        if (lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.compute() >= lead_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance) and (lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed.compute() >= lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance):
            lead_vehicle_swirling = true    
        else:
            lead_vehicle_swirling = false


    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_with_swirl: serial():
            # Initial drive of Ego and lead vehicle
            phase_essence_initial: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_initial: sut.car.drive() with:
                    # along(crash_road)
                    intent_assist_ego_lane_at_essence_initial: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_initial: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_position_at_essence_initial_start: position(
                        time: gen_ego_position_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase_start,

            with: 
                intent_essence_initial_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_initial, tolerance: 1s)

            # Lead vehicle prepares to crash into stationary crash vehicle
            phase_essence_pre_crash:parallel(overlap: equal):
                stationary_crash_vehicle_exists_at_essence_pre_crash: stationary_crash_vehicle.exists_at(
                    start_pos_lead_vehicle_drive)
                drive_ego_at_essence_pre_crash: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_position_at_essence_pre_crash_start: position(
                        time: gen_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle, 
                        behind: lead_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_pre_crash: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_shape_at_essence_pre_crash: shape(
                        quantity: position, request: both, 
                        shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_pre_crash: avoid_collisions(false)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_pre_crash: lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: 
                intent_essence_pre_crash_duration: duration(duration_at_phase_essence_pre_crash, tolerance: 1s)

            # Lane blockage due to crash
            phase_essence_crash:parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_crash: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_crash: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_crash: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_crash: avoid_collisions(false)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_crash: keep_lane()
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_crash: lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: 
                intent_essence_crash_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_crash, tolerance: 1s)

        scenario_stopper_at_essence: object_scenario_stopper(object_position: start_pos_lead_vehicle_drive)


 # lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_with_swirl_main scenario implementation
# scenario invokes serially ego warm up, lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_with_swirl 
# and then the post scenarios
extend sut.lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_with_swirl_main:

        # invoke lead_vehicle_and_stop scenario

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_post: lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_base_post(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

extend sut.lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_without_swirl:
    lane_section: lane_section

    #The ending lane behavior is made as false
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.ending_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    
    #The junction behavior is made as false
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.junction_entry_lane_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

    event crash_phase_end_event is @phase_essence_crash.end
    event ego_collision is @sut.car.collision  if (sut.car.prev_state != null)
    event initial_phase_start_event is @phase_essence_initial.start
    event pre_crash_phase_end_event is @phase_essence_pre_crash.end

    event pre_crash_phase_start_event is @phase_essence_pre_crash.start
    var pre_crash_phase_start : bool = sample(true, @pre_crash_phase_start_event)
    var pre_crash_phase_end : bool = sample(true, @pre_crash_phase_end_event)
    event pre_crash_phase_active is(pre_crash_phase_start and not pre_crash_phase_end)
    
    var time_pre_crash_phase_start: time
    var time_pre_crash_phase_end: time
    var sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle: bool = false
    event sample_at_pre_crash_phase_fraction

    lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd: statistics(sample_type: length, measurement: standard_deviation)
    var lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_calculated: length

    lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed: statistics(sample_type: speed, measurement: maximum)
    var lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed_calculated: speed

    # Values above or equal to this tolerances can be considered a swirling maneuver
    var lead_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance: length = 0.1m  
    var lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance : speed = 0.5mps

    # Values above this tolerance are high enough to consider that the vehicles have crashed
    var tolerance_for_lead_vehicle_to_stationary_object_time_gap: time = 1000s

    on @initial_phase_start_event:
        ego_position_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase_start = sut.car.get_time_gap(lead_vehicle)
        stationary_vehicle_kind = stationary_crash_vehicle.kind

    on @pre_crash_phase_start_event:
        time_pre_crash_phase_start = top.time

    on @pre_crash_phase_active:
        lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.add_sample(lead_vehicle.state.msp_pos.lane_position.lat_offset)
        lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed.add_sample((math.abs(lead_vehicle.state.local_speed.lat)))
        if top.time > time_pre_crash_phase_start + (path_fraction_lead_vehicle_drive / 100.0) * duration_at_phase_essence_pre_crash and not (sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle): 
            if lead_vehicle.get_time_gap(stationary_crash_vehicle) > tolerance_for_lead_vehicle_to_stationary_object_time_gap:
                lead_vehicle_position_to_stationary_crash_vehicle_at_pre_crash_start = 0s # vehicle has already crashed into stationary_vehicle, so time-gap is 0 instead of inf
            else:
                lead_vehicle_position_to_stationary_crash_vehicle_at_pre_crash_start = lead_vehicle.get_time_gap(stationary_crash_vehicle)
            sampled_lead_vehicle_position_to_crash_vehicle = true
            emit sample_at_pre_crash_phase_fraction


    on @pre_crash_phase_end_event:
        time_gap_to_lead_vehicle = sut.car.get_time_gap(lead_vehicle)
        if (lateral_shift_shape_amplitude_sd.compute() >= lead_vehicle_swirl_amplitude_sd_tolerance) and (lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed.compute() >= lead_vehicle_max_lat_speed_tolerance):
            lead_vehicle_swirling = true    
        else:
            lead_vehicle_swirling = false

            

    do phase_essence: first_of:
        phase_essence_lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_without_swirl: serial():
            # Initial drive of EGO and lead vehicle
            phase_essence_initial: serial():
                lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lead_vehicle(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle, 
                    default_cruise_distance: 
                    gen_ego_position_to_lead_vehicle_at_initial_phase_start,
                    gen_ego_speed_at_start: gen_ego_speed_at_start)
            # Lead vehicle prepares to crash into stationary crash vehicle
            phase_essence_pre_crash:parallel(overlap: equal):
                stationary_crash_vehicle_exists_at_essence_pre_crash: stationary_crash_vehicle.exists_at(
                    start_pos_lead_vehicle_drive)
                drive_ego_at_essence_pre_crash: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_pre_crash: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_lane()
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_pre_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_pre_crash_start: position(
                        time: gen_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle, 
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest, 
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_pre_crash: avoid_collisions(false)
            with: 
                intent_essence_pre_crash_duration: duration(duration_at_phase_essence_pre_crash, tolerance: duration_tolerance)

            # Lane blockage due to crash
            phase_essence_crash:parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_ego_at_essence_crash: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_crash: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                    
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_crash: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_essence_crash: avoid_collisions(false)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_crash: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_crash: keep_lane()
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_crash: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
            with: 
                intent_essence_crash_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_crash, tolerance: duration_tolerance)
        
        scenario_stopper_at_essence: object_scenario_stopper(object_position: start_pos_lead_vehicle_drive)

    in lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.drive_ego_at_essence_approaching with:
        intent_ego_drive_path_at_essence_approaching_start: along(outer.lane_section, end_offset: ego_lane_offset_at_essence_approaching_start, at: start)
    in lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.drive_ego_at_essence_approaching with:
        intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_approaching: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
    in lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.drive_ego_at_essence_approaching with:
        intent_ego_drive_path_at_essence_approaching: along(outer.lane_section)

    in lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.phase_essence_adaptive_cruise with:
        override_intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: override(intent_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_adaptive_cruise, run_mode: best_effort)
        
    on @lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.phase_essence_adaptive_cruise.start:
            lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable = false
            #sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable = false
            call lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial.lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()
            #call sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()



 # lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_without_swirl_main scenario implementation

extend sut.lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_without_swirl_main:

    do phase_main: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_base_ego_warm_up(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke lead_vehicle_and_stop scenario
        phase_essence: lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_without_swirl(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_post: lead_vehicle_crash_with_stationary_object_base_post(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

    in phase_post.drive_lead_vehicle_at_post with:
        intent_lead_vehicle_avoid_collisions_at_post: avoid_collisions(false)

    override(phase_post.intent_post_duration, run_mode: disable)
    in phase_post.phase_post with:
        duration([5..10]s)
