# sut::ego_merge_at_zipper_merge
# In this scenario, both the Ego vehicle and the merge vehicle are 
# approaching a forced merge location, where they must perform a 
# zipper merge by alternately merging into a gap between adjacent vehicles. 
# The lead_vehicle, middle_vehicle, and follow_vehicle, along with its 
# car_group, form a separate group of vehicles that are driving on a different 
# lane or path than the Ego and merge vehicles, all heading 
# towards the merge location.
# Forced merge locations are specific points on the road where vehicles 
# are required to merge onto an adjacent lane or into adjacent 
# traffic because they are unable to 
# continue on the same lane or path. These locations include 
# lane endings and highway on-ramps. 
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    gen_ego_speed_at_start(Ego speed at start)
#    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start(Ego time gap 
#    to merge vehicle at start)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_speed(Lead vehicle speed)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to forced merged location at start)
#    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start
#    (Lead vehicle time gap to forced merged location at vehicle merge 
#    phase start)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_speed(Merge vehicle speed)
#    merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start
#    (Merge vehicle time gap to forced merged location at start)
#    gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase
#    (Merge vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at ego merge phase)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start
#    (Middle vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at start)
#    gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start
#    (Middle vehicle relative speed to lead vehicle at vehicle 
#    merge phase start)

#    (Middle vehicle time gap to lead vehicle at vehicle merge phase

scenario sut.ego_merge_at_zipper_merge inherits ego_merge_common:

    # Ego attributes

    gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start in [7..40]s)

    # Lead vehicle attributes
    lead_vehicle: vehicle

        keep(default it in [1..25]s)
    gen_lead_vehicle_speed: speed with:

    gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_merge_phase_start)
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start - \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2) ..\
        gen_lead_vehicle_speed * gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_start + \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)])
    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: length with:
        keep(it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start - \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2) ..\
        gen_lead_vehicle_speed * \
        gen_lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start + \
        (lead_vehicle.get_length()/2)])

            no_lights])

        left_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == left_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \
        right_indicator_on => turn_signal_state == right_on)
    keep(gen_merge_vehicle_conspicuity_state_type == \

        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_traffic_speed_range)
    middle_vehicle_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [gen_lead_vehicle_speed..
            gen_lead_vehicle_speed + gen_middle_vehicle_rel_speed_to_lead_vehicle_at_start])
    gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_middle_vehicle_desired_time_gap: time with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)

    # Follow vehicle attributes   
    follow_vehicle: vehicle
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_time_gap_to_other_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap: time
    keep(default gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap in \
        ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)
    gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_middle_vehicle_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_relative_traffic_speed_range)
    gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start:time with:
        keep(default it in [4..10]s)

     # Car group followed by follow_vehicle attributes
    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group: int with:
        keep(default it in \
            ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)
    follow_vehicle_group: single_lane_car_group with(
        reference_car: follow_vehicle):
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)

    # The Vehicle's junction behavior is disabled to achieve the distance
    # provided
    keep(ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.ego_merge_at_zipper_merge:

    # Offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 20m)
    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == 4kph)
    time_offset: time
    keep(default time_offset == 0.5s)

    # Speed deviation and initial TTC of the follow_vehicle_group vehicles
    # gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap is 
    # the TTC provided to car_group which maintains it
    # throughout the scenario
    for member in follow_vehicle_group.members_params:
        keep(member.initial_speed_percentage in [90..110])
        keep(default member.min_initial_ttc == \
            gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start)
        
    # Driver model is provided to car group which will maintain
    # the initial lane
    keep_lane_driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    for car in follow_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == keep_lane_driver_model)
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.use_target_speed == true)

    # Speed to car group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.target_speed in \
        [middle_vehicle_speed.. middle_vehicle_speed +\
        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_middle_vehicle_at_start])
    keep(keep_lane_driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 0)

    lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_merge_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase: time with:
        keep(default it in [0..5]s)
    
    on @phase_essence_initial.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @phase_essence_initial.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    ego_distance_to_pass: length with:
        keep(it == lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_merge_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase * \
        gen_ego_speed_at_start + \
        lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start)


    do phase_essence: first_of:
        ego_merge_at_zipper_merge: serial():

            # The merge_vehicle and Ego starts from the lane end
            # The lead_vehicle, middle_vehicle, follow_vehicle and
            # follow_vehicle_group 
            # forms a group and travels on highway in the lane next
            # to lane end maintaining certain position and speed
            phase_essence_initial: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_initial: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_lead_vehicle_distance_at_essence_initial: distance([((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start) \
                    - distance_offset)..((lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_start - \
                    lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start) \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    tolerance: distance_offset)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed([gen_lead_vehicle_speed..gen_lead_vehicle_speed + speed_offset], 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_position_at_essence_initial_end: position(time: lead_vehicle_rel_pos_to_merge_vehicle_at_end_of_initial_phase, 
                    measure_by: nearest, ahead_of: merge_vehicle, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_middle_vehicle_at_essence_initial: middle_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_middle_vehicle_lane_at_essence_initial_start: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle, at: start)
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed(middle_vehicle_speed, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_middle_vehicle_position_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        position(time: gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start, 
                            time_tolerance: time_offset, behind: lead_vehicle, measure_by: nearest,
                            at: start)
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_essence_initial: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_follow_vehicle_lane_at_essence_initial_start: lane(same_as: lead_vehicle, at: start)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed([middle_vehicle_speed.. middle_vehicle_speed +\
                        gen_follow_vehicle_rel_speed_to_middle_vehicle_at_start], at: start)
                    intent_follow_vehicle_position_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        position(time: gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_start, 
                        time_tolerance: time_offset, behind: middle_vehicle, measure_by: nearest,
                            at: start)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_essence_initial: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_merge_vehicle_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed(gen_merge_vehicle_speed, at: start)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_initial: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_initial: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_merge_vehicle_distance_at_essence_initial: distance([(gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(gen_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    tolerance: distance_offset)
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_along_at_essence_initial_end: along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                        start_offset: [10..20]m,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_merge_vehicle_position_at_essence_initial_start:\
                        position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_merge_vehicle_at_start, 
                        time_tolerance: time_offset, at: start, 
                            ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest)
                drive_ego_at_essence_initial: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_ego_speed_at_essence_initial_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_initial: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_lane_at_essence_initial_start: lane(same_as: merge_vehicle, at: start)
                drive_follow_vehicle_group_at_essence_initial: follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_merge_vehicle_speed)..\
                # 2 * (max_merge_vehicle_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_merge_vehicle_speed)]
                # This will ensure that Merge vehicle travels the distance and 
                # reach at start_offset of road_to_force_merge_location
                intent_essence_initial_duration: duration([6..30]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            #Conspicuity state of Merge vehicle
            merge_vehicle.turn_hazard_lights_state(hazard_light_type)
            merge_vehicle.turn_signal_lights_state(turn_signal_state)

            # The merge_vehicle starts from the lane end
            # and tries to merge in the highway whereas other vehicles
            # maintain the position and speed
            phase_essence_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_merge: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_merge_start:\
                        along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start, end_offset:
                        (lead_vehicle_distance_to_merge_location_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start),
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_middle_vehicle_at_essence_merge: middle_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_position_at_essence_merge_start:\
                        position(time: \
                        [gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start..
                        gen_middle_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge_phase_start + \
                        time_offset], 
                            measure_by: nearest, behind: lead_vehicle, at: start, 
                                run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_essence_merge: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_position_at_essence_merge_start:\
                        position(time: \
                        [gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start..
                        gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start +\
                        time_offset], 
                            behind: middle_vehicle, at: start, 
                            	measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_essence_merge: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_along_at_essence_merge_end:\
                        along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_ego_at_essence_merge: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_merge_end: along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                        start_offset: [10..20]m,
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_group_at_essence_merge: follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_merge_duration: duration([3..25]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # The Ego merges in between the vehicles travelling on highway
            # at the end. The merge_vehicle tries to maintain position with 
            # lead_vehicle. The other vehicle maintains its position.
            phase_essence_ego_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_ego_merge: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_middle_vehicle_at_essence_ego_merge: middle_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_position_at_essence_ego_merge_start:\
                        position(time: [gen_middle_vehicle_desired_time_gap..\
                        gen_middle_vehicle_desired_time_gap + time_offset], 
                        behind: merge_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest, 
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_essence_ego_merge: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_ego_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_position_at_essence_ego_merge_start:\
                        position(time: \
                        [gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start..
                        gen_follow_vehicle_time_gap_to_middle_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase_start + \
                            time_offset], behind: middle_vehicle,
                                at: start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_position_at_essence_ego_merge_end:\
                        position(time: [gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap..
                        gen_follow_vehicle_desired_time_gap + time_offset], behind: sut.car,
                        at: end, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_ego_merge: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_essence_ego_merge: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_position_at_essence_ego_merge_start:\
                        position(time: [gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase ..
                        gen_merge_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_ego_merge_phase + time_offset], 
                            at: start, behind: lead_vehicle, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_ego_at_essence_ego_merge: sut.car.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence_ego_merge_end: along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                drive_follow_vehicle_group_at_essence_ego_merge: follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_ego_merge_duration: duration([3..25]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # All the vehicles drives keeping the lane and
            # speed in best effort
            phase_essence_post_merge: parallel(overlap: equal):
                drive_merge_vehicle_at_essence_post_merge: merge_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_merge_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_ego_at_essence_post_merge: sut.car.drive()  with:
                    intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_post_merge_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_post_merge: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_ego_along_at_essence_post_merge_end: along(\
                        road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
                drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_post_merge: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_middle_vehicle_at_essence_post_merge: middle_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_middle_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_at_essence_post_merge: follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_follow_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_post_merge: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                drive_follow_vehicle_group_at_essence_post_merge: follow_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                intent_essence_post_merge_duration: duration([1..20]s, tolerance: 50s)
        
        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_ego_along_at_essence_post_merge_end,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sut.ego_merge_with_leading_mergers
# In this scenario, the Ego drives on a highway entry with lead vehicle 
# follow vehicle and ftx driver vehicle driving ahead of it.  
# And the lead traffic vehicle and traffic group drive on highway 
# The Ego merges to highway following the lead vehicle, follow vehicle
# and ftx driver vehicle.
#
#    In this scenario you may constrain specifically:
#    . gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start (the speed of 
#       highway entry road vehicles within [2..30]mps) 
#    . lead_vehicle_time_gap_to_merge_location (the initial time gap
#        of lead vehicle to merge location within [1..3]s)
#    . gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start (the time gap 
#       between highway entry road vehicles within [2..5]s) 
#    . gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group (the number of vehicles in
#      in car group within [2..10]) 
#    . gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed (the speed of vehicles in 
#       traffic group within [2..30]mps)

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/ego_merge/ego_merge_common/ego_merge_common_top.osc"
import "$FTX/env/basic/behavioral_models/ftx/ftx_group_driver_model.osc"

scenario sut.ego_merge_with_leading_mergers inherits ego_merge_common:

    lead_vehicle: vehicle
    follow_vehicle: vehicle
    ftx_driver_vehicle: vehicle
    lead_traffic_vehicle: vehicle 
        
    gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [200..400]m)

    # Road attributes
    force_merge_offset_from_end: length with:
        keep(it == road_to_force_merge_location.force_merge_offset_from_end + \
            sut.car.compound_object.get_length()/2 + sut.car.get_width())

    # The number of cars in car group is decided based on the 
    # minimum and maximum length of acceleration lane in maps
    # so that it can block or cover the length of acceleration
    # lane completely.
    gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group: int with:
        keep(default it in \
            ftlx_lib_base_config.default_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)

    # Time gap between vehicles on highway entry.
    gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start : time with :
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    # Speed of vehicles on highway entry.
    gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start: speed with:
        keep(default it in [0..150]kph)
    
    # Speed of vehicles on highway 
    gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [0..150]kph)

    keep(gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed >= \
        gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start)

extend vehicle:
    # The Vehicle's junction behavior is disabled to achieve the distance
    # provided
    keep(ftx_driver.junction_behavior.enable == false)

extend sut.ego_merge_with_leading_mergers:

    # This calculates the min and max forward speed for aggressive ftx driver 
    # profile. The min speed will be 10% more than the gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start
    # The max speed will be 20% more than the gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start.
    
    min_speed: speed with:
        keep(it == ((gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start*(10/100.0))+\
            gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start))
    max_speed: speed with:
        keep(it == ((gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start*(20/100.0))+\
            gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start))

    keep(ftx_driver_vehicle.ftx_driver.driving_profiles.aggressive_driving.forward_speed_max == max_speed)
    keep(ftx_driver_vehicle.ftx_driver.driving_profiles.comfort_driving.forward_speed_max == max_speed)
    keep(ftx_driver_vehicle.ftx_driver.driving_profiles.aggressive_driving.speed_min == min_speed)
    keep(ftx_driver_vehicle.policy.max_speed == max_speed)
      
    time_offset: time with:
        keep(default it == 1s)

    speed_offset: speed
    keep(default speed_offset == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_offset)

    length_offset: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)

    lead_traffic_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge: time with:
        keep(it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_ego_time_gap_to_vehicle)

    # Lead vehicle distance to start_of_merge_offset
    lead_vehicle_offset_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [20..50]m)

    # Defining the car group and its attirbutes
    traffic_vehicle_group: single_lane_car_group with:
        keep(it.reference_car == lead_traffic_vehicle)
        keep(it.cars.size() == gen_number_of_vehicles_in_vehicle_group)

    driver_model: ftx_group_driver_model
    for car in traffic_vehicle_group.cars:
        keep(car.initial_bm == driver_model)
        keep(car.ftx_driver.random_cruise_behavior.enable == true)
    keep(driver_model.use_target_speed == true)
    keep(driver_model.change_lane_eagerness == 2)
    
    # Speed to vehicle group is provided as same as of follow_vehicle
    keep(driver_model.target_speed in \
        [gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed-speed_offset..\
            gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed+speed_offset])

    on @initial_phase.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @initial_phase.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do first_of:
        merge_to_highway_with_leading_mergers: serial():
            # In this phase, the Ego drives behind the lead vehicle, follow vehicle
            # and ftx driver vehicle along the highway entry. The lead traffic vehicle
            # and vehicle group drive on highway road.
            initial_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                    position(time: [gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start-time_offset\
                        .. gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start+time_offset],
                        ahead_of: follow_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        time_tolerance: time_offset)
                    speed(gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start, 
                        tolerance: speed_offset, at: start)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                    position(time: [gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start-time_offset\
                        .. gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start+time_offset],
                        ahead_of: ftx_driver_vehicle, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        time_tolerance: time_offset)
                    speed(gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start, 
                        tolerance: speed_offset, at: start)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                ftx_driver_vehicle.drive()  with:
                    lane(same_as: sut.car, run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: [gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start-time_offset\
                        ..gen_highway_entry_vehicles_time_gap_at_start+time_offset],
                        ahead_of: sut.car, at: start, measure_by: nearest,
                        time_tolerance: time_offset)
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        - length_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                        + length_offset)], 
                    tolerance: 10m)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end,\
                        start_offset: [0..10]m, run_mode: best_effort)
                    speed([gen_ego_speed_at_start-10kph..\
                        gen_ego_speed_at_start+10kph],
                        tolerance: speed_offset, at: start)
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                lead_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed([gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed-5kph..\
                        gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed+5kph], at: start) 
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: start)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            # The duration is calculated by,
            # [(min_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
            # min_ego_speed_at_start)..\
            # 2 * (max_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
            # max_ego_speed_at_start)]
            # This will ensure that Ego travels the distance and 
            # reach at start_offset of road_to_force_merge_location
            with:
                duration([5..30]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)
                 
            # In this phase, the Ego drivers on the road_to_force_merge_location and the 
            # lead vehicle,follow vehicle and ftx driver merge to the highway
            # on the same lane as traffic vehicles
            vehicle_merge_phase: parallel(overlap:equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed(gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start, tolerance: speed_offset,
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end)
                follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end)
                    speed(gen_highway_entry_vehicles_speed_at_start, tolerance: speed_offset,
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                ftx_driver_vehicle.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end)
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location,
                        at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                lead_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed([gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed..\
                        gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed + speed_offset],
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: [lead_traffic_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge \
                        .. lead_traffic_vehicle_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_vehicle_merge+2s],
                        ahead_of: lead_vehicle, at: start, run_mode: best_effort) 
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([5..30]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase the Ego will merge to the highway and the 
            # lead vehicles continue driving in front of the Ego.
            ego_merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: [2..]s,ahead_of:follow_vehicle, 
                        at:end, run_mode: best_effort, track: projected)
                follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    position(time: [2..]s, ahead_of: ftx_driver_vehicle,
                        at: end, run_mode: best_effort, track: projected)
                ftx_driver_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    position(time: [2..]s,ahead_of:sut.car,
                        at:end, run_mode: best_effort, track: projected)
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to, at: end, 
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)   
                lead_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    speed([gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed..\
                        gen_highway_vehicle_group_speed + speed_offset],
                        run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([2..40]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            post_ego_merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                follow_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                ftx_driver_vehicle.drive()  with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
                lead_traffic_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode:best_effort)
                traffic_vehicle_group.group_drive()
            with:
                duration([1..5]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)
        
        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

extend sut.ego_merge_with_forced_stop:

    # Sampling the speed of blocking_vehicle at start
    on @start: blocking_vehicle_speed = blocking_vehicle.state.speed

    # Offset used in scenario
    distance_offset: length
    keep(default distance_offset == 20m)
    distance_tolerance: length
    keep(default distance_tolerance == 20m)

    var merge_phase_started := sample(true, @merge_phase.start)
    
    on @initial_phase.start:
       emit initial_phase_at_start_event

    on @initial_phase.end:
        emit initial_phase_at_end_event

    do ego_merge_with_forced_stop: first_of:
        main_scenario: serial():
            # In this phase, the Ego is coming from the highway entry and the
            # vehicle which is blocking the Ego's lane is coming from the highway
            initial_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                ego_drive1: sut.car.drive() with:
                    init_ego_speed: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start)
                    override(init_ego_speed, run_mode: best_effort)
                    distance([(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    - distance_offset)..(gen_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start \
                    + distance_offset)], 
                    tolerance: distance_tolerance)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location, at: end, 
                        start_offset: [10..20]m,
                            run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                blocking_vehicle_drive1: blocking_vehicle.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to,  at: start)
                    vehicle_speed_start: speed(gen_blocking_vehicle_speed, at: start,
                        tolerance: ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)
                    override(vehicle_speed_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    avoid_collisions(false)
            with:
                # The duration is calculated by,
                # [(min_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)..\
                # 2 * (max_ego_lon_lane_dist_to_merge_location_at_start/ 
                # max_ego_speed_at_start)]
                # This will ensure that the Ego travels the distance and reaches
                # the start_offset of the road_to_force_merge_location
                initial_duration: duration(default [6..30]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase, ego moves on forced_merge_lane and blocking
            # vehicle moves on side lane and maintains a distance
            forced_merge_lane_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                ego_drive2: sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location,
                        end_offset: [force_merge_offset_from_end - distance_offset..\
                            force_merge_offset_from_end + distance_offset],
                        at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                blocking_vehicle_drive2: blocking_vehicle.drive() with:
                    position([10..15]m, ahead_of: sut.car,tolerance:2m,
                       run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    avoid_collisions(false)
                    # Make sure that the blocking car is assertive and does not
                    # try to give ego any opportunity to merge
            with:
                duration([1..20]s, tolerance:phase_time_tolerance)

            # In this phase, ego reaches end of forced_merge_lane and tries
            # to merge with highway and blocking_vehicle tries to block its
            # path from merging
            merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                ego_drive3: sut.car.drive() with:
                    along(road_to_force_merge_location.merge_to,
                        at: end, run_mode:best_effort)
                    # This is a workaround to ensure that the lane change happens
                    # This will ensure that the NolaneChange soft constraint 
                    # is overridden
                    change_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                blocking_vehicle_drive3: blocking_vehicle.drive() with:
                    position([0..30]m, ahead_of: sut.car,tolerance: 2m,
                        at: end, run_mode:best_effort)
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    avoid_collisions(false)
                    # Make sure that the blocking car is aggresive and does not
                    # try to give ego the any opportunity to merge

            # In this phase the both vehicles maintain speed and lane
            post_merge_phase: parallel(overlap: equal):
                blocking_vehicle.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                sut.car.drive() with:
                    keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                    keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase: along(road_to_force_merge_path.successor_lane, 
                        at: end)
            with:
                duration([1..20]s, tolerance: phase_time_tolerance)
        
        serial:
            wait @ego_stopped
            log_info("$(self): ending scenario after Ego stopped for"+\
                "$(ego_complete_stand_still_time).")
        serial:
            wait @ego_merge_end_condition
            log_info("$(self): The Ego merged successfully into target lane "+\
                "and passed 10s.")

    on @ego_stopped:
        call other_warning(ego_stopped_warning, 
            "Ego stopped and was not able to merge into target lane.")
    
    # To ensure the scenario runs long enough, the Ego is expected 
    # to move to the successor lane of road_to_force_merge using the along modifier. 
    # Once the merge is completed, the along modifier is 
    # changed to best_effort, as the intent has been achieved
    on @sut.car.switch_lane_end:
        override(intent_assist_ego_along_at_post_phase,
            run_mode:best_effort)
        call logger.log_info("The Ego performed a lane change, "+\
            "triggering the switch_lane_end event")

                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_drive_3: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:

#    . gen_lat_swirling_period_at_end - End of swirling period

scenario sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl inherits lead_vehicle_family_base:
    keep(default scenario_str == "lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl")

    # Speed of lead_vehicle in phase 2 (drive_2)
    gen_lead_vehicle_speed_2: speed with:
        keep(default it in ftlx_lib_base_config.default_vehicle_speed_range)
    
    # Acceleration of lead_vehicle during lateral_swirl_and_change_speed
    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed_start.acceleration_range_during_lateral_swirl", gen_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_start_event.gen_acceleration_range_during_lateral_swirl")
    gen_acceleration_range_during_lateral_swirl: acceleration with:
        keep(default it in [-4..5]mpsps)

    # lateral distance offset while swirling
    gen_lat_offset_for_swirl: length
    keep(default gen_lat_offset_for_swirl in [1..3]m)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed_start.lat_swirling_period_at_start", gen_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_start_event.gen_lat_swirling_period_at_start")
    gen_lat_swirling_period_at_start: time
    keep(default gen_lat_swirling_period_at_start in [3..6]s)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.finish.lat_swirling_period_at_end", gen_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_start_event.gen_lat_swirling_period_at_end")
    gen_lat_swirling_period_at_end: time
    keep(default gen_lat_swirling_period_at_end in [3..6]s)

    @gen_parameter(actual_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_start_event.duration_at_essence", gen_cover: "sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl.phase_essence_start_event.gen_duration_at_essence")
    gen_duration_at_essence: time with:
        keep(default it in [5..9]s)

    gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence: time with:
        keep(default it == 5s)

    gen_ego_end_offset_to_lane_section_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [60..]m)

    gen_ego_end_offset_tolerance_to_lane_section_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it == 10m)

enum lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl_kind: [lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl,
    lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl_with_stationary_object]
    
extend sut.lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl:

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    # Lane section definition
    lane_section: lane_section

    # In behavioral tracking mode, the system searches for the point closest 
    # to the vehicle's current position on the calculated trajectory. The 
    # objective is set based on a point ahead by the look_ahead_time and is 
    # updated either every update_period or when the vehicle reaches the current 
    # objective. This objective is then evaluated by other behaviors in the 
    # driver's stack, such as speed adaptation or collision avoidance. When the 
    # vehicle is within look_ahead_time of the trajectory's end, the final point 
    # becomes the objective.
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.shape_behavior.tracking_mode == behavioral)

    # Shape definition and constraints for the shape
    lateral_shift_shape_with_acc: lateral_shift_shape_variable_amplitude_with_acc with:
        keep(it.transform == relative)
        keep(it.shape_duration == lat_swirl_duration)
        keep(it.acc_value_cpp == gen_acceleration_range_during_lateral_swirl)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 20.0)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_start_cpp == 0.5)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_end_cpp == 2.0)
        keep(it.sin_period_start == gen_lat_swirling_period_at_start)
        keep(it.sin_period_end == gen_lat_swirling_period_at_end)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == lead_vehicle)
        keep(it.lat_offset == gen_lat_offset_for_swirl)
    
    # Parameters to reduce the sensitivity of the collision avoidance for lead_vehicle
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon 
        == 1meter)
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lat
        == 0.1)

    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl_kind with:
        keep(default it == lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl)
    # For scenario with stationary objects
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)

    keep(gen_scenario_kind == lead_vehicle_changing_speed_with_lateral_swirl)

    keep(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start == 
        gen_ego_speed_at_start + gen_lead_vehicle_rel_speed_to_ego_at_start)

    # Constraining number of lanes to 
    road: one_way_road
    keep(road.min_lanes >= 1)
    
    straight_road: road_curvature 
    keep(straight_road.direction == neither)

    # Speed tolerance for lead_vehicle
    lead_vehicle_speed_tolerance: speed with:
        keep(default it == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)

    # End of swirling period
    lat_swirl_duration: time
    keep(default lat_swirl_duration in [5..7]s)

    lead_vehicle_lateral_offset_at_end: length with:
        keep(default it == 0meter)


    do phase_essence: serial():
        
        # Initial phase 
        phase_essence_drive: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, at: start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_along_at_essence: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_start: along(lane_section, 
                    end_offset: gen_ego_end_offset_to_lane_section_at_start, at: start, 
                    tolerance: gen_ego_end_offset_tolerance_to_lane_section_at_start)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lead_vehicle_at_essence_start: position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start,
                    ahead_of: sut.car, measure_by: nearest, at: start, 
                    time_tolerance: lead_vehicle_position_tolerance)
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_start: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: start,
                    tolerance: lead_vehicle_speed_tolerance)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_end: speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start, at: end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_start :lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_distance_at_essence_start: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start, 
                    line: center, at: start)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_start: along(lane_section, 
                    end_offset: gen_lead_vehicle_end_offset_to_lane_section_at_start, at: start, 
                    tolerance: gen_lead_vehicle_end_offset_tolerance_to_lane_section_at_start)
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_end: lateral(lead_vehicle_lateral_offset_at_end, line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_duration: duration(gen_duration_at_essence, tolerance: gen_duration_tolerance_at_essence)

        # Lead vehicle swirling with acceleration/deceleration
        phase_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_straight_road_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: along(straight_road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                control_lead_vehicle_shape_at_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed: shape(quantity: position, request: both, 
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape_with_acc)

    # Deactivating the off_road check for the swirling phases
    on @phase_essence_lateral_swirl_and_change_speed.start:
        override(lead_vehicle.global_checkers.off_road_checker,freeze)
    
    # Downgrading out of ODD error to warning due to swirling shape
    on @top.new_issue:
        call issues.curr.modify(out_of_odd, warning, "Downgrading out_of_odd error to warning")

    # Downgrading negative speed error when there is a negative acceleration 
    on @top.new_issue:
        call issues.curr.modify(driver_invalid_shape_trajectory, warning, "Downgrading driver_invalid_shape_trajectory error to warning")

extend sut.lead_vehicle_with_vehicle_ahead:

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    # Lead vehicle ahead of Ego
    ahead_lead_vehicle_2 : vehicle

    # Road definition
    road: one_way_road

    phase_ego_warm_up_duration: time
    keep(default phase_ego_warm_up_duration in [1..10]s)

    phase_ego_warm_up_duration_tolerance: time
    keep(default phase_ego_warm_up_duration_tolerance == 3s)

    # Duration of essence_slow_1 phase
    phase_essence_slow_1_duration: time
    keep(default phase_essence_slow_1_duration in [5..10]s)

    # Duration tolerance of essence_slow_1 phase
    phase_essence_slow_1_duration_tolerance: time
    keep(default phase_essence_slow_1_duration_tolerance == 5s)

    # Duration of essence_slow_2 phase
    phase_essence_slow_2_duration: time
    keep(default phase_essence_slow_2_duration in [2..15]s)

    # Duration tolerance of essence_slow_2 phase
    phase_essence_slow_2_duration_tolerance: time
    keep(default phase_essence_slow_2_duration_tolerance == 3s)
    
    do phase_essence: serial():
        # In this phase, the lead_vehicle starts reducing speed after
        # a delay of 'lead_vehicle_wait'
        phase_essence_slow_1: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_slow_1: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_slow_1: along(road)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_slow_1: keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
            phase_essence_lead_vehicle_drive_1: serial():
                drive_lead_vehicle_part_1_at_essence_slow_1: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_slow_1: \
                        keep_speed(run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_1_at_essence_slow_1: keep_lane()
                # Delay 
                intent_lead_vehicle_wait_at_essence_slow_1: wait elapsed(gen_lead_vehicle_delay)
                drive_lead_vehicle_part_2_at_essence_slow_1: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                    intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_slow_1_end: \
                        speed(gen_lead_vehicles_speed_at_lead_phase_1_end, at: end, 
                            run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_2_at_essence_slow_1: keep_lane()
            phase_essence_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_drive_1: serial():
                drive_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_at_essence_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_drive_1: ahead_lead_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                    intent_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_keep_lane_essence_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_drive_1: keep_lane()
                    intent_assist_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_along_essence_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_drive_1: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                    intent_assist_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_speed_essence_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_drive_1_end: \
                        speed(gen_lead_vehicles_speed_at_lead_phase_1_end, at: end, 
                            run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_slow_1_duration: duration(phase_essence_slow_1_duration, 
                tolerance: phase_essence_slow_1_duration_tolerance)

        # In this phase two lead vehicles further reduce their speed
        phase_essence_slow_2: parallel(overlap: equal):

            drive_ego_at_essence_slow_2: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_slow_2: along(road)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_slow_2: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_slow_2_end: speed(\
                    gen_lead_vehicles_speed_at_lead_phase_2_end, at: end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_slow_2_end: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end, 
                    line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_slow_2: along(road)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_slow_2: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_at_essence_slow_2: ahead_lead_vehicle_2.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_speed_at_essence_slow_2_end: speed(\
                    gen_lead_vehicles_speed_at_lead_phase_2_end, at: end,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                control_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_lateral_at_essence_slow_2_end: lateral(distance: gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_end, 
                    line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_along_at_essence_slow_2: along(road, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_keep_lane_at_essence_slow_2: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_slow_2_duration: duration(phase_essence_slow_2_duration, 
                tolerance: phase_essence_slow_2_duration_tolerance)

    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_end_event: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    do phase_test: serial():
        phase_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle_with_vehicle_family_base_ego_warm_up(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle, vehicle: ahead_lead_vehicle_2)
        phase_scenario: lead_vehicle_with_vehicle_ahead(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle, ahead_lead_vehicle_2: ahead_lead_vehicle_2)
        phase_post: lead_vehicle_with_vehicle_family_base_post(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle, vehicle: ahead_lead_vehicle_2)

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.gen_ego_speed_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_ego_speed_at_start)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_lead_vehicle_lat_offset_at_start)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.ahead_lead_vehicle_1_rel_time_dist_to_lead_vehicle_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_ahead_lead_vehicle_1_rel_time_dist_to_lead_vehicle_at_start)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.ahead_lead_vehicle_2_rel_time_dist_to_ahead_lead_vehicle_1_at_start == phase_scenario.gen_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_rel_time_dist_to_ahead_lead_vehicle_1_at_start)
    keep(phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.lead_vehicle_position_tolerance == phase_scenario.lead_vehicle_position_tolerance)

    in phase_ego_warm_up.ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.drive_ego_at_ego_warm_up with:
        intent_assist_ego_speed_at_warm_up: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)

            line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)

    in phase_ego_warm_up.drive_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up with:
        intent_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_lane_at_ego_warm_up_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
        intent_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_time_gap_at_warm_up_start: position(time: \
            ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.ahead_lead_vehicle_2_rel_time_dist_to_ahead_lead_vehicle_1_at_start +
            ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.ahead_lead_vehicle_1_rel_time_dist_to_lead_vehicle_at_start,

            time_tolerance: ego_and_lead_vehicle_at_ego_warm_up.lead_vehicle_position_tolerance)
        control_ahead_lead_vehicle_2_lateral_at_warm_up: \

extend sut.lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl:

    # In behavioral tracking mode, the system searches for the point closest 
    # to the vehicle's current position on the calculated trajectory. The 
    # objective is set based on a point ahead by the look_ahead_time and is 
    # updated either every update_period or when the vehicle reaches the current 
    # objective. This objective is then evaluated by other behaviors in the 
    # driver's stack, such as speed adaptation or collision avoidance. When the 
    # vehicle is within look_ahead_time of the trajectory's end, the final point 
    # becomes the objective.
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.shape_behavior.tracking_mode == behavioral)

    # Shape definition and constraints for the shape
    lateral_shift_shape: lateral_shift_shape_variable_amplitude with:
        keep(it.transform == lane_relative)
        keep(it.power_value_cpp == 20.0)
        keep(it.width_value_cpp == 1.0)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_start_cpp == 0.5)
        keep(it.sin_wave_intensity_value_end_cpp == 2.0)
        keep(it.sin_period_start == swirl_period_at_start)
        keep(it.sin_period_end == swirl_period_at_end)
        keep(it.swirl_vehicle == lead_vehicle)
        keep(it.lat_offset == swirl_amplitude_at_start)
    
    # have a collision avoidance on for the swirling vehicle but be 'carelss' so swirl will happen
    # when there is traffic in the vacinity
    keep(lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.collision_avoidance_behavior.safety_distance_lon == 0.5m)

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event

    duration_at_essence_closure: time with:
        keep(default duration_at_essence_closure in [5..10]s)

    duration_at_essence_prepare: time with:
        keep(default duration_at_essence_prepare in [1..8]s)

    duration_tolerance: time with:
       keep(default duration_tolerance == 2s)

    # Tolerance for speed 
    speed_tolerance: speed
    keep(default speed_tolerance == ftlx_lib_base_config.default_speed_tolerance)

    # Offset lateral distance while swirling
    swirl_amplitude_at_start: length
    keep(default swirl_amplitude_at_start in [0..1.5]m)

    # Duration of swirling
    swirl_period_at_start: time
    keep(default swirl_period_at_start in [1..5]s)
    swirl_period_at_end: time
    keep(default swirl_period_at_end in [1..5]s)

    # Lane section definition
    lane_section: lane_section
    lane_section_end_offset: range of length with:
        keep(default it in [100..]m)
    
    lat_offset_essence: length with:
        keep(default it == 0m)


    # Main do of the scenario 
    # It is a serial drive 
    do phase_essence: serial():

        # Parallel drive of lead vehicle and Ego at start
        phase_essence_prepare: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_prepare: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_prepare: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                     run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_along_at_essence_prepare_start:   \
                along(lane_section, end_offset: lane_section_end_offset, at: start)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_prepare: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_prepare_start:   \
                speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start,
                     tolerance: speed_tolerance, at: start)
                intent_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_prepare_end:    \
                speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start,
                     tolerance: speed_tolerance, at: end)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_prepare:    \
                lane(same_as: sut.car)
                intent_lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_prepare_start:    \
                position(time:
                    gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start,
                    ahead_of: sut.car, 
                    measure_by: nearest,
                    at:start, time_tolerance : lead_vehicle_position_tolerance)
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_prepare_end:    \
                lateral(lat_offset_essence, line: center, at: end)
        with:
            intent_essence_prepare_duration: \
                duration(duration_at_essence_prepare, tolerance: duration_tolerance)

        # Shape drive of lead vehicle while Ego drives
        phase_essence_lateral_swirl: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_lateral_swirl: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_lateral_swirl:   \
                speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_lateral_swirl:  \
                keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_lateral_swirl: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_lead_vehicle_shape_at_essence_lateral_swirl: \
                shape(quantity: position,request: both, 
                    shape_object: lateral_shift_shape)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_lateral_swirl:  \
                speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start,run_mode: best_effort)
            
        
        # Simple drive after lead vehicle's shape drive
        phase_essence_closure: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_closure: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_closure: speed(gen_ego_speed_at_start,
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_closure:   \
                keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_closure: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_closure:    \
                 lateral(distance: lat_offset_essence,
                    line: center, at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_closure:   \
                speed(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start,run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_closure:   \
                lane(same_as: sut.car, at: end, track: projected, run_mode: best_effort)
        with:
            intent_essence_closure_duration: \
                duration(duration_at_essence_closure, tolerance: duration_tolerance)

    # Check whether the Ego started to change lanes
    event ego_lane_change_start is @sut.car.switch_lane_start

    on @ego_lane_change_start: 
        call logger.log_info("The Ego started to change lanes")

extend vehicle.global_checkers:
    # Deactivate the off_road check, aligning with the intended objective of the scenario.
    override(off_road_checker, run_mode: freeze)

    # lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl_test scenario implementation
    # scenario invokes serially ego warm up, lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl and then the post scenarios

extend sut.lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl_test:

    do phase_test: serial():

        # invoke the default base ego warm up scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_ego_warm_up: lead_vehicle_family_base_ego_warm_up(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl scenario
        phase_scenario: lead_vehicle_with_lateral_swirl(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

        # invoke the default base post scenario for the lead_vehicle family
        phase_post: lead_vehicle_family_base_post(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle)

extend sut.lead_vehicle:

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    lat_offset: range of length
    keep(default lat_offset == [-0.5..0.5]m)

    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: lead_vehicle_kind with: keep(default it == lead_vehicle)
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)
    default_cruise_distance: range of time
    keep(default default_cruise_distance == [3..5]s)

    speed_offset: speed 
    keep(default speed_offset == 3kph)
    
    # Bypass behavior parameters
    var ego_bypass_default:bool
    var lead_vehicle_bypass_default:bool

    # Phase duration and it's tolerances 
    duration_at_essence_approaching: time with:
        keep(default it in [3..10]s)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_approaching: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    duration_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: time with:
        keep(default it in [3..5]s)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: time with:
        keep(default it == 1s)

    do phase_essence: serial():
        phase_essence_approaching: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_approaching: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_speed_at_essence_approaching_stat: speed(speed: [(gen_ego_speed_at_start - speed_offset).. \
                    (gen_ego_speed_at_start + speed_offset)], 
                    at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_approaching: keep_lane()
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_approaching: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_approaching_start:\ 
                    speed(speed: [(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start - speed_offset).. \
                        (gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start + speed_offset)], 
                        at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_same_as_ego_at_essence_approaching_start:\
                    lane(same_as:sut.car, at: start)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_time_gap_at_essence_approaching_start:\
                    position(time: gen_ego_time_gap_to_lead_vehicle_at_start, ahead_of: sut.car, 
                        at:start, measure_by: nearest, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_approaching: keep_lane()
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_relative_position_at_essence_approaching_end: \
                    position(time: default_cruise_distance, ahead_of: sut.car, at:end, 
                        measure_by: nearest, track: projected, run_mode: best_effort)
                control_lead_vehicle_lateral_at_essence_approaching_end: \
                    lateral(lat_offset, line: center, at: end, run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_approaching_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_approaching, 
                tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_approaching)
        phase_essence_adaptive_cruise: parallel(overlap: equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_adaptive_cruise:sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_speed_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                intent_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: keep_lane()
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_speed_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: keep_speed(run_mode:best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_adaptive_cruise: keep_lane()
        with: 
            intent_essence_adaptive_cruise_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_adaptive_cruise, 
                tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_adaptive_cruise)

    on @phase_essence_start_event:
        ego_bypass_default = sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable
        lead_vehicle_bypass_default = lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable
        logger.log_info("setting EGO bypass behavior to false")
        lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable = false
        sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable = false
        call lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()
        call sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()
    on @phase_essence_end_event:

        call lead_vehicle.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()
        call sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.update_config()

import "$FTX_PACKAGES/base_scenarios/scenarios/lead_vehicle/lead_vehicle/lead_vehicle_top.osc"

extend sut.lead_vehicle_breaks_speed_limit:

    # Connect @phase_essence.start implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_essence.start: emit phase_essence_start_event 
    # Connect @phase_essence.end implementaton to the base event phase_essence_end_event
    on @phase_essence.end: emit phase_essence_end_event 

    speed_limit: speed  # speed limit
    road_with_speed_limit: speed_limit_section

    duration_at_essence_speed_up: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..30]second)

    duration_at_continue_drive: time with:
        keep(default it in [1..10]second)
    
    duration_tolerance: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    lead_vehicle_end_offset_to_lane_section_at_start: length with:
        keep(default it in [150..]m)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_speed_up: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    duration_tolerance_at_essence_continue_drive: time with:
        keep(default it == 2s)

    keep(lead_vehicle.policy.may_exceed_legal_speed == true)
    keep(speed_limit > 0kph)
    keep(speed_limit == road_with_speed_limit.speed_limit)
    # Lead vehicle speed is 50% to 80% greater than the speed limit of the road element. 
    lead_vehicle_speed_lower_bound: speed with:
        keep(it == (speed_limit + (speed_limit*(50/100))))
    lead_vehicle_speed_upper_bound: speed with:
        keep(it == (speed_limit + (speed_limit*(80/100))))
    # Set the lead vehicle 10% lower than speed limit at the start
    keep(gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start == (speed_limit - (speed_limit*(10/100))))
    # For separating coverage when invoked as sub-scenario
    kind: lead_vehicle_kind with:
        keep(default it == lead_vehicle_breaks_speed_limit)
    has_stationary_object: bool with: keep(default it == false)
    keep(lead_vehicle.policy.may_exceed_legal_speed == true)
    
    do phase_essence: serial():
        lead_vehicle_at_essence: lead_vehicle(lead_vehicle: lead_vehicle, kind: self.kind,
            has_stationary_object: self.has_stationary_object)
        phase_essence_speed_up: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_speed_up: sut.car.drive()  with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_speed_up: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
                keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.enable == false)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_speed_up: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_along_at_essence_speed_up: along(road_with_speed_limit,  
                    end_offset: lead_vehicle_end_offset_to_lane_section_at_start,
                    at:start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_speed_up_start: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: start)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_speed_up_start: speed(speed: gen_lead_vehicle_speed_at_start, \
                     at: start, run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_lane_at_essence_speed_up_end: lane(same_as: sut.car, at: end, 
                    run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_speed_up_end: speed(speed: [lead_vehicle_speed_lower_bound..\
                    lead_vehicle_speed_upper_bound], at: end,run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_speed_up_duration: duration(duration_at_essence_speed_up,
                tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_speed_up)

        phase_essence_continue_drive: parallel(overlap:equal):
            drive_ego_at_essence_continue_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
                intent_assist_ego_keep_lane_at_essence_continue_drive: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
            drive_lead_vehicle_at_essence_continue_drive: lead_vehicle.drive() with:
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_speed_at_essence_continue_drive_start: \
                    speed(speed: [lead_vehicle_speed_lower_bound..\
                        lead_vehicle_speed_upper_bound], at: start,run_mode: best_effort)
                intent_assist_lead_vehicle_keep_lane_at_essence_continue_drive: keep_lane(run_mode: best_effort)
        with: 
            intent_essence_continue_drive_duration: duration(duration_at_continue_drive,
                tolerance: duration_tolerance_at_essence_continue_drive)

 
# lead_vehicle_breaks_speed_limit_test scenario implementation
# scenario invokes serially ego warm up, lead_vehicle_breaks_speed_limit and then the post scenarios
extend sut.lead_vehicle_breaks_speed_limit_test:

    # Connect @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event event implementaton to the base event phase_essence_start_event
    on @phase_scenario.phase_essence_start_event: emit phase_essence_start_event

# Scenario definition with the name 'vru_group_crossing_marked_crosswalk'
